papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Genetic factors play an important role in the pathogenesis of interstitial lung diseases. Recent studies have shown that approximately 30% of familial interstitial lung diseases are associated with mutations in telomere-related genes. Herein, we present a young patient with severe pulmonary fibrosis and multisystem involvement in whom a homozygous NOP10 variant was identified. CASE REPORT: A 29-year-old man presented with progressive exertional dyspnea, cough, and fever. Thoracic computed tomography demonstrated a probable usual interstitial pneumonia pattern. Laboratory investigations showed anemia, thrombocytopenia, neutropenia, and elevated lactate dehydrogenase levels, while hematological evaluation revealed a hypocellular bone marrow. Abdominal imaging demonstrated findings compatible with chronic liver disease. Due to parental consanguinity and a positive family history, alpha-1 antitrypsin analysis and whole-exome sequencing (WES) were performed. Despite treatment, his clinical condition continued to deteriorate, with progression to multiorgan failure, and he died on the 21st day of hospitalization. Genetic results obtained after the patient's death revealed the presence of the alpha-1 antitrypsin Pi*M/P Lowell variant and the homozygous NOP10 variant. CONCLUSION: In conclusion, to the best of our knowledge, this case is the first to describe a patient with a homozygous NOP10 p.Arg34Trp variant who presented with severe pulmonary fibrosis and multisystem involvement in the absence of the classic mucocutaneous triad of dyskeratosis congenita (nail dystrophy, reticular skin pigmentation, and oral leukoplakia).

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Breathlessness has long been associated with respiratory and cardiovascular diseases. Obesity has also been reported to be independently associated with breathlessness. However, the impact of obesity on lung volumes and diffusion capacity parameters among those with breathlessness who showed no evidence of respiratory or cardiac disease has not been well explored, particularly in Saudi Arabia. Thus, the aims of this study were (1) to assess whether body mass index (BMI) is associated with lung volumes and diffusion capacity parameters, and (2) to explore the impact of overweight and obesity on lung volumes and diffusion capacity parameters among Saudi participants who visited a pulmonary clinic for a follow-up concerning unexplained breathlessness. METHOD: The medical records of individuals who visited our local respiratory clinic complaining of breathlessness and underwent a full pulmonary function test were reviewed. Participants with known respiratory or cardiovascular diseases and missing lung volumes and diffusion capacity data were excluded. Group comparisons across BMI categories (normal weight, overweight, and obesity) were performed using one-way ANOVA followed by Tukey's multiple comparisons test. Associations between BMI and lung function parameters were further evaluated using multivariable linear regression analyses adjusted for age, sex, and smoking status. RESULTS: A total of 79 patients met the inclusion criteria and were included in the final analyses, of whom 62% were male. The means ± SD age and BMI were 47 ± 15.5 years and 29.7 ± 7.2 kg/m2, respectively. Expiratory reserve volume (ERV), functional residual capacity (FRC), and DLCO (% predicted) were lower in obese participants compared with normal weight and/or overweight groups. In multivariable analysis, BMI remained independently associated with reduced ERV (β = -1.83, 95% CI - 2.74 to - 0.91, p < 0.0001) and DLCO (β = -0.69, 95% CI - 1.15 to - 0.23, p < 0.001), and a modest increase in inspiratory capacity (IC) (β = 0.62, 95% CI 0.05 to 1.20, p < 0.05), with no significant associations observed for other lung volumes. CONCLUSION: Obesity was associated with lower ERV and DLCO in individuals with unexplained breathlessness. These findings support pulmonary function assessment and weight management in clinical practice. Further studies are needed to explore the underlying mechanisms of obesity and its associations with breathlessness and impairment in lung function.

papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: MDA5+ dermatomyositis (MDA5+DM) frequently complicates interstitial lung disease (ILD), especially rapidly progressive ILD (RP-ILD), which worsens prognosis. Traditional assessments cannot directly reflect fibroblast activation status, a key driver of pulmonary fibrosis. 68Ga-FAPI-04 PET/CT targets fibroblast activation protein (FAP), but its value in MDA5+DM remains understudied. METHODS: Fourteen MDA5+DM patients and 5 controls were enrolled. 68Ga-FAPI-04 PET/CT was performed to obtain SUVmax of lungs, muscles, and other organs. Clinical data, pulmonary function tests, and deep learning-quantified HRCT indices were collected. Follow-ups for pulmonary function and HRCT were conducted. Correlations between SUVmax, clinical features, and follow-up outcomes were analyzed. RESULTS: Whole-lung SUVmax was significantly higher in MDA5+DM patients (3.32 vs. 0.67, p < 0.0001), with left lower lobe showing the most prominent difference (p = 0.0003). SUVmax strongly correlated with HRCT inflammation/fibrosis indices (e.g., left lower lobe vs. PII at 3 months: r = 0.9863, p < 0.0001) and small-to-medium airway function (lung vs. MMEF 75/25: r=-0.8168, p = 0.0133). Baseline SUVmax predicted 3-12-month lesion progression and lung function changes, with deceased patients having higher baseline whole-lung SUVmax (p = 0.008). CONCLUSION: This exploratory study suggests that 68Ga-FAPI-04 PET/CT may reflect fibroblast activation and the active inflammatory-fibrotic process, assesses early pulmonary impairments and monitoring lesion progression in MDA5+DM. It provides a valuable hypothesis-generating tool for clinical evaluation, warranting further validation.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Despite advances in asthma management, asthma exacerbations (AE) remain a leading cause of morbidity, and the immunopathological mechanisms driving AE progression need further clarification. Here, we explored the role of macrophage apoptosis resistance in AE using clinical samples and murine models. METHODS: Macrophages were isolated from bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) of AE patients and lung macrophages from AE mice to detect Bcl-2 expression and apoptosis. We performed adoptive transfer of ex vivo apoptotic bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs) and ADAM8-silenced BMDMs. Integrative transcriptomic analysis of GSE144576 combined with in vivo validation was used to screen regulators of lung macrophage apoptosis resistance. In vitro and in vivo experiments with the peptidomimetic inhibitor BK1361 were conducted to dissect ADAM8 downstream signaling. RESULTS: Macrophages from AE patients and AE mice showed elevated Bcl-2 and strong apoptosis resistance. Adoptive transfer of apoptotic BMDMs partially reversed macrophage apoptosis resistance and mitigated airway inflammation. Transcriptomics plus animal validation identified ADAM8 as a regulator of macrophage apoptosis resistance. Consistently, transfer of ADAM8-silenced BMDMs relieved airway inflammation and reduced apoptosis resistance. Mechanistically, ADAM8 may activate PI3K/AKT signaling to upregulate Bcl-2 and promote apoptosis resistance. BK1361 suppressed ADAM8/PI3K/AKT signaling, enhanced macrophage apoptosis, and reduced inflammatory infiltration, mucus hypersecretion, and airway hyperresponsiveness (AHR) in AE mice. DISCUSSION: In summary, macrophage apoptosis resistance drives inflammatory amplification in AE. The ADAM8/PI3K/AKT axis mediates this phenotype, indicating ADAM8 as a promising therapeutic target for AE.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Chronic helminth infection is associated with altered anti-mycobacterial immunity, including impaired Th1 responses and expansion of regulatory immune populations. However, how helminth infection reshapes coordinated innate and adaptive immune pathways during active tuberculosis remains poorly understood. We therefore investigated systemic and cellular immune signatures associated with helminth infection, tuberculosis (TB), and helminth-TB coinfection. METHODS: Plasma and peripheral blood mononuclear cells were obtained from healthy Swedish controls, endemic Peruvian controls, individuals with helminth infection, active tuberculosis, and helminth-TB coinfection. Plasma proteins were quantified using high-throughput Olink proteomics, while circulating monocytes and CD4+ T-cell compartments were characterized via flow cytometry. Protein abundance, monocyte phenotypes, and CD4+ T-cell differentiation and activation marker expression were compared between study groups. RESULTS: Proteomic profiling revealed broad differences associated with active TB, whereas helminth infection alone was associated with relatively few differentially abundant proteins compared with endemic controls. Participants with helminth-TB coinfection exhibited 65 differentially abundant proteins compared with endemic controls, including 33 that met the significance threshold only in this comparison. These proteins were associated with immune regulation, leukocyte trafficking, vascular activation, and myeloid responses. Flow cytometric analysis revealed increased PD-L1 expression on intermediate monocytes in helminth-infected participants compared to endemic controls, while plasma CD274 abundance was highest in helminth-TB coinfection. Coinfected individuals also displayed increased IL-4 receptor expression on classical and intermediate monocytes compared to the endemic control group. Within the CD4+ T-cell compartment, helminth infection was associated with broad upregulation of PD-1 across naïve, central memory, effector memory, and effector subsets, whereas TB was associated with altered T-cell differentiation and increased TIM-3 expression. Helminth-TB coinfection combined these features and was further characterized by increased frequencies of CTLA-4+, CD40L+, and CD28+ CD4+ T-cell populations. CONCLUSION: Plasma proteomic and cellular profiling identified distinct immune signatures associated with TB, helminth infection, and their co-occurrence. Helminth-TB coinfection was associated with additional changes in immune regulation and cell-communication pathways, alongside concurrent activation-associated and inhibitory features across monocyte and CD4+ T-cell compartments. Together, these findings support an exploratory model in which active TB is associated with broad systemic inflammatory remodeling, while helminth exposure is associated with an additional regulatory overlay during coinfection.

papers.abstract_en: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a complex and heterogeneous disease affecting approximately 300 million individuals worldwide. Currently, there is an unmet need in the management of COPD, leading to some patients receiving inadequate or inappropriate treatment. The aim of this paper is to synthesize expert opinion from a group of Europe-based pulmonologists from nine countries on the unmet needs and challenges in the patient pathway for COPD and to outline potential recommendations to address them. In order to explore the current gaps and potential solutions in clinical practice, patients diagnosed with COPD with unmet needs were divided into two groups: 1) patients not receiving optimal treatment and 2) patients with access to standard treatment options, but with unmet needs due to continuing symptom burden or exacerbations. Key challenges for patients suboptimally treated center around inadequate treatment intensification and device mismatch/inhaler technique, with proposed solutions focusing on disease stability and considerations around patient dexterity and cognitive status for inhaler choice and technique. For patients with unmet needs despite optimized inhaled treatment, challenges focus on recurrent exacerbations, with proposed solutions of personalized treatment assessing phenotypes and endotypes which may inform timely initiation of additional treatments, such as biologics. Hereby, we discuss the multifactorial issues that contribute to unmet needs, and how a shift in the paradigm of COPD management is necessary to tackle the gap in patient care.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Invasive mold disease (IMD) remains a substantial cause of patient morbidity and mortality. Aspergillosis and mucormycosis remain the predominant infections encountered, although rare molds continue to emerge as important pathogens. Improvement in patient outcomes has been the result of progress in risk stratification, diagnostics, supportive care, antifungal therapy, and/or prophylaxis, yet substantial challenges remain, requiring the development of novel treatment strategies. Clinical trials evaluating treatment response are currently based on consensus criteria published in 2008. However, advances in clinical mycology and the broadening variety of mold diseases in clinical trials necessitate a revision of these criteria to ensure that adjudication of patient outcomes accurately captures responses to therapeutic intervention. METHODS: To tackle this task, an international expert panel nominated by the European Confederation of Medical Mycology (ECMM) and Mycoses Study Group Education and Research Consortium (MSGERC) was convened. RESULTS: The panel produced updated consensus guidance for assessing treatment responses and defining study outcomes in clinical trials of IMD in both adults and children. CONCLUSIONS: Along with guidance, potential pitfalls in assessing outcome, such as discordant clinical, radiologic, and/or mycologic data and areas for future research are discussed.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a leading cause of disease- related mortality worldwide and is characterized by progressive airflow limitation accompanied by persistent neutrophilic airway inflammation. Macrophage activation plays a key role in this process through the production of pro- inflammatory mediators and neutrophil-attracting chemokines. METHODS: This study investigated the anti-inflammatory effects of Cardamine flexuosa extract (CFE) in macrophage and cigarette smoke extract (CSE)/lipopolysaccharide (LPS)- induced models, with emphasis on macrophage inflammatory responses and neutrophilic airway inflammation. RESULTS: In LPS-stimulated RAW 264.7 macrophages, CFE reduced nitric oxide production by 77.8% and decreased the secretion of TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, and matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs), accompanied by reduced MAPK phosphorylation. In a murine model induced by intranasal administration of CSE and LPS, oral CFE reduced total inflammatory cell and neutrophil counts in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) by 53.9% and 82.9%, respectively, at 200 mg/kg compared with the CSE/LPS group. These effects were associated with reduced pulmonary expression of CXCL-1 and MIP-2 and decreased MAPK phosphorylation. Histological analysis demonstrated attenuation of inflammatory cell infiltration and mucus hypersecretion. CONCLUSION: These findings demonstrate that CFE attenuates macrophage inflammatory responses and neutrophilic airway inflammation in the CSE/LPS-induced murine model, accompanied by reduced inflammatory mediator production and MAPK activation.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Pulmonary rehabilitation (PR) is beneficial, yet outcome assessment remains inconsistent. A multidisciplinary D-A-CH working group reviewed evidence, introduced new measures, and explored emerging PR concepts. SUMMARY: The meeting emphasized patient-reported and clinician-reported outcome measures. A key focus was the minimal clinically important difference (MCID), a widely used metric which is applied inconsistently and is highly dependent on the baseline value. The "performance score" (T2D = T2 + (T2-T1)) takes baseline status (T1) into account by combining the discharge value (T2) with the improvement (T2-T1) before and after treatment, based on the distribution. This simple descriptive approach results in a baseline-adjusted MCID estimator, with a planned multicenter study to validate its use in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease rehabilitation. Further discussions addressed epistemic trust, crucial for patient adherence and interdisciplinary collaboration, with a study planned to assess its impact. Dysfunctional breathing (DB), often overlooked in PR, was highlighted, emphasizing the need for standardized diagnostic tools. The role of artificial intelligence (AI) in PR, including large language models, was explored, with surveys planned to evaluate patient and provider perceptions. KEY MESSAGES: The T2D performance score offers a dynamic approach to assessing PR progress, addressing MCID limitations. Standardized methods for epistemic trust and DB diagnosis are essential for better recognition and management. AI integration in PR presents opportunities for personalized rehabilitation but requires further evaluation. The D-A-CH working group remains committed to advancing PR through evidence-based strategies and international collaboration.

papers.title_zh: 过敏性鼻炎与哮喘基层管理中全科医生角色的评述性论述（无实证数据）
papers.title_en: ARIA - Italy from guidelines to practice: the role of general practitioners in allergic rhinitis and asthma management.
papers.authors: Paoletti G, Marchetti M, Cavaglià E, Bognanni A, Passalacqua G, Heffler E, Bousquet J, Canonica GW et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Biomedical Sciences, Humanitas University, Milan, Italy.
papers.authors_conclusion: Ultimately, empowering GPs through education, resource allocation, and stronger multidisciplinary networks is essential to improve the management of AR and asthma, mitigating their impact on patients' quality of life, and ensuring better sustainability of care.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：全文为叙述性论述，摘要未提供任何样本量、研究设计、终点或统计数值；无实证数据支撑其主张，无法评估证据强度。内容为过敏性鼻炎与哮喘基层管理，属非肿瘤呼吸病，与胸部肿瘤/胸外科核心业务关联度低。
papers.abstract_en: This paper outlines the critical role of General Practitioners (GPs) in managing allergic rhinitis (AR) and asthma, two prevalent chronic respiratory diseases characterized by immune-mediated airway inflammation. AR and asthma frequently coexist, affecting an increasing portion of the global population and imposing substantial health and socioeconomic burdens. The paper highlights that GPs are often the first point of contact for patients and are uniquely positioned to ensure early diagnosis, ongoing care, and adherence to evidence-based treatment guidelines. It emphasizes the necessity of integrated, multidisciplinary approaches, including collaboration with specialists and pharmacists, to enhance patient outcomes and optimize healthcare resources. Challenges such as fragmented care, regional disparities in healthcare access, and patient self-medication are discussed, underscoring the need for structured healthcare pathways and the more effective use of diagnostic tools. The article also emphasizes the growing importance of digital health technologies, telemedicine, and artificial intelligence in supporting GPs, improving adherence monitoring, and personalizing patient management. Ultimately, empowering GPs through education, resource allocation, and stronger multidisciplinary networks is essential to improve the management of AR and asthma, mitigating their impact on patients' quality of life, and ensuring better sustainability of care.

papers.study_type: 回顾性全国数据库队列研究（SEER-Medicare）· 用近端因果推断与阴性对照校正未测混杂，比较SBRT与亚肺叶切除的肺癌特异性死亡
papers.title_zh: SEER-Medicare队列经近端因果推断校正未测混杂后，IA期NSCLC中SBRT相对亚肺叶切除的肺癌特异性死亡差异大幅缩小但仍偏向手术
papers.title_en: Stereotactic Body Radiation Therapy vs Surgery for Stage IA Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer.
papers.authors: Linderman GC, Li KQ, Potter AL, Hwang T, Kozono DE, Fong ZV, Tchetgen Tchetgen EJ, Yang CJ et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Division of Thoracic Surgery, Department of Surgery, Massachusetts General Hospital, Boston.
papers.authors_conclusion: 本研究实证显示既往SBRT与手术的观察性比较存在因未测混杂导致的偏倚；当使用近端因果推断更好控制虚弱与合并症混杂后，手术相关结局仍持续存在较小但显著的改善，尽管不能排除病理与临床分期差异所致残余偏倚的影响；本研究证明近端因果推断可用于多种场景下控制未测混杂因素。
papers.ai_note: ①效应随校正层级从0.047降至0.024再降至0.012人年，约75%的表观差异可归因于混杂，最终残余效应的CI下限0.0013贴近零，临床获益幅度（人年为单位）缺乏临床意义换算，信息不足；②人群为平均75.6岁的老年患者且仅比较亚肺叶切除，结论外推至适合肺叶切除的年轻、体能状态好的可手术患者信息不足；③非随机设计，作者自认无法排除分期差异带来的残余偏倚，无法与已关闭的3项RCT证据等同；④摘要载明数据分析时间为2023年4月至2026年8月，时间跨度存在矛盾、信息不足；⑤主要终点为肺癌特异性死亡，未报告总生存，次要终点（其他原因死亡）主要用于混杂诊断而非疗效结论。
papers.abstract_en: IMPORTANCE: Stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT) is a well-established alternative to surgery for nonoperable patients with early-stage non-small cell (NSCLC) lung cancer. However, the role of SBRT in operable patients is unclear as 3 randomized clinical trials comparing SBRT with surgery were closed early because of poor accrual. Existing observational comparisons are limited by confounding because patients who receive SBRT are generally frailer and more comorbid. OBJECTIVE: To compare cancer-specific mortality between surgery and SBRT using proximal causal inference to adjust for unmeasured confounding due to frailty and comorbidity using proxy variables. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This cohort study was a national database analysis of the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER)-Medicare dataset. Three treatment effect estimates were obtained with increasing control of confounding: unadjusted, standard-regression adjusted for measured confounders as in existing studies, and proximally adjusted for unmeasured confounders. Participants were patients with stage IA NSCLC who underwent sublobar resection or SBRT from 2010 to 2019, followed up through December 21, 2021. Data analysis was performed from April 2023 to August 2026. EXPOSURES: Sublobar resection vs SBRT. Negative control exposures were constructed from billing codes. MAIN OUTCOME AND MEASURES: Lung cancer-specific mortality. Negative control outcomes were constructed from other-cause mortality. Results are reported as hazard differences (HD) and 95% CI. RESULTS: A total of 4251 patients met inclusion and exclusion criteria; 2581 (60.7%) were female and 1670 (39.3%) were male. Their mean (SD) age was 75.6 (6.3) years. A total of 2558 patients underwent SBRT and 1693 underwent surgery. In the unadjusted and covariate-adjusted analyses, SBRT was associated with higher lung cancer cause-specific mortality, HD of 0.047 person-years (95% CI, 0.038-0.055) and 0.024 person-years (95% CI, 0.014-0.034), respectively. However, there was also compelling evidence of confounding due to a strong estimated association with other-cause mortality. In the proximal analysis, other-cause mortality together with negative control exposures were used to indirectly control for hidden confounders, yielding an HD of 0.012 person-years (95% CI, 0.0013-0.027). CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: This study empirically showed that existing observational comparisons of SBRT and surgery are biased because of unmeasured confounding. When proximal causal inference was used to better control for confounding due to frailty and comorbidity, there continued to be a smaller but significant improvement in outcomes associated with surgery, though the effects of residual bias due to differences in pathologic and clinical staging could not be ruled out. This study demonstrates that proximal causal inference can be used to control for unmeasured confounders in a variety of settings.

papers.study_type: 回顾性横断面研究 · 823例手术切除肺腺癌谱系病灶靶向测序
papers.title_zh: 肺腺癌组织病理谱系各阶段的综合基因组特征：EGFR随浸润程度升高、TP53在浸润性腺癌显著富集
papers.title_en: Comprehensive Genomic Landscape Across Histopathological Stages of Lung Adenocarcinoma: A Retrospective Cross-Sectional Study.
papers.authors: Hu X, Huang Y, Cao Y, Wang W, Wang J, Wang K, Wu D, Fu S et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hospital, Sun Yat-sen University Guangzhou China.
papers.authors_conclusion: These findings delineate histology-associated genomic patterns across the lung adenocarcinoma spectrum without implying direct temporal evolution.
papers.ai_note: 研究为横断面设计，无法推断前驱病变至浸润性癌的时序演化，作者已明确声明不暗示直接时间演化；EGFR升高与TP53富集的趋势为已知发现，创新性有限。生存分析中TMB及KRAS/STK11/KEAP1组与较差生存关联的效应量、HR、CI及P值在摘要中未报告，信息不足，无法评估其临床意义大小。TMB与PD-L1 TPS随基因突变状态变化的描述缺乏具体数值。
papers.abstract_en: The genomic features associated with the histopathological spectrum from precursor glandular lesions to invasive lung adenocarcinoma remain incompletely characterized. In this retrospective cross-sectional study, we performed targeted sequencing of 823 resected lesions from 823 patients, including 149 precursor glandular lesions (11 atypical adenomatous hyperplasia [AAH] and 138 adenocarcinoma in situ [AIS]), 252 minimally invasive adenocarcinoma (MIA), and 422 invasive adenocarcinoma (IAC). EGFR mutation frequency increased across precursor lesions, MIA, and IAC (44%, 57%, and 65%), whereas ERBB2 decreased (20%, 13%, and 6%); TP53 was markedly enriched in IAC (3%, 6%, and 35%). Cell-cycle and homologous recombination repair (HRR) pathway alterations were likewise more frequent in IAC and in Grade 3 tumors. Solid nodules showed higher TP53, cell-cycle, and HRR alteration frequencies than ground-glass-predominant lesions. IAC displayed prominent tobacco-associated single-base substitutions 4 (SBS4) and APOBEC-associated SBS2 signatures, whereas MIA signatures showed lower similarity to canonical COSMIC signatures. Smoking was associated with a distinct genomic profile and higher tumor mutational burden (TMB). TMB and PD-L1 tumor proportion score varied according to gene mutation status. High TMB and KRAS/STK11/KEAP1-related mutation groups were associated with poorer survival. These findings delineate histology-associated genomic patterns across the lung adenocarcinoma spectrum without implying direct temporal evolution.

papers.study_type: 儿童诊断技术方法学对比研究（同体交叉比较两种nNO测量设备与两种呼吸配合方法的检测成功率及读数差异）
papers.title_zh: 手持电化学传感器与化学发光分析仪测鼻呼出一氧化氮：潮气呼气腭闭合（TBVC）法提高检测成功率，但便携设备读数系统偏低
papers.title_en: Usability of Hand-Held Devices With an Electrochemical Sensor to Determine Nasal Nitric Oxide in Clinical Routine.
papers.authors: Lenz A, Usemann J, Horat-Buechel F, Moeller A, Jung A
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Respiratory Medicine, University Children's Hospital Zurich, Switzerland.
papers.authors_conclusion: 常规呼吸方法检测成功率低，尤其低龄者，但TBVC可提高成功率；电化学传感器设备的鼻NO水平低于化学发光分析仪，而常规法与TBVC法之间无差异；这些发现支持将便携分析仪联合TBVC作为筛查排除PCD的有前景工具
papers.ai_note: 研究仅比较检测成功率与读数水平，摘要未报告任何PCD确诊病例、金标准对照或敏感度/特异度/阴性预测值，故'筛查排除PCD（screen-out）'的结论缺乏诊断准确性证据支撑，属结论超出研究设计；电化学设备读数系统性偏低（低约50–75 nL/min）意味着不能直接套用基于化学发光仪器建立的nNO截断值，但作者仍推荐该组合用于筛查，未讨论阈值如何重定；未报告CI，仅给P值；未说明两设备测量是否同期同序进行及顺序效应。信息不足：样本中PCD阳性例数、截断值及验证方式均未交代
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Nasal nitric oxide (nNO) is an established screening tool for primary ciliary dyskinesia (PCD). Customary chemoluminescence-based analyzers preclude widespread screening for PCD. Portable devices with electrochemical sensors have not been clinically validated. OBJECTIVE: To compare test success and nNO levels between a chemoluminescence analyzer (CLD88 sp) and a portable device (NIOX MINO) in clinical routine, and to assess whether a tidal breathing velum-closure (TBVC) method increases test success. METHODS: Measurements were performed in children ≥ 3 years using a conventional single-breath maneuver against an expiratory resistance (ER) for CLD88, and a breath-hold (BH) method for NIOX. TBVC was evaluated for both devices. RESULTS: One hundred and twenty children referred for investigation of respiratory symptoms were included (median age 9.9 years, range 3.1-18.5). For conventional breathing methods, test success increased from preschool age (CLD88 10% and NIOX 3.3%) to adolescence (87.5% and 65%). TBVC increased test success for both devices (preschoolers 80% and 70% vs. adolescents 97.5% and 97.5%; p < 0.001 for all age groups). Median nNO was higher for CLD88 with 263.3 nL/min (ER) and 283.7 nL/min (TBVC) compared to NIOX with 214.5 nL/min (BH) and 208.1 nL/min (TBVC) (p = 0.013 and p < 0.001). CONCLUSION: Test success is low when conventional breathing methods are applied, especially in younger ages, but can be increased by TBVC. Nasal NO levels are lower for electrochemical sensor devices compared to chemoluminescence analyzers with no difference between conventional and TBVC methods. These findings support using portable analyzers with TBVC as a promising tool to screen-out PCD.

papers.study_type: 临床前机制研究 · 小鼠博来霉素模型联合人IPF/SSc-ILD移植肺组织与精密切割肺片的多模型验证
papers.title_zh: 交感神经来源去甲肾上腺素经ADRA1D+效应成纤维细胞促进肺纤维化的机制研究
papers.title_en: Noradrenergic input from sympathetic nerves to fibroblasts regulates lung fibrosis.
papers.authors: Ishikawa G, Ghincea A, Peng X, Shao S, McGovern J, Zielonka J, Jeevanandam A, Woo S et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Internal Medicine, Section of Pulmonary, Critical Care, and Sleep Medicine, School of Medicine, Yale Unive…
papers.authors_conclusion: These studies show that a fibrogenic unit comprising sympathetic nerve-derived noradrenaline and ADRA1D+ effector fibroblasts promotes lung fibrosis in disease-relevant modeling systems. Strategies targeting sympathetic innervation or α1-adrenoreceptors may provide previously unrecognized therapeutic opportunities in IPF, SSc-ILD, and related fibrotic conditions.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要全文无任何定量结果（无效应量、CI、P值或样本量），仅有定性描述（enhanced、mitigated、suppressed），无法评估效应大小与统计稳健性；结论主要基于博来霉素小鼠模型，人类数据为观察性（免疫荧光与单细胞RNA测序二次分析），缺乏人体干预证据；单细胞测序为二次分析，disease-specific programs的具体指标未报告。
papers.abstract_en: Pulmonary fibrosis is a progressive, irreversible condition in which expansion of effector fibroblasts and extracellular matrix obliterates alveolar gas exchange regions of the lung through incompletely understood mechanisms. We found sympathetic nerve fibers in fibrotic alveolar regions enriched for alpha-smooth muscle actin-positive (α-SMA+) effector fibroblasts and noradrenaline by applying optical clearing and whole-lung imaging to the bleomycin mouse model of lung fibrosis and multichannel immunofluorescence to explanted lung tissues from patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) or systemic sclerosis-associated interstitial lung disease (SSc-ILD). Human lung fibroblasts cultured with sympathetic nerves displayed enhanced production of fibrotic markers, and sympathetic nerve-specific deletion of the nerve growth factor receptor neurotrophic receptor tyrosine kinase 1 mitigated bleomycin-induced lung fibrosis in mice. Pharmacologic inhibition of noradrenaline receptors, including α1-adrenoreceptors, mitigated collagen accumulation and pathologic remodeling in bleomycin-challenged mice and in human precision-cut lung slices. Accumulation of α-SMA+ effector fibroblasts expressing α1-adrenoreceptor subtype D (ADRA1D) was observed in fibrotic mouse lungs and in explanted lung tissues from patients with IPF or SSc-ILD. Therapeutic deletion of Adra1d in α-SMA+ effector fibroblasts suppressed fibrosis in the bleomycin model. Secondary analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing datasets from IPF or SSc-ILD lung explants revealed α1-adrenoreceptor antagonist-responsive, disease-specific programs in effector fibroblasts. Together, these studies show that a fibrogenic unit comprising sympathetic nerve-derived noradrenaline and ADRA1D+ effector fibroblasts promotes lung fibrosis in disease-relevant modeling systems. Strategies targeting sympathetic innervation or α1-adrenoreceptors may provide previously unrecognized therapeutic opportunities in IPF, SSc-ILD, and related fibrotic conditions.

papers.study_type: 伞状综述（系统综述的系统综述）· AMSTAR-2质量评价与九类生物标志物证据定量优先级排序
papers.title_zh: 结核病生物标志物检测、进展预测与治疗优化的伞状综述：无任何标志物持续达到WHO目标产品档案准确性阈值
papers.title_en: Biomarkers for tuberculosis detection, progression, and treatment optimisation: an umbrella review of systematic reviews.
papers.authors: Mann T, Greenan-Barrett J, Wright S, Steward E, Nguyen TM, Aung KM, Duong L, Fama F et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: University of Warwick, Coventry, UK.
papers.authors_conclusion: Across all use cases, no biomarkers consistently met WHO target product profile accuracy thresholds. Most primary studies were at high risk of selection bias, and accuracy estimates varied widely. Prospective head-to-head studies in representative populations are needed to determine which biomarkers have potential to improve individual and public health outcomes.
papers.ai_note: 总体为阴性结论（无标志物达标），但摘要同时以'证据最强'突出宿主转录组等方向，属对阴性总判断的选择性弱化强调；仅叙述性综合，摘要未报告任何具体敏感度/特异度、AUC或预测值数值，亦无合并效应量与CI，无法评估各标志物的实际性能差距；排除仅限WHO已认可检测的综述，削弱了与现有标准检测的直接对比；多数原始研究高选择偏倚风险提示底层证据确定性低，'证据最强'的表述应谨慎对待；信息不足：未说明九类标志物各自的证据量与达标差距。
papers.abstract_en: Numerous tuberculosis biomarkers have been described, but evidence supporting their use remains fragmented. We conducted an umbrella review of systematic reviews on host-derived and pathogen-derived biomarkers for three tuberculosis use-cases: detection of disease, prediction of progression to disease, and treatment monitoring and optimisation. We searched MEDLINE, Web of Science, Global Index Medicus, and the Cochrane Library from inception to Sept 1, 2025, excluding reviews confined to WHO-endorsed tests for approved use cases. We appraised the quality of reviews using an adapted version of AMSTAR-2, extracted assessments of risk of bias in primary studies, synthesised evidence narratively across nine biomarker classes, and applied a quantitative prioritisation framework. We included 46 reviews: 40 on detection, seven on progression, and six on treatment monitoring. Some reviews addressed more than one use case. For detection, evidence was strongest for host proteins, host transcriptomics, and pathogen antigens; for progression, evidence was strongest for host transcriptomics, particularly for short-term risk prediction. For treatment monitoring, evidence for predicting clinical outcomes was scarce. Across all use cases, no biomarkers consistently met WHO target product profile accuracy thresholds. Most primary studies were at high risk of selection bias, and accuracy estimates varied widely. Prospective head-to-head studies in representative populations are needed to determine which biomarkers have potential to improve individual and public health outcomes.

papers.study_type: 基于登记数据的观察性目标试验模拟（clone-censor-weight + 滚动地标分析）· 巴西2013–2023年17.1万人队列
papers.title_zh: 巴西圣保罗州结核治疗期间失访与5年死亡率：目标试验模拟显示失访使标准化5年死亡率绝对增加2.49个百分点
papers.title_en: Loss to follow-up during tuberculosis treatment and 5-year mortality in Brazil: A target trial emulation.
papers.authors: Lepka de Lima E, Lindoso AA, Orlandi GM, Fukasava S, Martinez C, Croda J, Horsburgh CR, Ranzani O et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Epidemiology, Boston University School of Public Health, Boston, Massachusetts, United States of America.
papers.authors_conclusion: 尽管DOT覆盖率高，治疗前6个月内脱离结核治疗仍很常见，并在所设定的识别假设下增加了5年死亡率，且超额死亡集中归因于结核死亡；应测试贯穿全程治疗的支持性干预在维持治疗参与和降低死亡率方面的效果
papers.ai_note: 属观察性目标试验模拟而非干预试验，识别依赖无未测混杂假设；作者自述登记缺失影像学病变范围、菌量等严重程度指标，残余混杂不能排除；死亡归因依赖死因登记，结核占61%的归因可能存在误分类，信息不足；失访定义为中断≥30天且要求个体存活至被记录为脱离，仍存在生存/时间零偏倚的残余影响，信息不足；摘要未说明主要终点与主要估计量是否预先设定，信息不足；结论末尾的干预建议为外推，本研究并未评估任何干预效果
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Loss to follow-up (LTFU) during tuberculosis treatment is a major programmatic gap, but how much excess mortality it causes has been difficult to estimate, because individuals who disengage differ from those who do not, and they must survive long enough to be recorded as having disengaged. Quantifying this excess and identifying which populations are at greatest risk are critical to informing program design and resource allocation. METHODS AND FINDINGS: We followed 171,048 people aged 15 years or older starting a first course of tuberculosis treatment in São Paulo State, Brazil, between 2013 and 2023, linking surveillance and mortality registries; 20,830 (12.2%) were LTFU, defined as interruption of treatment for at least 30 consecutive days. Among those LTFU, 65% had received directly observed therapy (DOT). Using a clone-censor-weight target trial emulation, we contrasted two strategies over 60 months from the first day of treatment: disengagement at any point during the first 6 months and remaining in care throughout. Analyses were adjusted for age, sex, race, education, HIV status, diabetes, alcohol use, drug use, incarceration, homelessness, hospitalization at diagnosis, clinical form of tuberculosis, DOT, and municipality. A rolling landmark analysis addressed the timing of disengagement and cause-specific mortality excess. LTFU increased standardized 5-year mortality by 2.49 percentage points (95% CI [1.94, 3.17]). In a rolling landmark analysis, tuberculosis accounted for 61% of the 5-year excess mortality. Relative effects were largest in younger, stably housed individuals, whose baseline mortality was low; the largest absolute excess fell on people living with HIV (5.16 percentage points, 95% CI [3.76, 6.60]). The excess was similar for disengagement at any point in the first 4 months of treatment and attenuated thereafter. Limitations include the absence from the registry of severity markers such as radiographic extent and bacillary load, so residual confounding cannot be excluded. CONCLUSIONS: Despite high DOT coverage, disengagement during the first 6 months of tuberculosis treatment was common and increased 5-year mortality under the stated identification assumptions, with the excess concentrated in deaths attributed to tuberculosis. Interventions that provide support throughout treatment should be tested for their effectiveness in sustaining engagement and reducing mortality.

papers.title_zh: 2015–24年肠道病毒D68全球流行病学与基因演化系统综述：持续广泛传播、每偶数年流行及基因型更替

papers.authors: Hirvonen A, Hodcroft EB, Johannesen CK, Fischer TK, Harvala H, Benschop KSM
papers.affiliation_highlight: National PhD Programme in One Health approaches to infectious diseases and life science research, Department of Public H…

papers.abstract_en: Enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) is a persistent global health concern, causing mild to severe respiratory disease and, in rare cases, acute flaccid myelitis, a polio-like paralytic syndrome. In this systematic review, we synthesised global data on the epidemiology and genetic evolution of EV-D68 from 2015 to 2024 and show its continued widespread circulation and concerning severity. 8184 EV-D68 cases were reported by 44 countries, and 267 (3·3%) of these cases were EV-D68-associated acute flaccid paralysis cases reported by 26 countries, across all continents. Biennial upsurges followed a distinct every-even-year pattern until 2020, after which the circulation showed geographical diversification in Europe and North America, possibly influenced by the COVID-19 pandemic. EV-D68 remained associated with severe respiratory disease and acute flaccid myelitis, not only primarily in children younger than five years but also increasingly in adults. Individuals who progressed to acute flaccid paralysis had poor prognosis for full recovery. Genotypic shifts were marked by the dominance of subgenotype B3 since 2016 and A2/D since 2018, with novel variants emerging for both after 2020. Despite limitations in surveillance quality and coverage, the findings underscore the need for sustained surveillance, improved diagnostic strategies, and targeted interventions to mitigate EV-D68-related morbidity.

papers.abstract_en: Cystic Fibrosis (CF) diagnosis relies on quantitative sweat chloride testing, a process that requires highly trained personnel, bulky instrumentation, and a cumbersome workflow performed at specialized clinical centers with high per-test cost. Recent advances in wearable sweat biomarker sensors offer opportunities for the development of point-of-care CF sweat chloride analysis. This work presents a flexible, wearable platform for sweat chloride testing, based on miniaturized, automated iontophoresis stimulation, microfluidic sweat collection, and colorimetric chloride analysis. This system enables quantitative, visually interpretable chloride measurements without external instrumentation, requires only microliters of sweat to operate, and reduces the per-test cost to around 1 dollar. Clinical evaluation of the device with 55 subjects at a single pediatric CF center demonstrates strong agreement between chloride concentrations from standard-of-care sweat testing and this platform, with reliable operation across physiologically relevant chloride concentrations. This platform provides a practical, scalable alternative for CF diagnosis in a range of clinical settings with potential for use in the home.

papers.abstract_en: RATIONALE: Persistent lung infection by nontuberculous mycobacteria (NTM) is a prerequisite for progression to NTM pulmonary disease, a serious clinical outcome for people with cystic fibrosis (PwCF). Understanding risk factors for persistent infection will improve patient care. OBJECTIVES: We sought to identify genomic loci associated with persistent lung infection by Mycobacterium avium and Mycobacterium abscessus complexes in PwCF. METHODS: We performed genome-wide association studies of persistent NTM infection in PwCF enrolled in the CF Genome Project, as well as several secondary studies to assess test sensitivity. Persistent NTM airway infection was defined as two positive sputum cultures within three years, and two NTM species complexes were independently tested as primary outcomes. MEASUREMENTS: The primary genome-wide association study included whole genome sequencing data for 2,068 participants with NTM culture data who met demographic inclusion criteria. Persistent infection by Mycobacterium avium complex and Mycobacterium abscessus complex were the primary outcomes of study. MAIN RESULTS: A significant association signal was observed for each primary outcome. The genotype of a locus near ICOS (p = 8.48 x 10-9) was associated with persistent Mycobacterium avium complex infection, while the genotype of a locus overlapping ASB13 (p = 2.19 x 10-9) was associated with persistent Mycobacterium abscessus infection. CONCLUSIONS: The detection of associations between specific genomic loci and persistent NTM airway infections allows for better assessment of individual risk in PwCF, guides surveillance intensity, provides clues regarding underlying biology of infection, and identifies pathways that may be targeted by therapeutics.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Pulmonary nodules are common in ANCA-associated vasculitis (AAV), but their clinical relevance remains unclear. This study assessed the influence of pulmonary nodules and radiological features on clinical characteristics and outcomes in AAV. METHODS: In this multicenter retrospective cohort, clinical features and outcomes were compared between nodule-positive and nodule-negative AAV patients. Pulmonary nodules were classified as cavitary or non-cavitary, and their morphology and regression were evaluated on serial CT scans at diagnosis, 6 months, and last follow-up. Among patients with pulmonary nodules, radiological regression rates were compared according to cavitary and non-cavitary nodule status. Associations between radiological parameters, inflammatory markers, and radiological outcomes were evaluated using correlation analyses. RESULTS: Among 342 patients, 100 had pulmonary nodules at diagnosis (51 cavitary, 49 non-cavitary). Patients presenting with pulmonary nodules at diagnosis more likely to have lower baseline proteinuria, a higher prevalence of pleural effusion, and an increased risk of pulmonary nodule relapse (p = 0.043, p = 0.022, and p < 0.001, respectively). Radiological regression rates did not differ between cavitary and non-cavitary nodules at 6 months or last control. Moreover, smaller cavitary nodule diameter, a lower necrosis ratio, and fewer cavitary nodules were associated with a higher rate of complete radiological regression at 6 months (p = 0.016, p < 0.001, and p = 0.046, respectively). Larger cavitary nodule diameter and increased wall thickness correlated with elevated CRP levels (p = 0.001, r = 0.452 and p = 0.018, r = 0.340, respectively). CONCLUSION: In AAV, cavity size and wall thickness were associated with systemic inflammation. A lower necrosis ratio, smaller cavity diameter, and fewer cavitary nodules were associated with favorable radiological outcomes. These exploratory findings require prospective validation using standardized CT protocols.

papers.authors: Qi S, Zhou X, Liu C, Zhou Q
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Oncology, Zhuzhou Hospital Affiliated to Xiangya School of Medicine, Central South University, Zhuzhou, Ch…
papers.authors_conclusion: 作者提出可检验的空间免疫韧性框架（eradication-permissive、persistence-prone、escape-permissive 三类生态系统）；并认为空间 profiling 仅靠最大分子分辨率不太可能改变围术期诊疗，其临床价值将取决于可重复、简约、能在分期、病理与分子残留病之外改善决策的测量。

papers.abstract_en: Perioperative immune-checkpoint blockade has improved pathological and event-free outcomes in resectable non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC), but benefit remains heterogeneous and current biomarkers do not reliably distinguish tumor eradication from transient control or future relapse. This limitation partly reflects how tumors are measured: programed death ligand 1 expression, tumor mutational burden and bulk immune-cell abundance compress a spatially organized ecosystem into summary values. Here, we define the spatial immune geography of resectable NSCLC across four coupled scales: intratumor territories, cellular neighborhoods, regional immune structures-including tertiary lymphoid structures and tumor-draining lymph nodes-and longitudinal transitions from pretreatment biopsy to resection, molecular residual disease and recurrence. We critically synthesize human evidence linking T-cell access, antigen-presentation circuits, B-cell and tertiary-lymphoid organization, and stromal, myeloid and hypoxic niches to perioperative immunotherapy response. We further distinguish pretreatment predictors from treatment-induced pharmacodynamic changes and explain why pathological response and biological cure are related but non-equivalent endpoints. On this basis, we propose a testable spatial-immune-resilience framework comprising eradication-permissive, persistence-prone and escape-permissive ecosystems. We also evaluate how multiplex imaging, spatial transcriptomics, digital spatial profiling, anatomically registered single-cell analysis and computational pathology differ in biological reach and translational readiness. Finally, we outline an assay-to-decision validation pathway that integrates standardized multiregion tissue sampling, tumor-draining lymph nodes and circulating tumor DNA. Spatial profiling is unlikely to transform perioperative care through maximal molecular resolution alone; its clinical value will depend on reproducible, parsimonious measurements that improve decisions beyond stage, pathology and molecular residual disease.

papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: Hospital readmission after acute exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (AECOPD) remains a clinical challenge. Patients meeting eosinophilic criteria may exhibit distinct clinical characteristics; however, predictors of readmission in this subgroup are not well established. This study aimed to identify factors associated with 90-day readmission in AECOPD patients meeting eosinophilic criteria and to develop a preliminary prediction model. PATIENTS AND METHODS: This single-center retrospective cohort included 157 patients with AECOPD meeting eosinophilic criteria. Baseline demographics, prior exacerbation history, in-hospital characteristics, and laboratory findings were collected. The primary outcome was unplanned 90-day readmission. Univariate and Firth's penalized multivariable logistic regression were used, and a preliminary prediction model was developed with internal bootstrap validation. RESULTS: In the multivariable Firth's penalized logistic regression model, prior-year exacerbation frequency (≥2 vs <2 hospitalizations) was strongly associated with 90-day readmission (OR 42.15, 95% CI 13.54-172.77, P < 0.001). High-flow nasal cannula oxygen therapy (HFNC) (OR 7.18, 95% CI 1.39-36.80, P = 0.019) and log-transformed procalcitonin (per 1-unit increase in ln(PCT); OR 5.16, 95% CI 2.03-16.36, P < 0.001) were also significantly associated with readmission. The model showed promising discrimination, with an apparent AUC of 0.914 and a bootstrap-corrected AUC of 0.909 (mean optimism 0.005). The full model demonstrated significantly better discrimination than prior-year exacerbation frequency alone (AUC 0.914 vs 0.824; DeLong test P < 0.001). Calibration was acceptable in the intermediate-risk range, although slight deviation was observed at low predicted probabilities. CONCLUSION: In patients with AECOPD meeting eosinophilic criteria, prior-year hospitalized exacerbations were associated with 90-day readmission. The preliminary prediction model showed promising discrimination, but these findings are exploratory and require external validation. Future studies may explore whether incorporating exacerbation history into risk stratification can facilitate early identification of high-risk patients.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Asthma is common in women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS), and several plausible shared mechanisms may link the conditions, including metabolic dysfunction, systemic inflammation and hormonal pathways. We conducted a systematic review to synthesise the evidence, quantify any association, assess lung function data and identify gaps for future studies. METHODS: We searched Ovid MEDLINE, Ovid Embase, Cochrane Library, Web of Science Core Collection in April 2026. We included observational studies reporting asthma prevalence or lung function in women with PCOS. Crude and adjusted effect estimates were pooled separately using random-effects model meta-analyses. Heterogeneity was assessed using I2 and τ2 statistics. Quality assessment was conducted using the Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tools. RESULTS: 13 studies (including over 28 million women, 11 cross-sectional and 2 longitudinal) were included. Of these, eight were assessed as moderate or high risk of bias. Meta-analyses showed that PCOS was associated with a higher odds of asthma in both crude (OR 1.59, 95% CI 1.44 to 1.76, I²=72.0%, τ²=0.009) and adjusted analyses (OR 1.57, 95% CI 1.40 to 1.77, I²=90.6%, τ²=0.007). The associations were not substantially different by PCOS or asthma ascertainment method. Only two lung function studies showed conflicting results. CONCLUSIONS: PCOS appeared to be associated with asthma but this was driven by findings from cross-sectional studies which are at risk of reverse causation. Lung function evidence remains inconclusive. Future studies should prioritise standardised methods and longitudinal designs to establish temporality.

papers.abstract_en: Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) is a common cause of acute hypoxemic respiratory failure in patients with pneumonia, sepsis, aspiration of gastric contents, severe trauma, or other inciting triggers. Although the definition of the syndrome has evolved over the past several decades, the core elements (acute onset, hypoxemia, and bilateral radiographic opacities) remain consistent. Critical components of management include identification and treatment of the underlying cause of ARDS as well as avoidance of ventilator-induced lung injury and volume overload. Ongoing areas of controversy include the best strategy for supporting nonintubated patients, personalization of positive end-expiratory pressure, the role of innovative ventilatory strategies, and the use of glucocorticoids. New research suggests that precision medicine approaches to ARDS management that focus on discrete biologic, radiographic, or physiological subphenotypes may improve outcomes, and prospective trials of these approaches are ongoing.

papers.authors: Shao W, Zhao P, Tan Y, Tian L, Wang X, Li H, Liu H
papers.affiliation_highlight: College of Basic Medicine, Changchun University of Chinese Medicine, Changchun, Jilin, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: Anlotinib potentiates the synthetic lethality of talazoparib in drug-resistant SCLC by suppressing E2F8-mediated RAD51 transcription, impairing homologous recombination repair, and inducing persistent DNA damage, while concurrently activating STING-dependent innate immunity. This dual mechanism provides a strong preclinical rationale for combining PARP inhibitors with anlotinib in relapsed SCLC, highlights E2F8/RAD51 as candidate biomarkers warranting further clinical validation, and supports future triplet regimens incorporating immune checkpoint inhibitors.
papers.ai_note: 摘要全程无任何量化数值（无协同指数/CI、无IC50、无肿瘤体积或生长抑制率、无P值或CI、无样本量与统计方法），'协同''显著增加'等表述无法核验；'synergistic'结论未报告协同评价方法（如ZIP/Loewe）；免疫激活仅见于MCT模型的流式表型描述，缺乏功能性抗肿瘤免疫证据；结论外推至含免疫检查剂的三联方案及复发SCLC临床应用，超出本研究数据范围；无安全性、药代相互作用与耐药选择压力评估；信息不足以判断该机制在人体是否成立
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Small cell lung cancer (SCLC) is an aggressive neuroendocrine malignancy that almost invariably acquires resistance to first-line platinum-based chemotherapy, leading to early relapse. PARP inhibitors (PARPi) hold theoretical potential for SCLC due to universal TP53/RB1 deletion, but their monotherapy activity has limited efficacy in unselected relapsed patients. Anlotinib-a multi-target tyrosine kinase inhibitor-has recently been implicated in modulating DNA damage repair, raising the possibility of synergistic interaction with PARPi. However, the molecular basis of such synergy remains entirely unexplored. METHODS: Cisplatin-resistant SCLC cell models were established and characterized. A potent PARPi was screened, and the synergistic antitumor effects of talazoparib combined with anlotinib were evaluated via in vitro functional assays, multicellular tumor spheroid (MCT), and in vivo xenograft. Mechanisms were explored through transcriptomic, dual-luciferase reporter, rescue experiments, and immunohistochemical validation. RESULTS: The combination synergistically suppressed cell viability, anchorage-independent colony formation, and tumor growth versus monotherapies. Mechanistically, it significantly downregulated the E2F8 which was identified as a direct transcriptional activator of RAD51, as luciferase reporter assays showing that E2F8 overexpression increased wild-type RAD51 promoter activity. Rescue experiments demonstrated that E2F8 overexpression restored HR repair and reduced γ-H2AX levels in combination-treated cells. Furthermore, the combination activated the STING-TBK1-IRF3-IFNβ innate immune pathway and, in the MCT, significantly increased CD8+ cytotoxic T cells, CD45+HLA-DR+ activated immune cells and CD4+ helper T cells. CONCLUSION: Anlotinib potentiates the synthetic lethality of talazoparib in drug-resistant SCLC by suppressing E2F8-mediated RAD51 transcription, impairing homologous recombination repair, and inducing persistent DNA damage, while concurrently activating STING-dependent innate immunity. This dual mechanism provides a strong preclinical rationale for combining PARP inhibitors with anlotinib in relapsed SCLC, highlights E2F8/RAD51 as candidate biomarkers warranting further clinical validation, and supports future triplet regimens incorporating immune checkpoint inhibitors.

papers.title_zh: Effectiveness of a standardised cleaning protocol to prevent malignant cell contamination during EBUS-TBNA: Results from a European multicentre study.
papers.title_en: Effectiveness of a standardised cleaning protocol to prevent malignant cell contamination during EBUS-TBNA: Results from a European multicentre study.
papers.authors: Bugalho A, Szlubowski A, Rozman A, Eberhardt R, Sequeira T, Mechsner M, Gnass M, Primozic MP et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Pulmonology Department, CUF Tejo Hospital, Lisbon, Portugal.
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Endobronchial ultrasound (EBUS) and transoesophageal ultrasound with a bronchoscope (EUS-B) are key techniques for mediastinal staging in lung cancer. The 9th TNM classification underscores the prognostic importance of accurate station-specific nodal assessment. However, the optimal sampling strategy remains uncertain, particularly regarding needle reuse between N2 stations due to the risk of cross-contamination. METHODS: We conducted a prospective multicentre study including patients undergoing EBUS and/or EUS-B for diagnosis or staging of lung cancer or metastatic disease. A standardised transbronchial needle aspiration (TBNA) cleaning protocol was evaluated. The primary endpoint was the absence of malignant cells in post-cleaning needle rinse samples. RESULTS: Of 164 enrolled patients, 162 were included in the final analysis, comprising 270 sampled targets, with malignancy confirmed in 76.3%. The mean cleaning time was 148.8 ± 40.9 seconds per target, and the needle was visually assessed as clean in 89.3% of cases. Among malignant cases, post-cleaning needle rinse samples were negative for malignant cells in 92.2% and positive or suspicious in 7.8%. No clinical or procedural variables were associated with cleaning failure. Visual assessment of needle cleanliness did not correlate with cytological findings. No complications were observed. CONCLUSION: A standardised needle-cleaning protocol is safe and effective in reducing malignant cell contamination during EBUS and EUS-B. However, residual contamination persists in a minority of cases, indicating that needle reuse may carry a small risk of cross-contamination between targets. This approach may represent a pragmatic alternative to routine needle exchange in clinical practice.

papers.authors: Zhou C, Yu W, Li Y, Mao B, Liu W, Jiang H
papers.affiliation_highlight: Division of Pulmonary Medicine, Department of Internal Medicine, Institute of Integrated Traditional Chinese and Western…
papers.authors_conclusion: IAL直接靶向HSC70并促进GPX4降解，在NSCLC细胞中诱导铁死亡；在皮下移植瘤模型中IAL抑制肿瘤生长且HSC70/GPX4变化与该机制一致，所测剂量下无明显毒性。这些发现支持对IAL开展进一步临床前评估
papers.ai_note: 纯临床前研究，无患者数据，临床决策价值有限；体内实验未报告样本量、随机化、盲法、统计方法及肿瘤抑制的定量数值，'显著抑制''无明显毒性'缺乏可核查数据支撑；结论中'no overt toxicity'仅限定于所测剂量，未报告体重、生化指标等安全性数据；药物尚未进入临床转化阶段，信息不足
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Isoalantolactone (IAL), a sesquiterpene lactone derived from Inula helenium L. and Inula racemosa Hook. f., exhibits anti-inflammatory and anticancer properties. This study investigated the effects of IAL against non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). METHODS: The anticancer activity and potential mechanisms of IAL were evaluated in A549 and H1299 cells using CCK-8 proliferation assays, colony formation assays, flow cytometry, and RNA sequencing. The molecular target of IAL was identified through Drug Affinity Responsive Target Stability (DARTS) coupled with mass spectrometry. The binding between IAL and its target, HSC70, was validated by molecular docking and surface plasmon resonance (SPR). The functional role of HSC70 was confirmed via co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) and lentiviral-mediated short hairpin RNA (shRNA) knockdown. In vivo efficacy was evaluated in subcutaneous xenograft models, with IAL administered every other day. RESULTS: IAL directly bound to HSC70 with a dissociation constant (Kd) of 1.07 μM and promoted glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4) degradation. IAL induced hallmark features of ferroptosis, including lipid peroxidation, iron accumulation, glutathione (GSH) depletion, and oxidized glutathione (GSSG) elevation. In vitro, HSC70 knockdown abrogated IAL-induced GPX4 degradation and ferroptosis. In subcutaneous xenograft models, IAL significantly suppressed tumor growth without evident toxicity and was accompanied by HSC70/GPX4 changes consistent with the in vitro mechanism. CONCLUSIONS: IAL directly targets HSC70 and promotes GPX4 degradation, inducing ferroptosis in NSCLC cells. In subcutaneous xenograft models, IAL suppresses tumor growth with HSC70/GPX4 changes consistent with this mechanism and no overt toxicity at the tested doses. These findings support further preclinical evaluation of IAL.

papers.title_zh: 清金得生片联合化疗用于Ⅲ–Ⅳ期NSCLC的回顾性研究：抑制中性粒细胞胞外诱捕网形成及HMGB1/TLR2/MyD88通路机制
papers.title_en: Qingjin Desheng Pian attenuates NSCLC progression by suppressing neutrophil extracellular trap formation: involvement of the HMGB1/TLR2/MyD88 axis.
papers.authors: Qin B, Huang S, Ma C, Zhou R, Zhou D, Tang Y
papers.affiliation_highlight: Guangzhou University of Chinese Medicine, Guangzhou, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: These findings indicate that QJDS attenuates NSCLC progression by suppressing NET formation through mechanisms involving the HMGB1/TLR2/MyD88 axis, supporting its adjuvant application in advanced lung cancer.
papers.ai_note: 主要临床终点PFS仅定性描述为“prolonged”，摘要未给出任何HR、中位数、CI或P值，也未说明质量生活、炎症指标的具体数值与分组差异，信息不足，无法判断效应量与统计学意义；回顾性非随机分组，化疗方案、基线特征与合并用药等混杂未见校正说明；QoL与全身炎症为次要终点，结论实际主要由动物与体外机制实验支撑；联合用药中单药贡献不可分离。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Despite advances in immune checkpoint inhibitor-based therapy, a substantial proportion of patients derive limited benefit. In the tumor microenvironment, neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) promote tumor progression and metastasis, representing a potential therapeutic target. Qingjin Desheng Pian (QJDS) is a standardized hospital preparation of traditional Chinese medicine that has been used clinically for primary and metastatic lung cancer. Although earlier studies have suggested antitumor effects of QJDS, its impact on NET formation and the underlying mechanisms in NSCLC remain unclear. This study aimed to investigate whether QJDS suppresses NET formation and to elucidate the molecular mechanisms. METHODS: This retrospective study included 209 stage III-IV NSCLC patients who received QJDS plus chemotherapy or chemotherapy alone. NET enrichment was assessed by single-cell RNA sequencing and histopathology. Network pharmacology predicted potential targets. A syngeneic Lewis lung carcinoma model evaluated antitumor efficacy and intratumoral NET levels. In vitro, primary mouse neutrophils were stimulated with phorbol 12-myristate 13-acetate (PMA) for NET induction, followed by QJDS intervention. Transcriptomic sequencing and weighted gene co-expression network analysis identified hub genes. Pharmacological rescue experiments using N4-acetylcytidine (N4A) were performed. RESULTS: QJDS prolonged progression-free survival, improved quality of life, and attenuated systemic inflammation. NETs were markedly enriched in NSCLC tumor tissues compared with adjacent tissues. QJDS dose-dependently inhibited tumor growth and reduced intratumoral NET formation and serum MPO-DNA levels in vivo. In vitro, QJDS suppressed NET release and attenuated NET-mediated migration, invasion, epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT), and proliferation of lung cancer cells. Mechanistically, high mobility group box 1 (HMGB1) was identified as a key hub gene through transcriptomic and weighted gene co-expression network analyses. QJDS significantly downregulated HMGB1, toll-like receptor 2 (TLR2), and myeloid differentiation primary response 88 (MyD88) expression in neutrophils, effects partially reversed by N4A. CONCLUSION: These findings indicate that QJDS attenuates NSCLC progression by suppressing NET formation through mechanisms involving the HMGB1/TLR2/MyD88 axis, supporting its adjuvant application in advanced lung cancer.

papers.study_type: 叙述性/机制综述（无系统检索与定量合成），综合临床数据与临床前机制提出假设性风险模型
papers.category_label: 局晚期与晚期靶向/免疫
papers.title_zh: ADC相关间质性肺病的分子基础：结构决定因素、致病通路与 mitigation 策略（叙述性综述，提出基于T-DXd数据的三维结构风险模型）
papers.title_en: Unraveling the molecular basis of ADC-related interstitial lung disease: from structural determinants to pathogenic pathways and mitigation strategies.
papers.authors: Wang Y, Xiao Q
papers.affiliation_highlight: Second Clinical Medical College, Nanjing Medical University, Nanjing, Jiangsu, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: This review establishes a conceptual basis for safer ADC development and better clinical risk stratification, framing ILD as a potentially predictable and structure-modulated toxicity, rather than an entirely idiosyncratic adverse event; it proposes a multidimensional risk model and a "safety-by-design" approach for next-generation ADC engineering, while emphasizing that the FcγR-macrophage-SPP1 axis remains predominantly supported by murine and in vitro data and its generalization across all ADC constructs and validation in human pulmonary tissue require further investigation.
papers.ai_note: 叙述性综述，摘要未说明检索策略、纳入标准或证据分级，发生率范围（<1%至>15%）未给出具体药物、队列与出处，无法核对；三维风险模型与FcγR-巨噬细胞-SPP1轴主要依据T-DXd单一药物的小鼠与体外数据外推，作者已自陈人群外推与人肺组织验证不足；结论中“可预测、结构可调控的毒性”属概念性主张，尚无人体前瞻验证；属假说生成而非证据合成。
papers.abstract_en: Despite being a revolutionary class of precision oncology therapeutics, antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) face growing restrictions on clinical application due to one of their most significant and life-threatening side effects-interstitial lung disease (ILD). The incidence of ADC-related ILD (ADC-ILD) exhibits marked heterogeneity across agents (less than 1% to more than 15%), indicating that this toxicity is not a general class effect, but rather fundamentally linked to the molecular structure of individual ADC molecules. This review synthesizes the association of structural elements of ADCs (linker chemistry, properties of payload, drug-to-antibody ratio (DAR), and target selection) with the risk of ILD, based on clinical data and insights into the mechanism. We propose a multidimensional risk model, informed primarily by trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) mechanistic studies, wherein pulmonary toxicity may arise from the convergence of three structural liabilities: cleavable linkers, high DAR, and membrane-permeable payloads. From a mechanistic standpoint, evidence from preclinical models, particularly T-DXd-related studies, suggests that important events in ADC- ILD may involve target-independent processes, including Fcγ receptor-mediated sequestration of intact ADCs by alveolar macrophages, subsequent liberation of the payload into lysosomes, and bystander injury to alveolar epithelial cells; this cascade may trigger inflammatory amplification via the upregulation of secreted phosphoprotein 1 (SPP1) and contribute to fibrotic remodeling. This mechanistic paradigm supports a "safety-by-design" approach for the next-generation of ADC engineering, including Fc optimization, linker stabilization, payload permeability rationalization, and DAR optimization; this review establishes a conceptual basis for safer ADC development and better clinical risk stratification, framing ILD as a potentially predictable and structure-modulated toxicity, rather than an entirely idiosyncratic adverse event. It must be emphasized that the proposed FcγR-macrophage-SPP1 axis remains predominantly supported by murine and in vitro data, and its generalization across all ADC constructs and validation in human pulmonary tissue require further investigation.

papers.study_type: 全省出院摘要数据库回顾性观察性研究（Elastic-net筛选诊断编码对 + 患者聚类GEE估计费用关联）

papers.title_zh: 四川省肺癌住院患者诊断编码共现模式及其与住院费用的关联：基于13.4万例患者的全省出院数据库回顾性分析
papers.title_en: Diagnosis-code co-occurrence patterns and their associations with hospitalization costs among patients with lung cancer: a province-wide retrospective study in Sichuan, China.
papers.authors: Zeng L, Jin M, Wen J, Gu T
papers.affiliation_highlight: Business School, Sichuan University, Chengdu, Sichuan, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: Diagnosis-code pairs differed substantially in both how frequently they occurred and their associations with hospitalization costs. Joint consideration of these two dimensions identified recurrent patterns with distinct frequency-cost profiles. These findings show how routinely collected discharge data can be used to distinguish cost-relevant patterns of diagnostic complexity in hospitalized patients with lung cancer.
papers.ai_note: 1) 摘要未报告任何单个编码对的95%CI或P值，仅给出FDR后'显著'的计数与成本比范围，精确度信息不足；2) 成本比下限低至1.022，且未报告绝对费用金额，临床与卫生经济意义是否实质存疑；3) 编码对由某次'最新一次符合条件住院'经Elastic-net筛选后，又在包含该次住院的全部住院数据中估计关联，特征选择与效应估计未完全独立，可能存在乐观偏倚，且无外部验证队列；4) '调整后'的调整协变量在摘要中未说明，信息不足；未测量的病情严重度、编码强度/过度编码等因素可能混杂编码共现与费用的关联；5) 结论落点为'可用于区分费用相关的诊断复杂度模式'，属于方法学/资源管理层面的展示，并未验证任何临床干预或决策效果。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Hospitalized patients with lung cancer often have complex diagnosis records, yet conventional comorbidity measures provide limited information on which specific diagnosis-code combinations are associated with differences in hospitalization costs. We examined diagnosis-code co-occurrence patterns and their associations with hospitalization costs in patients with lung cancer. METHODS: We analyzed de-identified records from the province-wide hospital discharge abstract database of Sichuan Province, China, from January 2016 to December 2024. Diagnoses were standardized to three-character categories of the International Classification of Diseases, 10th Revision (ICD-10). Elastic-net regression was used to select core diagnosis-code pairs associated with hospitalization cost based on each patient's latest eligible admission. A weighted co-occurrence network was then constructed from the selected pairs. Their adjusted cost associations were estimated across all eligible admissions using patient-clustered generalized estimating equations. Pairs with significant positive associations were further classified according to patient-level co-occurrence frequency and the magnitude of their cost associations. RESULTS: The study included 133,977 patients and 199,740 hospitalizations. Elastic-net regression selected 88 core diagnosis-code pairs, which formed a network of 49 nodes and five communities. After false discovery rate correction, 69 pairs were significantly associated with hospitalization costs, including 59 positive and 10 negative associations. Adjusted cost ratios for positively associated pairs ranged from 1.022 to 1.659. Of the 59 positively associated pairs, 9 were classified in the higher-frequency/larger-cost-association region, 21 in the lower-frequency/larger-cost-association region, 21 in the higher-frequency/smaller-cost-association region, and 8 in the lower-frequency/smaller-cost-association region. CONCLUSION: Diagnosis-code pairs differed substantially in both how frequently they occurred and their associations with hospitalization costs. Joint consideration of these two dimensions identified recurrent patterns with distinct frequency-cost profiles. These findings show how routinely collected discharge data can be used to distinguish cost-relevant patterns of diagnostic complexity in hospitalized patients with lung cancer.

papers.title_zh: 重氧酯单用及联合奥昔布宁对阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停患者次晨清醒脑电定量指标无显著影响

papers.authors: Tan CJE, Altree TJ, D'Rozario AL, Eckert DJ, Vakulin A
papers.affiliation_highlight: National Healthcare Group, Singapore, Singapore.
papers.authors_conclusion: Reboxetine with and without oxybutynin did not increase neurophysiological markers of next-day morning sleepiness as measured by wake delta and theta EEG power. These findings support the potential safety profile of these agents in respect to next-day sleepiness in people with OSA.
papers.ai_note: 样本量仅16例的二次分析，未报告效能估算，阴性结果可能为检验效能不足所致，无法等同于确证无效应；摘要未给出治疗主效应的具体估计值、CI或确切P值，仅述'无显著'，信息不足；主要终点（qEEG治疗效应）为阴性，结论转向'安全性支持'属于由阴性推论安全性，属替代性表述；研究对象为OSA药物治疗，与胸部肿瘤/胸外科核心业务关联有限
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVE: Recent studies of noradrenergic and antimuscarinic agents to treat obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) have been promising, but their impact on subjective and objective sleep quality and daytime sleepiness have shown inconsistent results. This study aimed to assess the effects of the noradrenergic agent reboxetine alone and in combination with the antimuscarinic oxybutynin on next-day objective sleepiness through quantitative analysis of wake electroencephalography (qEEG) during a Karolinska Drowsiness Test (KDT). METHODS: This was a secondary analysis from a randomised trial of reboxetine alone and in combination with oxybutynin versus placebo in 16 participants with OSA. All participates have undergone a KDT in the evening prior to drug or placebo administration and sleep opportunity, and ∼1hr post-waking next morning. Mixed models were used to examine drug effects on qEEG outcomes. RESULTS: There was no significant main effect of treatment (Reboxetine vs placebo vs Reboxetine-Oxybutynin) on slow EEG frequencies or theta/alpha ratio during the morning KDT. There was a significant main effect of testing time (evening vs morning) with higher morning delta and theta EEG power during eyes open and the delta power during entire KDT (all p < 0.001) compared to the evening test. There was a significant main effect of electrode position (F3, C3, O1), on wake delta and theta EEG with both frequencies higher in frontal (F3) vs occipital regions (O1) (all p < 0.001). There were no interaction effects and no correlations between qEEG outcomes and morning subjective sleepiness. CONCLUSION: Reboxetine with and without oxybutynin did not increase neurophysiological markers of next-day morning sleepiness as measured by wake delta and theta EEG power. These findings support the potential safety profile of these agents in respect to next-day sleepiness in people with OSA.

papers.study_type: 研究类型待评定（启发式模式）
papers.title_zh: Endoplasmic reticulum stress promotes ferroptosis in ventilator-induced lung injury by promoting HRD1-dependent GPX4 ubiquitination via the IRE1α/XBP1 pathway.
papers.title_en: Endoplasmic reticulum stress promotes ferroptosis in ventilator-induced lung injury by promoting HRD1-dependent GPX4 ubiquitination via the IRE1α/XBP1 pathway.
papers.authors: Jiang Y, Ling M, Huang C, Ji L, Lin J, Ou H, Xiao Y, Lu K et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Anesthesiology, Guangxi Medical University Cancer Hospital, Liang Yu Road No.50, Nanning, Guangxi Zhuang A…
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Ventilator-induced lung injury (VILI) is a serious complication of mechanical ventilation. Endoplasmic reticulum stress (ERS) has been implicated in regulating ferroptosis, and we previously linked ERS to VILI-associated inflammation. However, how ERS mechanistically drives ferroptosis during VILI remains unclear. METHODS: C57BL/6J mice were pretreated with the IRE1α RNase inhibitor STF-083010 or the HRD1 inhibitor LS102 before high tidal volume (HTV) ventilation for 4 h. Mouse lung epithelial cells were transfected with sgGpx4, siHrd1, or corresponding controls and then subjected to 20% cyclic stretch (CS) with or without ferrostatin-1. Lung injury was assessed by H&E staining, wet/dry ratio, and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) protein and cell counts. Inflammation was quantified by ELISA and qRT-PCR. Ferroptosis was evaluated by transmission electron microscopy and measurement of malondialdehyde (MDA), Fe²⁺, and reactive oxygen species (ROS). Protein abundance and localization were analyzed by immunoblotting and immunohistochemistry. HRD1/GPX4 interaction and GPX4 ubiquitination were examined by co-immunoprecipitation and ubiquitination assays. RESULTS: HTV ventilation induced severe lung injury with ferroptotic features and reduced SLC7A11 and GPX4 expression. STF-083010 alleviated lung injury and inflammation, suppressed ferroptosis, and restored SLC7A11/GPX4, while attenuating HRD1 upregulation. GPX4 deletion markedly increased susceptibility to CS-induced cell death and was not rescued by ferrostatin-1. Mechanistically, HRD1 interacted with GPX4 and promoted its ubiquitination and degradation under injurious ventilation. HRD1 knockdown preserved GPX4 stability and reduced CS-induced ferroptosis. Consistently, LS102 mitigated ferroptosis, lung injury, and inflammatory responses in vivo. CONCLUSION: ERS promotes ferroptosis in VILI through an IRE1α/XBP1-HRD1 axis that drives ubiquitin-mediated GPX4 degradation. Targeting HRD1 or upstream IRE1α RNase activity preserves GPX4, limits ferroptosis, and attenuates VILI, supporting this pathway as a therapeutic target.

papers.authors: Zheng X, Hua Y

papers.ai_note: 本研究为描述性注册分析，无传统意义的主要/次要终点，各时代对比的 P 值多数未报告，仅 PK/PD 分层给出跨零的 95% CI（-24.4 至 +43.6），提示时代差异不显著；晚期组仅 10 个家族，效能极低，阴性/减弱结果不能等同于无差异。最大允许年龄 ≤18 岁仅为事后敏感性分层而非纳入标准，分层后时代对比普遍减弱，说明早期结论对人群限定敏感。5 个结局模块完全缺失者全部在早期时代，缺失非随机且方向单一，可能扭曲时代比较；作者已在限制中承认。摘要检索日期（2026-10-02）晚于资格截止日（2026-08-08），历史登记重建的完整性信息不足。全部结果为登记终点的构成计数，未与实际试验结果或患者获益关联，临床外推信息不足。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Pediatric therapeutic development depends not only on age-appropriate dosing but also on endpoints whose administration and interpretation remain coherent across developmental stages. METHODS: An expanded ClinicalTrials.gov search was performed on 2 October 2026 using pulmonary hypertension terms plus the structured Child age filter (birth-17 years), while restricting eligibility to records first posted on or before 8 August 2026. The combined inventory contained 394 unique records. Seventy-two records formed the main analysis set; 69 were assigned to 57 traceable trial families and three continuation records remained unassigned at family level. Endpoint domains were counted once per family. RESULTS: Fifty-two families had registered outcomes available for domain analysis (42 first posted before 2017 and 10 in 2017-2026). Biomarker/laboratory measures occurred in 12/42 versus 9/10 families and functional capacity/activity in 38/42 versus 6/10. The study-level registered maximum permitted age was 18 years or younger in 14/42 earlier and 9/10 later families; this was used only for an age-scope sensitivity stratum and was not an eligibility criterion. In this age-scope stratum, several era contrasts attenuated, including PK/PD/dosing (9/14 vs. 7/9; difference +13.5 percentage points, 95% CI -24.4 to +43.6). A core-primary sensitivity analysis excluding four families whose registry records were updated after the eligibility cutoff produced the same qualitative pattern of no recent functional primary entries and wider uncertainty in the smaller later-era group. Five families with completely missing outcome modules were all in the earlier era; extreme-case analyses are reported in the supplement. CONCLUSION: Endpoint portfolios differed across registration eras, but age-scope composition, differential missingness, and incomplete historical registry reconstruction limit a temporal interpretation. Public endpoint descriptions should specify the clinical construct, measurement method, reporter or data source, capability rule, and handling of children unable to complete an assessment.

papers.title_en: Chest x-ray patterns and clinical outcomes of COVID-2019 patients at Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital, Malawi.
papers.authors: Kondowe B, Ankunda R, Mzumara S, Katundu KG, Banda NP, Chingoli F, Shang J
papers.affiliation_highlight: Ernest Cook University, Sir Albert Cook Building, P.O Box 7161, Kampala City, Uganda.
