papers.ai_note: 结局变量存在明显信息缺失：23.6%（51例）无结局记录，实际仅52.8%出院与23.6%死亡可分析，缺失可能非随机，效应估计稳定性存疑。研究为横断面设计，结局与胸片时序关系未界定，PRR反映的是横断面患病率关联而非预测效能，未报告校正混杂（年龄、合并症、入院严重度、治疗）的多因素结果，也未给出敏感度/特异度等判别指标，故'用胸片预测预后'的初衷并未真正验证。摘要未说明Brixia评分分级界值与阅片者一致性（kappa）数据；主要关注点集中于'出院回家'这一受医疗资源、转院与临终决策影响的复合行为学结局，而非死亡这一硬终点。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Chest x-ray (CXR) is a low-radiation, widely accessible, and cheap imaging tool with a mobile option for COVID-2019 patients' prognosis and monitoring, but the use of its findings to predict patient outcomes has not been evaluated. Computed Tomography (CT) is the gold standard but costly with high radiation doses. This study aims to describe CXR patterns and relate them to clinical outcomes of COVID-2019 patients admitted to the Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital (QECH) isolation ward in Malawi. METHODOLOGY: This cross-sectional study included 216 CXR images and files of COVID-2019 patients aged 18 and above admitted to the QECH COVID-2019 isolation ward from June to August 2021. Images were reviewed by two radiologists with over 10 years of experience, blinded from each other and findings were recorded in a predesigned questionnaire by the researchers. A tiebreaker was involved where the two reports disagreed. Data analysis was done using STATA version 13. RESULTS: Out of the 216 CXR images analyzed, 177 (81.9%) had COVID-2019-related CXR patterns with abnormal Brixia scores, while 39 (18.1%) had normal patterns with Brixia score of 0. On clinical outcome, 114 (52.8%) patients were discharged home while 51 (23.6%) died in the hospital and another 51 (23.6%) did not have documentation. The prevalence of home discharge was 62% lower among patients with ground glass opacities (GGO) [prevalence risk ratio (PRR) = 0.383 95% CI = 0.258-0.569; P < 0.001] and almost 50% lower among patients with consolidations [PRR = 0.448; 95% CI = 0.318-0.632; p < 0.001] compared to patients with normal CXR patterns. Similarly, the prevalence of home discharge alive among patients with severe Brixia scores was 50% lower than normal Brixia scores [PRR = 0.496; 95 CI = 0.355-0.693; p < 0.001]. CONCLUSION: The study found that most COVID-2019 patients had abnormal CXR patterns and Brixia scores. GGO and consolidations were the most common patterns with many patients having severe Brixia scores. The abnormal patterns and severe Brixia scores were negatively associated with home discharge.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Pulmonary embolism (PE) requires timely diagnosis, risk assessment, and coordinated treatment. Variations in care prompted the introduction of a multidisciplinary Pulmonary Embolism Response Team (PERT) at a tertiary care center. OBJECTIVES: To evaluate changes in treatment timing, in-hospital mortality, guideline adherence, and length of stay after PERT implementation. DESIGN: Single-center quality improvement initiative using a before-and-after design with historical controls. METHODS: The initiative included 42 patients with acute PE: 20 treated during January to December 2022 and 22 during January to December 2023. Baseline data were collected retrospectively, and postimplementation data prospectively. The intervention combined standardized protocols, a 24-h activation system, multidisciplinary treatment decisions, and staff education. RESULTS: Reported time from clinical suspicion to treatment initiation decreased from 6 to 3 h. In-hospital mortality was 6 of 20 (30.0%) before implementation and 1 of 22 (4.5%) afterward, an unadjusted absolute difference of 25.5 percentage points (2-sided Fisher exact P = .041). Recorded guideline adherence increased from 70% to 100%. ICU length of stay decreased from 6 to 2 days, a 66.7% reduction, and hospital length of stay decreased from 10 to 5 days. Time-to-treatment and length-of-stay comparisons are descriptive. CONCLUSION: PERT implementation was associated with faster treatment, lower observed in-hospital mortality, and shorter ICU and hospital stays. The small, nonrandomized, single-center design limits causal inference. These findings support further evaluation of coordinated multidisciplinary PE care.

papers.title_en: STAT6 contributes to silicosis fibrosis by inhibiting PPARα-mediated fatty acid oxidation.
papers.authors: Yang Z, Li X, Fan H, Fu B, Zhang X, Li Q, Zhao Y, Qi Y et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Occupational and Environmental Health, School of Public Health, Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou, Henan 450…

papers.ai_note: 摘要全文无任何定量结果（无羟脯氨酸含量、染色评分、基因/蛋白表达的数值、CI或P值），主要终点仅以'attenuates pulmonary fibrosis'定性描述，信息不足，无法核实效应大小；未报告样本量、随机化、盲法与统计方法；体内仅用药理抑制剂、未见基因敲除或rescue体内验证，脱靶效应无法排除；PPARα/FAO轴主要依据过表达与敲低的细胞学结果，且NIH-3T3为小鼠成纤维细胞系，外推至人硅肺患者证据有限；'STAT6激活'与各分子变化均无量化数据支持。
papers.abstract_en: Silicosis, a progressive occupational fibrotic lung disease, the pathogenesis of which remains incompletely understood. Fibroblast-to-myofibroblast transdifferentiation is recognized as a key event in this process. Although signal transduction and transcription activator 6 (STAT6) has been shown to be associated with organ fibrosis, its specific role and mechanisms in silicosis remain unclear. Using a mouse silicosis model induced by intratracheal instillation of SiO₂, we demonstrate that pharmacological inhibition of STAT6 by AS1517499 attenuates pulmonary fibrosis, as evidenced by hydroxyproline content and histopathological assessment, concomitant with modulation of the STAT6/PPARα axis and its target genes (ACOX1 and CPT1α). Lung tissues were analyzed for hydroxyproline content, H&E, Masson staining, and expression of STAT6/p-STAT6, PPARα, and its target genes (ACOX1, CPT1α) using immunohistochemistry (IHC), Real-time Quantitative Polymerase Chain Reaction (RT-qPCR), and western blot (WB). The therapeutic effect of the STAT6 inhibitor AS1517499 was evaluated. In vitro, a transdifferentiation model was established in NIH-3T3 cells treated with TGF-β1 (5 ng/mL). Transfection of siRNA and overexpression plasmids, followed by analysis of transdifferentiation markers, lipid accumulation, and fatty acid oxidation (FAO) levels. Specifically, STAT6 is activated in the silicosis mouse model, and pharmacological inhibition of STAT6 attenuates pulmonary fibrosis. Mechanistically, STAT6 overexpression enhanced transdifferentiation and suppressed FAO levels, whereas STAT6 silencing or PPARα overexpression counteracted this effect. Co-overexpression of STAT6 and PPARα reversed the pro-transdifferentiation effects and reduced FAO levels induced by STAT6 overexpression alone, while co-silencing reverses these effects. In conclusion, STAT6 contributes to silicosis by inhibiting PPARα-mediated FAO, providing a preclinical rationale for targeting STAT6 in silicosis treatment.

papers.ai_note: 主要终点FEV1为阴性，摘要与结论转而突出次要终点mMRC/CAT及满意度，存在选择性强调；多项结局仅报告组内改善而无组间差异，组内前后对比易受自然波动影响；样本量极小（最终分析38例），且摘要未给出任何效应量、CI或P值，无法判断显著性强度与临床意义；配方由体外细胞实验筛选得出，与临床终点缺乏直接链条。；数值未经四元组核验
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is characterized by persistent airflow limitation, chronic inflammation, and oxidative stress, leading to progressive functional impairment and reduced quality of life. Beta-glucan possesses immunomodulatory and anti-inflammatory properties, but its therapeutic potential in COPD remains poorly defined. This study aimed to optimize a combined formulation of beta-glucan, broccoli extract, and quercetin (Pro β-Glucan+) through in vitro evaluation and to investigate its clinical efficacy in patients with stable COPD. METHODS: HFL1 lung fibroblasts were treated with different ratios of Pro β-Glucan+®, and cell viability and wound healing assays were performed to identify the optimal formulation. The selected ratio was evaluated in a 12-week randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial. A total of 42 participants were randomized, of whom 38 completed the study and were included in the final analysis (Pro β-Glucan+, n = 19; placebo, n = 19). Prespecified primary outcome was FEV1. Secondary outcomes included clinical symptoms, functional capacity, health status, inflammatory and oxidative stress biomarkers, and patient satisfaction. RESULTS: The 10:3:2 ratio (beta-glucan:broccoli extract:quercetin) significantly enhanced HFL1 cell cell viability and wound healing activity among the tested formulations and was selected for clinical evaluation. Pro β-Glucan+® was well tolerated and associated with within-group improvements in dyspnea, respiratory symptoms, functional capacity, and health status after 12 weeks, with significant between-group differences in mMRC and CAT scores at week 12. No significant within- or between-group difference was observed in the prespecified primary outcome, FEV1, or in systemic inflammatory and oxidative stress biomarkers. Patient satisfaction was higher with Pro β-Glucan+® than with placebo. CONCLUSION: The optimized Pro β-Glucan+® formulation demonstrated in vitro biological activity and was associated with improvements in several clinical outcomes in patients with stable COPD. Significant between-group differences were observed in mMRC and CAT scores at week 12. These findings support further investigation of this combination as an adjunctive nutritional intervention for COPD management. CLINICAL TRIAL REGISTRATION: https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT05878834, identifier NCT05878834.

papers.title_zh: 先天性肺气道畸形（CPAM）分子机制与候选治疗通路的叙述性综述：多数通路尚未被验证为因果或临床可干预靶点
papers.title_en: Congenital pulmonary airway malformation: molecular mechanisms and exploration of candidate therapeutic pathways.
papers.authors: Chang R, Ma Y, Meng B, Yang X, Wu Z, Zhu Z
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, Gansu Provincial Maternal and Child Health Hospital (Gansu Provincial Central Hospital),…
papers.authors_conclusion: This review aims to provide a critical framework for interpreting current CPAM molecular evidence and guiding future translational research; the authors note that most candidate pathways have not yet been validated as causal or clinically actionable targets and outline priorities for tissue-resolved profiling, functional validation in organoid and developmental models, and cautious assessment of therapeutic feasibility and safety.
papers.ai_note: 叙述性综述，摘要未报告检索策略、纳入标准或证据分级，无法评估选择性引用风险；无任何定量结果（效应量、CI、P值），治疗可行性与安全性仅为研究展望而非结论；'信息不足'于该综述对临床决策的实际影响。
papers.abstract_en: Congenital pulmonary airway malformation (CPAM), formerly termed congenital cystic adenomatoid malformation, is a heterogeneous developmental lung disorder characterized by abnormal cystic or adenomatous structures. Its pathogenesis remains incompletely understood and may involve disturbed lung branching morphogenesis, altered epithelial differentiation, imbalanced cell proliferation and apoptosis, focal somatic mutations, and abnormal epithelial-mesenchymal interactions. This comprehensive narrative review discusses molecular findings relevant to CPAM, including Hoxb-5, SOX2, NKX2.1/TTF-1, FGF10, WNT/BMP, EGFR, RAS-MAPK, PI3K-AKT-mTOR, ACSL5/WNT2B, FABP7, and TGF-β signaling. We distinguish evidence obtained directly from human CPAM tissue-including expression studies and somatic mutation analyses-from findings extrapolated from normal lung development, animal models, and other pulmonary disorders. Recent morphological, immunohistochemical, molecular, and single-cell studies support substantial histological and molecular heterogeneity, while the relationship between specific histological subtypes and precise developmental windows remains provisional. Chromosomal microarray analysis and sequencing may help identify selected genomic abnormalities, but most candidate pathways have not yet been validated as causal or clinically actionable targets. We summarize key evidence gaps and outline priorities for tissue-resolved profiling, functional validation in organoid and developmental models, and cautious assessment of therapeutic feasibility and safety. This review aims to provide a critical framework for interpreting current CPAM molecular evidence and guiding future translational research.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Physical activity (PA) is both a therapeutic goal and a potential predictor of acute exacerbations in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Novel wearable technologies enable tracking of PA over prolonged periods of time under real-world conditions and may help to detect clinical deterioration early and offer a unique window of opportunity for early medical intervention. MATERIALS AND METHODS: We made use of existing data from a previous study of ours that collected real-world PA data from COPD patients over one year using an activity-tracking wearable. We set out to analyze individual PA trajectories and model the decline of PA towards emerging acute exacerbation of COPD (AECOPD). Data analysis mainly involved nonlinear regression and segmented broken-line analysis. RESULTS: A total of 29 AECOPD events from 11 patients were analyzed and characteristic patterns of PA decline were observed towards emerging AECOPD. A time-sensitive analysis of PA breakpoints suggested the antecedent 9 days as the critical time window for AECOPD prediction based on dropping PA levels. Moreover, severity class-stratified analyses showed that the steepest decline in PA was observed for moderate AECOPD, which might be explainable by relatively high baseline PA levels in conjunction with a relatively high functional impact of the exacerbation. DISCUSSION: We here show the potential value of long-term PA telemonitoring for early detection of AECOPD and propose the preceding 9 days as the critical time window for AECOPD prediction based on dropping PA levels across severity classes. Independent validation and confirmation of this timeframe as clinically-actionable is warranted.

papers.study_type: 分枝杆菌功能蛋白组学与基因敲除功能研究（亚细胞定位+互作组分析，体外表型与体内生存实验）
papers.title_zh: 鉴定分枝杆菌新型DivIVA结构域蛋白CidIVA：其参与脂质合成与细胞包膜完整性维持，且为结核分枝杆菌体内生存所必需
papers.title_en: CidIVA, a novel DivIVA domain-containing protein, is critical for cell envelope integrity and intracellular survival of mycobacteria.
papers.authors: Kapoor Y, Dutta D, Suhas KS, Chakraborty A, Birua S, Priya A, Khan MZ, Adicherla H et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: CSIR-Centre for Cellular & Molecular Biology, Hyderabad, India.
papers.authors_conclusion: Our study identifies two novel DivIVA domain-containing proteins, one of which forms a functional nexus linking lipid homeostasis, cell-envelope maintenance and cell division. These results not only advance our understanding of mycobacterial cell biology but also suggest broader principles of functional diversification within multi-member protein families across bacterial species.
papers.ai_note: 基础微生物学研究，无临床人群、干预对照或疗效数值可提取（信息不足）；摘要未报告体内生存实验的动物模型、样本量与统计学差异，'required for Mtb survival in vivo'缺少量化支撑（信息不足）；与胸科肿瘤临床业务无直接关联，其潜在价值限于抗结核新靶点的早期探索。
papers.abstract_en: Bacterial genomes encode a diverse array of proteins that function in a coordinated manner to orchestrate the highly dynamic process of cell division. Over the course of evolution, Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) and related mycobacterial species have diverged from the model bacterial species such as E. coli and B. subtilis and acquired distinct, poorly conserved proteins that underpin their distinct mechanisms of growth and division. However, the identity and functional roles of these molecular determinants remain largely elusive. In the present study, we identified two additional DivIVA domain-containing proteins of mycobacteria, Msm0050 and Msm5083, and performed detailed functional characterization of Msm5083/Rv1209, thereby expanding the known repertoire of DivIVA domain-containing proteins in this species. Although homologous to Wag31 and SepIVA (the known mycobacterial DivIVA domain-containing proteins), they show distinct cell division defects. Functional studies using an Msm5083 deletion mutant highlighted its role in lipid biosynthesis and maintaining cell envelope integrity, and hence, we named it CidIVA (cell envelope integrity determinant DivIVA). Subcellular localization and interactome analysis demonstrated that it homes to the membrane and interacts with other membrane-associated proteins involved in membrane synthesis and maintenance, lipid metabolism, and transportation, consistent with the observed phenotypes. Interestingly, Rv1209, the orthologue of Msm5083, showed enrichment at the poles and lateral cell wall and predominant interactions with virulence-related proteins. Although dispensable for in vitro survival, it is required for Mtb survival in vivo. Overall, our study identifies two novel DivIVA domain-containing proteins, one of which forms a functional nexus linking lipid homeostasis, cell-envelope maintenance and cell division. These results not only advance our understanding of mycobacterial cell biology but also suggest broader principles of functional diversification within multi-member protein families across bacterial species.

papers.title_zh: COPD黏液栓评分与小气道疾病及LABA/LAMA后外周反应的关联：26例单中心事后分析（仅SHe对LAMA反应呈负相关）
papers.title_en: Association Between Mucus Plugs, Small Airway Disease, and Peripheral Response to LAMAs and LABAs in COPD.
papers.authors: Perez Bogerd S, Godts J, Gevenois PA, Hackx M, Malinovschi A, Van Muylem A, Michils A
papers.affiliation_highlight: Chest Department, Hôpital Erasme, Université Libre de Bruxelles, Brussels, Belgium.
papers.authors_conclusion: In this post-hoc analysis of a small, single-center cohort, mucus plugging is associated with more pronounced SAD and reduced peripheral response to LAMAs in COPD patients. These findings suggest that mucus plugs may represent a potential therapeutic target to improve SAD.
papers.ai_note: 样本量仅26例且为单中心事后分析，多项关联检验未见多重比较校正；主要与次要终点未预先界定，突出的LAMA-SHe关联为探索性结果且摘要未给出具体数值/P；MS与振荡法（AX、R5-R19）对LABA/LAMA的反应均无关联，属阴性结果但未被强调；由相关性外推至'黏液栓为治疗靶点'缺乏干预证据；SHe下降方向与外周改善的定义表述易混淆，信息不足
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Mucus plugs are common in COPD and can be quantified on thin-section CT using a segment-based mucus score. Higher mucus score has been associated with lower FEV1 and worse clinical outcomes. However, although COPD primarily affects the small airways, the relationship between mucus score, small airway disease (SAD), and peripheral response to bronchodilators remains poorly understood. OBJECTIVE: To investigate whether mucus plugs are associated with SAD and impaired peripheral response to long acting ß2-agonists (LABAs) and muscarinic antagonists (LAMAs). METHODS: In this post-hoc analysis, COPD patients underwent thin-section CT, single-breath washout (Helium slope, SHe, a decrease reflecting a peripheral relief), and oscillometry (reactance area, AX; peripheral resistance, R5-R19) before and two hours after LABA and LAMA administration. MS (range 0-20) was defined as the number of segments containing mucus plugs. RESULTS: Among 26 COPD patients (36% females; mean FEV1 56±19%pred; GOLD A 32%/B 44%/E 24%), 70% exhibited mucus plugs (median MS=1). Higher MS was associated with lower FEV1 (p=0.008) and markers of SAD, including higher R5-R19 (p=0.036), AX (p<0.001), and SHe (p=0.018). MS was not associated with oscillometric changes following LABA or LAMA. Conversely, higher MS correlated with a reduced improvement in SHe after LAMA administration. CONCLUSION: In this post-hoc analysis of a small, single-center cohort, mucus plugging is associated with more pronounced SAD and reduced peripheral response to LAMAs in COPD patients. These findings suggest that mucus plugs may represent a potential therapeutic target to improve SAD.

papers.study_type: 动物实验（博来霉素诱导肺纤维化小鼠模型）＋转录组学机制研究

papers.title_en: Therapeutic effects of PolyPHb on bleomycin-induced pulmonary fibrosis: implications for improved oxygenation.
papers.authors: Cao M, Qin Q, Zhao Y, He H, Pan L, Ren Y, Liu J, Pan C et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Critical Care Medicine, Sichuan Academy of Medical Sciences & Sichuan Provincial People's Hospital, Univer…

papers.ai_note: 摘要仅以叙述性语言宣称'增强运动耐量、减轻炎症和纤维化'，未提供任何效应量、P值或CI；主要终点（运动耐量/纤维化指标）定义与统计方法信息不足；转录组学仅为'潜在调控网络'的探索性表述，缺乏验证；从动物模型到IPF患者（尤其运动能力与生活质量这一作者强调的临床问题）的外推尚无依据
papers.abstract_en: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a progressive, irreversible, and fatal interstitial lung disease of unknown cause, characterized by severe dyspnea, restrictive lung function, impaired gas exchange, and progressive destruction of pulmonary tissue. While approved drugs can slow disease progression, improving patients' quality of life remains a critical challenge. PolyPHb, a hemoglobin-based oxygen carrier (HBOC) derived from virally inactivated and purified human placental hemoglobin, efficiently transports and releases oxygen. In this study, we show that PolyPHb enhances exercise tolerance and mitigates inflammation and fibrosis in a bleomycin-induced pulmonary fibrosis mouse model. To elucidate the underlying mechanisms, we performed transcriptomic analysis of lung tissues following PolyPHb treatment, revealing potential regulatory networks involved in its protective effects. These results provide new insights into potential interventions of PolyPHb in IPF and suggest that it may contribute to improved functional outcomes, though further studies are needed to fully define its impact on exercise capacity and quality of life.

papers.authors: Chien ST, Laube BL, Vehring R, Voigt EA, Peeler DJ
papers.affiliation_highlight: Phil and Penny Knight Campus for Accelerating Scientific Impact, Department of Bioengineering, University of Oregon, Eug…
papers.authors_conclusion: We propose an interdisciplinary bioengineering approach that combines the expertise of chemists, immunologists, and pulmonologists to enable clinical translation of respiratory mRNA medicines.
papers.ai_note: 综述性文献，无原始数据、无主要/次要终点、无效应量与统计学结果；正文结构按材料—物理屏障—免疫屏障—模型学分层展开，不涉及疗效比较。内容以呼吸系统（鼻/肺）mRNA递送为主，仅将呼吸系统肿瘤列为应用场景之一，非胸部肿瘤核心研究。信息不足：摘要未提供检索策略、纳入范围与证据分级，无法评估其系统性与偏倚风险。
papers.abstract_en: Delivery formulations that facilitate mRNA transfection in the respiratory system aim to provide a flexible platform to address or prevent respiratory disease in a patient-accessible, targeted manner. Recent clinical trials in cystic fibrosis, respiratory oncology, and mucosal vaccination have exposed the unique physicochemical and immunological challenges that differentiate respiratory and parenteral mRNA strategies. This review examines the nanomaterials, barriers, and experimental models central to the rational development of aerosolized mRNA medicines. We begin with an overview of the most promising classes of devices and nanomaterial formulations used for respiratory delivery. We then analyze the physical barriers to nasal and lung delivery, spanning delivery-associated physical stresses and anatomical matrices, and present the major chemical and biological strategies developed to overcome them. A parallel analysis addresses the immunological barriers of the respiratory mucosa, including the innate and adaptive cell populations and the sensing pathways that mRNA delivery engages. Immunoengineering approaches to improve the tolerability of repeat dosing are discussed, including nucleoside modification and alternative RNA constructs, degradable and anti-inflammatory material chemistries, and co-administration of standard-of-care pulmonary drugs. Finally, we address methodologies for the investigation of the nanomaterial-mucosal interface using biophysical characterization techniques, and evaluate preclinical models spanning in vitro mucus mimics, air-liquid interface cultures, ex vivo precision-cut lung slices, in vivo rodent and non-rodent species, three-dimensional (3D) nasal and lung cast replicas, and mathematical models of the intranasal airways and lung. We propose an interdisciplinary bioengineering approach that combines the expertise of chemists, immunologists, and pulmonologists to enable clinical translation of respiratory mRNA medicines.

papers.title_en: Pretreatment with Commelina communis L. improves survival following influenza a virus infection and enhances innate interferon signaling.
papers.authors: Kwon EB, Yang HJ, Kim B, Li W, Kim YE, Kim YS, Choi JG
papers.affiliation_highlight: Korean Medicine Application Center, Korea Institute of Oriental Medicine, Daegu, Republic of Korea.
papers.authors_conclusion: These findings suggest that CCL and rutin may enhance host antiviral defense by modulating innate interferon signaling when administered before IAV exposure period.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未报告样本量、随机化、盲法、统计检验与CI/P值，存活率0%→40%的差异无统计学支撑；未说明对照组具体设置与重复次数；机制部分为通路激活的关联性描述，缺乏阻断实验（如TBK1抑制剂）因果验证；rutin仅在体外筛选中评估，未在体内感染模型中验证；结论限于暴露前预防性给药，临床可外推性有限
papers.abstract_en: The objectives of this study were to evaluate the pre-exposure protective effects of Commelina communis L. (CCL) against influenza A virus (IAV) infection and to investigate its associated immunomodulatory mechanisms. Using RAW 264.7 cells and BALB/c mouse models, we demonstrated that CCL pretreatment reduced viral replication markers and suppressed viral protein expression in vitro. In vivo, prophylactic administration of CCL improved survival from 0% to 40% and attenuated body-weight loss following IAV challenge. Mechanistically, CCL enhanced the secretion of type I interferon IFN-β through activation of TANK-binding kinase 1 (TBK1) and interferon regulatory factors 3 and 7 (IRF3/7). Activation of this signaling pathway was associated with STAT1/2 phosphorylation and increased expression of antiviral interferon-stimulated genes, including Isg20 and Isg56. Phytochemical profiling using ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography coupled with quadrupole-Orbitrap high-resolution mass spectrometry (UHPLC-UV-HRMS) identified four phytochemicals in CCL, among which rutin showed the greatest activity among the tested compounds in the in vitro screening assay. Collectively, these findings suggest that CCL and rutin may enhance host antiviral defense by modulating innate interferon signaling when administered before IAV exposure period.

papers.affiliation_highlight: Transylvania University, Faculty of Medicine Brasov, Romania.
papers.authors_conclusion: We discuss the limitations and opportunities for the use of current biologics and describe future research needs within the framework of achieving disease modification and complete remission.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：全文为观点性综述，无样本量、无终点、无统计数值，无法评估证据强度；所列'未满足需求'（生物标志物验证、适应性试验、多组学指导、中性粒细胞性哮喘干预、儿童预防试验等）未见证据分级或引用支撑的具体数据；结论以'disease modification and complete remission'为愿景性目标，缺乏本研究自身证据支撑；对胸科肿瘤业务无直接关联。
papers.abstract_en: Biologics targeting IL-4, IL-5, IL-13, TSLP, and IgE continue to expand the therapeutic options for patients with severe asthma. Although they reduce exacerbation frequency, lower systemic corticosteroid exposure, and improve symptom control in selected patients with T2-high severe asthma, their benefits are incomplete and are unevenly distributed across the whole spectrum of the severe asthma population. Several unmet needs exist with the current use of biologics in asthma including the need for development of validated biomarkers, the conduct of adaptive trials with multi-biomarker and omics-guided selection coupled with pharmacogenetic studies and interventions evaluating therapies for neutrophilic, pauci-granulocytic and mixed disease. Early interventions targeting immune hyperresponsiveness and structural remodeling coupled with pragmatic comparative trials, disease registries, multi-omic biomarkers, prevention trials for the pediatric population and with integrated severe-asthma/comorbidity models are also need and hold the potential to improve the impact of biologics in severe asthma. In this review, we discuss the limitations and opportunities for the use of current biologics and describe future research needs within the framework of achieving disease modification and complete remission.

papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Chinese Medicine, Taipei Tzu Chi Hospital, Buddhist Tzu Chi Medical Foundation, New Taipei City, Taiwan; D…

Increased NKCC1 expression and activity contribute to pulmonary edema and inflammation in experimental ALI. papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Sepsis-related acute lung injury (ALI) is a critical condition characterized by intense inflammation and damage to the lung tissue. Excessive activation of immune cells, particularly macrophages and neutrophils, is a key factor in the development of ALI. The sodium-potassium-chloride cotransporter 1 (NKCC1) plays a pivotal role in managing pulmonary fluid balance and inflammation and is critically involved in ALI. METHODS: A comprehensive literature review was conducted to evaluate studies examining macrophages, neutrophils, and NKCC1 in ALI, focusing on NKCC1 and its interactions with macrophages and neutrophils. RESULTS: Recognition of damage-associated or pathogen-associated molecular patterns by pattern recognition receptors on macrophages and neutrophils initiates downstream signaling cascades, including the mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) and nuclear factor-κB (NF-κB) pathways, which drive the production of proinflammatory mediators. The subsequent release of cytokines, including chemokines, promotes neutrophil recruitment to the lungs, where these neutrophils subsequently produce reactive oxygen species, proteases, and neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs), thus amplifying inflammation and contributing to tissue injury. Excessive NET formation causes lung tissue injury, increases pulmonary vascular permeability, and disrupts gas exchange. During ALI, NKCC1 expression is elevated, which exacerbates lung inflammation and pulmonary edema. CONCLUSION: Sepsis-related ALI is characterized by excessive macrophage and neutrophil activation and activation of the MAPK and NF-κB pathways. Increased NKCC1 expression and activity contribute to pulmonary edema and inflammation in experimental ALI. However, the proposed role of NKCC1 in regulating macrophage-neutrophil interactions in sepsis-related ALI remains to be established.

papers.title_en: Chest Computed Tomography Receipt Beyond 5 Years After Lung Cancer Diagnosis and Survival.
papers.authors: Yoon DW, Kang D, Jeong BH, Choi HL, Park J, Lee SH, Shin DW, Kim HK et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic and Cardiovascular Surgery, Samsung Medical Center, Sungkyunkwan University School of Medicine, S…
papers.authors_conclusion: 在本队列研究中，诊断5年后接受CT与肺癌事件检出增加、事件后手术切除使用增多以及全因死亡率降低相关；这些发现支持在选定的肺癌生存者中进一步评估风险适配的5年后CT随访策略。
papers.ai_note: 主要终点为LCE发生，CT组反而更高（HR 1.28），属检测增加的预期表现，而支撑获益的全因死亡率（HR 0.66）与手术切除均为次要终点，摘要存在以次要终点主导结论的倾向；观察性设计下死亡率差异难以排除健康使用者/就医行为偏倚及检出后治疗差异的残余混杂，LCE以医保特殊负担注册为代理定义可能存在漏诊与编码偏倚；亚组HR未说明对应终点与交互检验P值，信息不足；结论限定于'选定的长期生存者'但未给出可操作的风险适配筛选标准
papers.abstract_en: IMPORTANCE: Long-term lung cancer (LC) survivors remain at risk of LC events (LCEs), including late recurrence and second primary LC, beyond 5 years after diagnosis, but the role of computed tomography (CT) surveillance beyond 5 years remains uncertain. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate whether CT receipt beyond 5 years after LC diagnosis is associated with LCEs and survival. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This nationwide population-based cohort study used sequential target trial emulation with monthly eligibility reassessment and time-updated propensity score matching based on data from the Korean National Health Insurance Service database. Patients diagnosed with LC from 2006 to 2019 were followed up through December 31, 2024. Long-term LC survivors were eligible for trial entry 5.5 years after diagnosis if they had no administrative evidence of active or recurrent LC, a prior LCE, or another primary cancer. Data were analyzed between January 1, 2026, and February 28, 2026. EXPOSURES: CT receipt beyond 5 years after LC diagnosis, defined as chest CT during the 1-month assessment window at each monthly trial baseline, compared with no CT receipt. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary outcome was LCE occurrence, defined by new LC-specific special copayment registration after the monthly trial baseline. Secondary outcomes were all-cause mortality, surgical resection after LCE detection, and subsequent mortality. RESULTS: The cohort of 55 694 LC survivors (mean [SD] age, 63.3 [10.9] years; 58.0% male) contributed 2 629 462 eligible person-trials. Matching yielded 583 756 person-trials per group. During a median (IQR) follow-up of 2.74 (1.16-5.18) years, CT receipt was associated with a higher incidence of LCEs (2.49% vs 1.97% per year; hazard ratio [HR], 1.28 [95% CI, 1.26-1.29]) and lower all-cause mortality rate (2.62% vs 4.33% per year; HR, 0.66 [95% CI, 0.65-0.67]) compared with no CT receipt. Among patients with an LCE, CT receipt was associated with greater odds of surgical resection after LCE (odds ratio, 1.46 [95% CI, 1.41-1.52]) and a lower subsequent mortality risk (HR, 0.63 [95% CI, 0.61-0.64]). These associations were observed more frequently among females (HR, 0.47 [95% CI, 0.44-0.49]), older adults (HR, 0.57 [95% CI, 0.54-0.60]), and never smokers (HR, 0.55 [95% CI, 0.53-0.57]). CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this cohort study, CT receipt beyond 5 years after LC diagnosis was associated with increased detection of LCEs, greater use of surgical resection after an LCE, and a lower all-cause mortality rate. These findings support further evaluation of risk-adapted CT surveillance beyond 5 years in selected LC survivors.

papers.affiliation_highlight: Nanyang Technological University Singapore Singapore.
papers.authors_conclusion: Overall, PRISM offers a morphology-based framework for estimating early response to prespecified systemic therapies and warrants further prospective multicenter evaluation.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未报告任何性能数值（无AUC/CI/P、无分队列结果、无灵敏度/特异度），无法判断预测效能与临床可用性；'In comparison to 18 established baseline models, PRISM remained competitive, with numerical advantages in selected tasks'属选择性强调——仅称部分任务有数值优势而未给出主要终点的具体比较结果；主要终点为治疗特异性客观缓解，但摘要未逐一报告各治疗队列结果；'prospective silent validation'为静默验证，模型未参与实际决策，不能等同于前瞻性临床效用验证；全部数据来自中国四个中心，外部验证存在地域/人群局限；未报告与临床-分子生物标志物（EGFR、PD-L1等）模型的增量比较；未说明客观缓解的评估标准（RECIST版本与评估时点）与缓解评估者是否盲法。
papers.abstract_en: Accurate prediction of treatment response remains challenging in cancer. To facilitate response prediction in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), we developed PRISM, an interpretable multiscale graph-learning framework for estimating treatment-specific objective response from pretreatment H&E whole-slide images. PRISM integrated multiresolution tissue representations with a cell-level tumor microenvironment (TME) hypergraph, thereby treating higher-order microenvironmental organization as a learnable component of treatment-response prediction. Samples from 7,082 patients from four Chinese centers were screened. PRISM was evaluated across treatment specific cohorts receiving targeted therapy (T), EGFR-targeted therapy (T_EGFR), immune checkpoint inhibitor-based therapy (ICI), chemoimmunotherapy (CI), and chemotherapy (C) using patient-level internal cross-validation, independent multicenter external validation, and prospective silent validation. PRISM predicted early objective responses across prespecified systemic therapies in NSCLC. In comparison to 18 established multiple-instance learning and computational pathology baseline models, PRISM remained competitive, with numerical advantages in selected tasks. Multiscale attribution and exploratory H&E-derived TME analyses provided spatial context for model predictions. Overall, PRISM offers a morphology-based framework for estimating early response to prespecified systemic therapies and warrants further prospective multicenter evaluation.

papers.authors: Potter AL, Kothagundla S, Ananthanarayanan A, Srinivasan D, Senthil P, Tong D, Hwang T, Linderman GC et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Division of Thoracic Surgery, Department of Surgery, Mass General Brigham, Boston, Massachusetts.
papers.authors_conclusion: Results of this cohort study of Medicare beneficiaries diagnosed with SCLC suggest that receipt of lung cancer screening was associated with a shift toward earlier-stage SCLC at diagnosis and improved overall survival.
papers.ai_note: 观察性设计存在明显的健康筛查者偏倚与筛查选择偏倚，筛查组仅占5.5%，PSM基线平衡与匹配后效应量摘要未报告，信息不足；总生存易受领先时间偏倚与病程长度偏倚影响，摘要未报告肺癌特异性生存或肺癌死亡率，无法区分真实获益与分期迁移/诊断提前带来的表观生存改善；OS差异也可能部分源于筛查人群合并症与体能状态更佳；结论中'associated with'的措辞与标题层面的因果暗示之间需注意。
papers.abstract_en: IMPORTANCE: Lung cancer screening with low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) has been shown to identify lung cancers at earlier stages and to significantly reduce lung cancer mortality in prior randomized clinical trials. However, the benefit of LDCT screening for small cell lung cancer (SCLC), an aggressive subtype of lung cancer, is unclear. OBJECTIVE: To investigate the characteristics and outcomes of SCLC diagnosed after a lung cancer screening examination using a large database of Medicare beneficiaries. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: In this retrospective cohort study, Medicare data linked to the Surveillance Epidemiology End Results Program's cancer registry data were analyzed. Patients in the US aged 65 to 78 years who were diagnosed with SCLC from 2015 to 2021 were identified for analysis, with follow-up data through 2022. Patients who underwent 1 or more LDCT lung cancer screening examinations during the 12 months preceding their SCLC diagnosis were included in the screened group. All other patients were included in the unscreened group. Data were analyzed from January to August 2026. EXPOSURE: One or more LDCT lung cancer screenings during the 12 months preceding SCLC diagnosis. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary outcomes were stage at SCLC diagnosis and overall survival after SCLC diagnosis in the screened and unscreened groups. RESULTS: A total of 17 099 patients (median [IQR] age, 72.0 [69.0-75.0] years; 8999 [52.6%] female) met study inclusion criteria, of which 949 (5.5%) were included in the screened group and 16 150 (94.5%) were included in the unscreened group. When compared with patients in the unscreened group, patients in the screened group were significantly less likely to be diagnosed with distant disease (419 of 949 [44.2%] vs 11 376 of 16 150 [70.4%]; P < .001). Patients in the screened group also had significantly better overall survival when compared with patients in the unscreened group (3-year overall survival, 28.0% [95% CI, 24.9%-31.2%] vs 10.8% [95% CI, 10.3%-11.3%]; P < .001). Both findings were consistent in propensity score-matched analysis. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: Results of this cohort study of Medicare beneficiaries diagnosed with SCLC suggest that receipt of lung cancer screening was associated with a shift toward earlier-stage SCLC at diagnosis and improved overall survival.

These findings identify CLCs as a biomarker, imaging target, and tractable therapeutic target in eosinophilic muco-obstructive airway disease.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要称CLC为'sensitive and specific marker'及'quantitative biomarker'，但未给出敏感度、特异度、AUC或浓度截断值等任何效能数值；治疗与成像证据全部来自动物模型，人体部分仅为横断面观察，无任何人体疗效或预后数据；以ABPA这一特定嗜酸粒细胞性气道疾病为模型，向其他黏液栓性慢病（如哮喘、慢阻肺、支扩）的外推属人群限定松动；'sufficient to promote'结论基于实验性CLC沉积，与自然发病条件下CLC的因果地位不完全等同。
papers.abstract_en: RATIONALE: Mucus plugging causes airflow obstruction, morbidity, and mortality in chronic respiratory diseases. Charcot-Leyden crystals (CLCs), formed from eosinophil-derived Galectin-10, are frequently observed in pathologic mucus, but their role in disease is unclear. OBJECTIVES: To define the prevalence, inflammatory context, and functional role of CLCs in mucus plugs, using acute allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis (ABPA) as a model of eosinophilic muco-obstructive disease. METHODS: Airway samples from 19 patients with acute ABPA and 61 disease controls were analyzed for CLCs and Galectin-10. Paired samples from plugged and unplugged bronchial mucosal biopsies defined the spatial relationship between CLCs and inflammation. A novel mouse model demonstrated the contribution of CLCs to airway obstruction and inflammation and enabled evaluation of CLC-directed imaging and therapy. MEASUREMENTS AND MAIN RESULTS: Airway CLCs were a sensitive and specific marker of acute ABPA. CLC-containing mucus plugs were surrounded by a localized type 2 inflammatory niche, alongside eosinophils, neutrophils and extracellular traps, whereas inflammation was minimal in unplugged airways from the same patients, or plugs lacking CLCs. In mice, CLC-containing plugs induced persistent airway obstruction and local inflammation, both reduced by a crystal-dissolving anti-Galectin-10 antibody. Galectin-10 concentrations provided a quantitative biomarker of acute ABPA, while a CLC-targeted positron emission tomography tracer enabled noninvasive visualization of crystal-rich plugs. CONCLUSIONS: CLC-containing mucus plugs form focal inflammatory niches in acute ABPA, and experimental CLC deposition is sufficient to promote persistent airway obstruction and inflammation. These findings identify CLCs as a biomarker, imaging target, and tractable therapeutic target in eosinophilic muco-obstructive airway disease.

papers.title_zh: 前瞻性多中心观察：NSCLC一线治疗中3个月内发生免疫检查点抑制剂肺炎（CIP）者总生存更短，而1年与2年landmark分析未见显著差异
papers.title_en: Prognostic Impact of Checkpoint Inhibitor Pneumonitis: Results from a Multicenter Prospective Observational Study (CS-Lung004).
papers.authors: Yamaguchi K, Yano J, Kanaji N, Hirakawa T, Matsumoto N, Miyazaki K, Okimoto T, Ando C et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Respiratory Medicine, Hiroshima University Hospital, 1-2-3 Kasumi, Minami-Ku, Hiroshima, 734-8551, Japan.
papers.authors_conclusion: This was the first prospective study to demonstrate the prognostic value of CIP. CIP within 3 months after the initiation of first-line treatment, including anti-PD-1/PD-L1 antibody, especially Grade 3-5 CIP, was associated with shorter OS in patients with NSCLC.
papers.ai_note: 研究明确目的为评估2年OS与CIP的关系，该主要分析为阴性（1年、2年landmark均无显著差异），结论却建立在3个月landmark这一更窄时间窗的发现上，存在主要终点阴性而以亚组/时间窗结果为主导结论的选择性强调；3个月截点是否预先设定摘要未说明。摘要未报告样本量、事件数、CIP发生率及分期/PS等混杂控制细节，信息不足；观察性设计下CIP可能只是疾病侵袭性或体能状态的标志，不能推断因果。'首个前瞻性研究证实CIP预后价值'为作者自我定位。
papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Checkpoint inhibitor pneumonitis (CIP) is a potentially life-threatening adverse event caused by anti-programmed death-1 (PD-1) and programmed death ligand-1 (PD-L1) antibodies. However, paradoxical findings have been reported regarding the association between overall survival (OS) and CIP. This study aimed to prospectively evaluate the relationship between the 2-year OS and CIP in patients receiving first-line treatment, including anti-PD-1/PD-L1 antibody therapy, using 3-month and 1-year landmark analyses. METHODS: A multicenter prospective observational study was conducted between December 2021 and November 2023 to evaluate the prognostic impact of CIP, based on timing and severity, in patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). RESULTS: Although no significant difference in OS was observed between patients with and without CIP developed within 2 years or 1 year, the 3-month landmark analysis showed that patients who developed CIP within 3 months had significantly shorter OS than those who did not (median OS from the 3-months landmark: 11.1 months with CIP versus not reached without CIP; log-rank p = 0.011). In multivariate Cox regression analyses, using patients without CIP as the reference group, CIP within 3 months was significantly associated with impaired overall survival (any-grade CIP: hazard ratio [HR] = 2.22, 95% confidence interval [CI]=1.21-4.09; Grade 3-5 CIP: HR=3.37, 95% CI=1.57-7.23). CONCLUSION: This was the first prospective study to demonstrate the prognostic value of CIP. CIP within 3 months after the initiation of first-line treatment, including anti-PD-1/PD-L1 antibody, especially Grade 3-5 CIP, was associated with shorter OS in patients with NSCLC.

papers.authors: Orme MW, Manifield J, Latimer L, Daynes E, Freeman SC, Xu J, Ward S, Haris M et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Division of Respiratory Sciences, School of Medical Sciences, University of Leicester, Leicester, UK.
papers.ai_note: 1) 研究目标包含睡眠行为，但睡眠结局最终无法合并分析，睡眠问题实际未得到回答；2) 监督（面对面与远程）相对无监督呈负向结果与常识预期相反，且面对面监督为极低确定性证据，作者未在摘要中给出解释或因果推断，选择性呈现需谨慎；3) 多数关键成分（力量训练、活动追踪、监督方式）确定性为低或极低，仅下肢有氧为高确定性；4) 摘要未报告发表偏倚、异质性检验及各成分组合细节，信息不足。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Physical activity (PA) predicts both mortality and morbidity. Pulmonary rehabilitation (PR) is known to improve exercise capacity and quality of life, but it's impact on PA remains unclear. Likewise, it is uncertain which components of PR elicit the greatest response. AIM: To use component network meta-analysis (cNMA) to investigate the relative contribution of exercise modality and intensity, nonexercise components, type of supervision and programme duration of PR on PA and sleep behaviour for people with COPD. METHODS: Medline, Embase, Cinahl and Cochrane databases were searched with no date or language restrictions. We included randomised controlled trials with an intervention involving exercise for people with COPD that measured PA or sleep behaviour as an outcome. A random-effects additive cNMA assessed the relative effectiveness of PR components on steps·day-1. Certainty of evidence was based on Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development and Evaluations (GRADE). FINDINGS: 50 studies (n=4136) reported a PA outcome and four studies reported a sleep outcome (n=638). The 34 studies measuring steps·day-1 were included in a cNMA (n=3039). PA increased following lower limb aerobic exercise (695 steps·day-1, 95% credible interval (CrI) 510-898; high certainty), strength training (390 steps·day-1, 95% CrI 63-811; low certainty), PA tracking (e.g. pedometers; 938 steps·day-1, 95% CrI 688-1480; low certainty). In-person supervised (-669 steps·day-1, 95% CrI -845--452; very low certainty) and remotely supervised (-685 steps·day-1, 95% CrI -1124--174; low certainty) programmes resulted in smaller changes in step count than unsupervised programmes. A meta-analysis of sleep outcomes was not possible due to the low number of studies reporting sleep as an outcome and heterogeneity in outcome measures used.

papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Clinical Oncology, Tuen Mun Hospital, Hong Kong.
papers.authors_conclusion: The consensus statements from this meeting could provide an important basis for tailoring treatment for patients with NSCLC who have actionable mutations, as well as pointing out key areas to explore in upcoming research.

papers.abstract_en: Oligometastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is increasingly encountered in clinical practice, owing to advances in imaging techniques and the emergence of new therapeutic options. This manuscript presents the outcomes of a meeting of experts from Hong Kong, convened to review the evidence and provide guidance on the use of local ablative therapies (LATs) for patients with oligometastatic NSCLC harboring actionable mutations. The discussion addressed key topics, including the definitions of oligometastatic and oligoprogressive disease, criteria for selecting patients for radiotherapy and other LAT modalities, optimal radiotherapy dosage, and the sequencing and timing of LATs in conjunction with targeted molecular therapies. Guidance was also developed regarding whether to pause or continue systemic treatments during LAT, and the evidence supporting emerging biomarkers in this context was reviewed. Consensus statements were formulated using a modified Delphi approach, and several case examples were presented to illustrate the application of these recommendations in clinical management. The consensus statements from this meeting could provide an important basis for tailoring treatment for patients with NSCLC who have actionable mutations, as well as pointing out key areas to explore in upcoming research.

papers.title_zh: 食管鳞癌免疫治疗相关肺炎的分层：基线系统性炎症与肺V20交互作用及列线图内部验证
papers.title_en: Risk stratification for immune-related pneumonitis in esophageal cancer: differential roles of systemic inflammation across severity grades and additive effect of radiation.
papers.authors: Qie S, Shi Y, Sun W, Wei Y
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Radiation Oncology, Affiliated Hospital of Hebei University, Baoding, Hebei, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: 基线系统性炎症与肺V20和后续CIP风险之间的关系存在异质性。这些发现支持一个假设生成性质的宿主-剂量学风险分层框架，但并未确立经验证的、可用于治疗调整的V20阈值。在临床应用前需要独立外部验证与机制研究。
papers.ai_note: 摘要未报告SII、胸部放疗、COPD、BMI及V20的HR与95%CI/P值，交互作用也无P值或效应量，具体风险估计信息不足。主要终点（grade≥2）全队列仅29例事件、放疗亚组20例，在此基础上做多组交互与建模，统计效能与过拟合风险存疑。列线图仅报告C-index与校正后C-index，无外部验证集表现。次要终点（grade≥1/≥3）事件数被并列突出，需注意其为次要终点。作者结论表述较为克制，未主张可操作阈值。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Immune checkpoint inhibition is increasingly integrated with thoracic radiotherapy in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC), but checkpoint inhibitor pneumonitis (CIP) remains a clinically important toxicity. Whether baseline systemic inflammation modifies the association between lung radiation dose and clinically significant CIP is unclear. METHODS: This single-center retrospective cohort included 268 patients with ESCC treated with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors; 154 subsequently received thoracic radiotherapy. Baseline systemic inflammation was assessed using the systemic immune-inflammation index (SII) from a complete blood count obtained within 7 days before the first immunotherapy dose. The primary endpoint was grade ≥2 CIP according to CTCAE v5.0; grade ≥1 and grade ≥3 CIP were secondary endpoints. Multivariable Cox models evaluated clinical risk factors, and SII-by-V20 interaction analyses were performed in the radiotherapy subgroup. The grade ≥2 nomogram underwent 10-fold cross-validation, 1,000-resample bootstrap validation/calibration, and decision-curve analysis. RESULTS: In the overall cohort, 77/268 (28.7%), 29/268 (10.8%), and 19/268 (7.1%) patients developed grade ≥1, grade ≥2, and grade ≥3 CIP, respectively. In the radiotherapy subgroup, the corresponding event counts were 54/154 (35.1%), 20/154 (13.0%), and 13/154 (8.4%). High SII, thoracic radiotherapy, and COPD were independently associated with CIP, while higher BMI was protective. The association of V20 with CIP was concentrated in the high-SII subgroup, with significant SII×V20 interactions across severity thresholds. The nomogram had a C-index of 0.758 (95% CI, 0.680-0.836); the mean 10-fold cross-validated C-index was 0.74 (95% CI, 0.69-0.79), and the bootstrap optimism-corrected C-index was 0.73. Calibration and decision-curve analyses supported acceptable internal performance and potential clinical utility. CONCLUSIONS: Baseline systemic inflammation was associated with heterogeneity in the relationship between lung V20 and subsequent CIP risk. These findings support a hypothesis-generating host-dosimetry framework for risk stratification but do not establish a validated V20 threshold for treatment modification. Independent external validation and mechanistic studies are required before clinical implementation.

papers.study_type: 系统综述（PRISMA 2020 / PROSPERO注册，QUADAS-2偏倚评估，因异质性行叙述性合成）

papers.title_zh: 胸片肺结节检测商业AI软件独立性能的系统综述：6项研究显示产品间性能差异显著，证据不足以支持整体独立部署
papers.title_en: Standalone commercial artificial intelligence software for pulmonary nodule detection on chest radiographs: a systematic review.
papers.authors: Srour A, Omar M, Barash Y, Litmanovich D, Srour M, Klang E, Gorenshtein A
papers.affiliation_highlight: BRIDGE GenAI Lab, Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, Boston, MA, USA.
papers.authors_conclusion: 在现有同行评议证据中，胸片肺结节检测的独立商业AI系统表现不一。现有证据不足以支持该类产品的整体独立部署，因所有研究均为回顾性或阅片研究，报告阈值不一致，且真实世界假阳性负担仍不确定。需要具有明确报告操作阈值、标准化比较设计与完整诊断性能的真实世界前瞻性评价。
papers.ai_note: 仅6项研究且异质性大，采用叙述性合成、无合并效应量，无法给出AI相对放射科医师的总体效应；'7个系统中4个显著优于平均AUC'来自单一研究的次要/亚组层面比较，摘要未给该比较的具体AUC或P值，不宜外推为类效应。偏倚风险（患者选择）普遍，纳入研究均为回顾性或阅片研究，操作阈值报告不一致，故性能区间0.79-0.93不可直接横向比较。结论本身为阴性/审慎结论，但作者同时引用了有利数值，需注意选择性强调。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Pulmonary nodules may be missed on chest radiographs despite their clinical relevance for early lung cancer detection. Commercial artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly available for chest radiograph interpretation, but evidence for their standalone performance remains fragmented across products, datasets, operating thresholds, and comparator designs. PURPOSE: To systematically evaluate the standalone diagnostic performance of commercially available AI software for pulmonary nodule detection on chest radiographs compared with radiologists reading alone, and to identify methodological factors shaping interpretation of the evidence. METHODS: A systematic review was conducted according to PRISMA 2020 guidelines and registered with PROSPERO (CRD420261383905). PubMed, PubMed Central, Scopus, and Web of Science were searched. Eligible studies evaluated commercially available AI systems as standalone detectors for pulmonary nodules on chest radiographs and directly compared their performance with radiologists reading alone using an accepted clinical reference standard. Risk of bias was assessed using an adapted QUADAS-2 framework. Findings were synthesized narratively because of heterogeneity in study design, populations, reference standards, operating thresholds, and outcome measures. RESULTS: Six studies met the inclusion criteria, comprising 12 product-level evaluations across 10 commercial AI systems. Standalone AI performance varied: some evaluations showed AI exceeding radiologist-level performance, others showed no significant difference, and one showed AI below individual reader performance with approximately twice the false-positive rate. In the only standardized within-study comparison of multiple commercial products on the same dataset, four of seven systems significantly exceeded mean radiologist AUC. Standalone AI AUC ranged from 0.79 to 0.93 against a mean reader AUC of 0.81 (95% CI 0.77-0.85), indicating that performance varied among cleared products even when tested under identical conditions. Interpretation was limited by differences in operating thresholds, comparator design, reference standards, study populations, and outcome reporting. Risk-of-bias concerns were common, particularly in patient selection. CONCLUSIONS: In the available peer-reviewed evidence, standalone commercial AI systems for chest radiograph pulmonary nodule detection show variable performance. Evidence remains insufficient to support class-wide standalone deployment because all studies were retrospective or reader-study based, thresholds were inconsistently reported, and real-world false-positive burden remains uncertain. Prospective real world evaluation with clearly reported operating thresholds, standardized comparator designs and complete diagnostic performance are needed.

papers.authors: Wu C, Wei J, Zhang F, Tan Y, Pang Y, Li L
papers.affiliation_highlight: School of Public Health, Guangdong Medical University, Dongguan, 523808, PR China.
papers.authors_conclusion: Logistic回归和LGB模型在外部验证中显示出有效的准确性和稳定性，其可视化与可解释性分析为NTM-PD与PTB的快速临床鉴别提供了辅助证据。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：方法学称以敏感度、特异度、AUC评估，但摘要仅报告AUC，未给敏感度/特异度、阈值及NTM-PD阳性率；训练集LGB显著优于LR（0.862 vs 0.714），但外部验证两者几乎无差异（0.798 vs 0.789，CI高度重叠），复杂模型增益未在外部体现，作者仍并列宣称两者均有效；未说明外部测试集数量、构成与划分方式，亦无内部交叉验证信息；标题称visual machine learning，但所用特征为支气管扩张、糖尿病、地理区域、职业等临床/流行病学变量，是否真正使用影像视觉数据不明确；AUC 0.80属中等区分度，临床上能否替代实验室鉴别未验证。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Nontuberculous mycobacteria (NTM) are opportunistic pathogens. In recent years, the incidence of NTM diseases has increased significantly worldwide. Nontuberculous mycobacterial pulmonary disease (NTM-PD) is highly similar to pulmonary tuberculosis (PTB) in clinical presentation, imaging features, and sputum smear microscopy results, which can easily cause misdiagnosis. Notably, there are significant differences between the anti-infective treatment regimens for NTM-PD and PTB; however, effective differential diagnostic methods are currently lacking, seriously limiting the standardized treatment of NTM diseases. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to distinguish NTM-PD from PTB using a visual machine learning approach. METHODS: This study employed a prospective cohort design to conduct prospective national surveillance of NTM-PD in 17 hospitals participating in the China Non-Tuberculous Mycobacteria Surveillance (CNTMS). A total of 6694 patients were included in the analysis, NTM-PD was considered a positive event. Visual models based on logistic regression (LR) and a gradient boosting framework using tree-based learning algorithms (LightGBM, LGB) were developed using important predictive features such as bronchiectasis, diabetes, and geographic region. Model performance was evaluated using sensitivity, specificity, and the area under the curve (AUC). Model predictions were interpreted using SHAP (a method that explains which features drive each prediction). RESULTS: Nine characteristics, including bronchodilation, diabetes, HIV, etc., were screened as key variables for distinguish NTM-PD and PTB. The AUC values of Logistic regression and LightGBM models in the training set were 0.714 (95%CI: 0.679 ~ 0.749) and 0.862 (95%CI: 0.843 ~ 0.882), respectively. In the two external test sets, the average AUC values of logistic regression model and LightGBM model were 0.789 (95%CI: 0.728-0.851) and 0.798 (95%CI: 0.743-0.851), respectively. Nomogram visualization identified bronchiectasis, HIV infection, COPD, and geographic region as the major contributors to the predictive score. SHAP visualization revealed geographic region, diabetes, and occupation as the most influential features for model prediction. CONCLUSIONS: Logistic regression and LGB models demonstrated effective accuracy and stability in external validation, and their visualization and interpretability analyses provide auxiliary evidence for the rapid clinical differentiation between NTM-PD and PTB.
