papers.title_en: Differential pathogenicity of three major Mycobacterium avium complex species causing pulmonary disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Dahl VN, Feise J, Pedersen AA, Idris R, Wetzstein N
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Infectious Diseases, Aarhus University Hospital, Aarhus, Denmark.
papers.authors_conclusion: M. avium和M. intracellulare在不同地域与临床表现及治疗结局方面相关性相当，而M. chimaera与临床相关性较低的疾病相关；改进的分子菌种鉴别或可进一步阐明MAC-PD中菌种特异性致病性及其临床意义。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要称三者结局'相似/相当'，但未给出任何95%CI、P值或正式组间比较，无法判断是否做过等效或非劣效检验，阴性结论缺乏统计支撑。M. chimaera组仅582例，与另两组（28858/17540例）样本量悬殊，比例估计稳定性存疑。M. chimaera患者'更少接受治疗'构成明显治疗选择偏倚，其较低的治疗相关指标不能与另两组直接比较，而摘要仍将三者结局并列呈现。死亡率等数值仅给出跨菌种范围（14.2–19.3%），未标明菌种归属。合并比例来自异质性观察性研究，临床相关性定义在原始研究间可能不统一，摘要未报告异质性（I²）指标。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Mycobacterium avium complex (MAC) species are the leading causes of nontuberculous mycobacterial pulmonary disease worldwide. However, the clinical relevance and species-specific manifestations of MAC pulmonary disease (MAC-PD) caused by M. avium, M. intracellulare and M. chimaera remain incompletely understood. OBJECTIVE: To compare the clinical relevance, radiological manifestations and treatment outcomes associated with M. avium, M. intracellulare and M. chimaera pulmonary disease. METHODS: We performed a systematic review and meta-analysis of studies published between 2006 and 2 March 2026, identified through PubMed, Embase and Web of Science. Studies reporting adult patients with pulmonary isolates of M. avium, M. intracellulare or M. chimaera were included. Random-effects meta-analyses were conducted to estimate pooled proportions for clinical relevance, radiological manifestations, treatment success, culture conversion, relapse and mortality. RESULTS: A total of 134 studies comprising 46 980 patients were included, of whom 28 858 had M. avium, 17 540 had M. intracellulare and 582 had M. chimaera. Clinical relevance was comparable for M. avium and M. intracellulare (53.8% versus 54.7%) but lower for M. chimaera (17.8%). Nodular bronchiectatic disease predominated across all species. Treatment success (63.0-67.5%), culture conversion (70.8-71.9%), relapse (27.9-29.1%) and mortality (14.2-19.3%) were similar between M. avium and M. intracellulare. However, patients with M. chimaera were less frequently treated. CONCLUSIONS: M. avium and M. intracellulare were associated with comparable clinical relevance, disease manifestations and treatment outcomes across geographic regions, whereas M. chimaera was associated with less clinically relevant disease. Improved molecular species differentiation may further clarify species-specific pathogenicity and clinical implications in MAC-PD.

papers.journal_full: Annals of the American Thoracic Society
papers.study_type: 单中心（SIS队列）回顾性观察性队列研究 · 全因死亡Cox回归与性别×严重程度交互及年龄分层分析
papers.title_zh: 阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停患者全因死亡的性别差异：重度OSA中男性死亡风险更高，而≤50岁女性死亡风险更高
papers.title_en: Sex-specific differences in mortality in obstructive sleep apnea: results from the Sleep Apnea Patients in Skaraborg (SIS) Study.
papers.authors: Peker Y, Holtstrand Hjälm H, Thunström E, Glantz H, Pihtili A, Eulenburg C
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pulmonary Medicine, Koc University School of Medicine, Istanbul, Türkiye.
papers.authors_conclusion: Mortality risk among patients with OSA varied according to sex, age, and OSA severity. Our findings suggest potentially distinct risk patterns, with higher mortality observed among younger women and among older men with severe OSA. The findings in younger patients should be interpreted cautiously because of the limited number of events.
papers.ai_note: 总体性别×OSA严重程度交互p=0.110未达统计学显著，重度OSA男性HR 1.50的显著性应在此背景下审慎解读；摘要未报告性别差异的总体（合并严重程度）校正HR，仅给粗死亡率10.0% vs 11.4%，女性OSA严重程度更低但死亡率与男性接近这一点未被多变量模型直接量化。年龄分层为事后/多层切分（≤50与>50岁×三个严重程度），≤50岁组事件数有限（作者亦承认），HR 0.34的CI宽且存在多重比较问题，属探索性发现。治疗获益HR 0.52来自非随机观察性数据，治疗状态定义、依从性与指征混杂（健康使用者偏倚）摘要未说明，不能作因果解读；该结果为摘要中数值最显著的条目，存在以次要/观察性分析吸引注意的倾向。信息不足：治疗组与非治疗组的样本量与事件数、OSA患者来源与纳入年份、是否校正治疗本身。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Sex differences in mortality among patients with obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) remain incompletely understood. METHODS: We analyzed data from the Sleep Apnea Patients in Skaraborg (SIS) Study, including adult patients with OSA defined as an apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) ≥5 events/hour. OSA severity was classified as mild (AHI 5-14.9), moderate (AHI 15-29.9) or severe (AHI ≥30). All-cause mortality was assessed over a median follow-up of 5.9 (interquartile range 4.6-7.2) years using multivariable Cox regression adjusted for age, obesity, current smoking status, diabetes mellitus, Epworth Sleepiness Scale score, hypertension, cardiovascular disease, and cerebrovascular disease. Interaction between sex and OSA severity was tested, and analyses were stratified by age (≤50 and >50 years). RESULTS: The cohort comprised 3,843 patients with 421 deaths. Despite lower OSA severity, women had an overall mortality of 10.0% (120/1,203), compared with 11.4% (301/2,640) in men. Men had higher mortality than women in severe OSA (HR 1.50; 95% confidence interval (CI) [1.09; 2.05]; p = 0.011), whereas no sex differences were observed in mild and moderate OSA (HR 0.95; 95% CI [0.61; 1.50]; p = 0.850 and 1.09; 95%CI [0.73; 1.63]; p = 0.662; interaction p = 0.110) . In age-stratified analyses, among patients ≤50 years, women demonstrated higher mortality than men irrespective of the severity of OSA (HR for men versus women 0.34; 95%CI [0.14; 0.87]; p = 0.024), while among patients >50 years, men with severe OSA had the highest mortality risk (HR 1.58; 95%CI [1.15; 2.18]; p = 0.005). Treatment was associated with reduced mortality in patients >50 years (HR 0.52; 95%CI [0.40; 0.67]; p < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: Mortality risk among patients with OSA varied according to sex, age, and OSA severity. Our findings suggest potentially distinct risk patterns, with higher mortality observed among younger women and among older men with severe OSA. The findings in younger patients should be interpreted cautiously because of the limited number of events.

papers.journal_full: The New England journal of medicine
papers.study_type: Phase 2 随机对照试验（贝叶斯优效性筛选设计，以培养时间阳性斜率为替代终点，用于方案遴选而非确证疗效）
papers.title_zh: 利福平敏感性肺结核10种新四药联合方案的II期随机筛选：两种方案（含ganfeborole或BTZ-043）在培养转阴速率这一替代终点上显示优效概率，但疗效未获确证
papers.title_en: Assessing Multiple Treatment Regimens for Tuberculosis.
papers.authors: Esmail H, Paton NI, Schildkraut JA, Motta I, Szubert AJ, Dufault SM, Heinrich N, Tiberi S et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: UCL Innovative Clinical Trials Unit, University College London, London.
papers.authors_conclusion: In this trial, two four-drug regimens, one with ganfeborole and one with BTZ-043, showed evidence of potential efficacy and a safety profile that did not preclude progression to further evaluation.
papers.ai_note: 主要终点为培养转阳时间斜率这一替代指标，作者自述结果用于方案遴选而非疗效确证，不能外推为临床疗效结论；共评估10种新方案却仅报告入选的2种，存在选择性报告与多重比较风险；BPMG优效后验概率0.83且相对差异95%可信区间（-8.6至29.0）跨越0，仍被列为'promising'，属阈值偏松的选择性强调；BPMG的≥3级不良事件率38%高于HRZE的24%，安全性优势不明显；无临床治愈率、复发率或死亡率等硬终点数据。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Ganfeborole and BTZ-043 are new drugs that may improve tuberculosis treatment. METHODS: In this phase 2, randomized, controlled trial, we assigned participants with rifampin-susceptible pulmonary tuberculosis to receive the standard four-drug combination (isoniazid-rifampin-pyrazinamide-ethambutol; HRZE) for 24 weeks; bedaquiline-delamanid-moxifloxacin for 16 weeks; or one of 10 new four-drug combinations for 16 weeks. The new regimens contained ganfeborole, BTZ-043, or both, with combinations of bedaquiline, delamanid, moxifloxacin, pyrazinamide, pretomanid, and linezolid. The primary end point was the log10(time to positivity) slope (rate of change from baseline to week 12 in the time to Mycobacterium tuberculosis growth in a positive sputum culture). The treatment effect was assessed as the Bayesian posterior probability of superiority of each new regimen to HRZE with respect to the primary end point (results were used to select regimens for further evaluation, rather than for characterization of efficacy). RESULTS: A total of 401 participants underwent randomization; 371 were included in the modified intention-to-treat population and 400 in the safety population. We identified two promising regimens for further evaluation: ganfeborole-bedaquiline-pretomanid-moxifloxacin (BPMG) and BTZ-043-bedaquiline-delamanid-moxifloxacin (BDMT). The log10(time to positivity) slope was 0.129 log10(days) per week (95% Bayesian credible interval, 0.112 to 0.146) with BPMG and 0.142 log10(days) per week (95% Bayesian credible interval, 0.126 to 0.160) with BDMT, as compared with 0.118 log10(days) per week (95% Bayesian credible interval, 0.105 to 0.131) with HRZE, for a relative difference of 9.1% (95% Bayesian credible interval, -8.6 to 29.0) and 20.5% (95% Bayesian credible interval, 2.7 to 41.1), respectively, and a posterior probability of superiority of 0.83 and 0.99. The incidence of adverse events of grade 3 or higher was 38% in the BPMG group (none of the participants discontinued), 28% in the BDMT group (one discontinued because of a drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms), and 24% in the HRZE group (none discontinued). Bedaquiline-moxifloxacin-pyrazinamide-BTZ-043 was discontinued because of hepatotoxic effects. CONCLUSIONS: In this trial, two four-drug regimens, one with ganfeborole and one with BTZ-043, showed evidence of potential efficacy and a safety profile that did not preclude progression to further evaluation. (Funded by Innovative Medicines Initiative 2 Joint Undertaking and others; PARADIGM4TB ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06114628.).

papers.study_type: RCT二次分析 · 纵向蛋白质组学与机制探索
papers.title_zh: COVID-19炎症蛋白轨迹与重度呼吸衰竭：SAVE-MORE随机试验的二次分析
papers.title_en: Inflammatory protein trajectories and severe respiratory failure in COVID-19: a secondary analysis of the SAVE-MORE randomised trial.
papers.authors: Keur N, Stylianakis E, Ricaño-Ponce I, Rapti V, Milionis H, Metallidis S, Adamis G, Fragkou A et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Internal Medicine and Radboud Center for Infectious Diseases, Radboud University Medical Center, Nijmegen,…
papers.authors_conclusion: SRF进展涉及细胞因子、趋化因子、组织损伤和免疫检查点通路的炎症放大程序。anakinra治疗与炎症放大相关蛋白及呼吸恶化伴随急性炎症变化的较小改变相关。这些发现为SAVE-MORE试验中观察到的临床获益提供了生物学背景。
papers.ai_note: 本研究为机制性二次分析，非主要疗效终点；基线IL-6在两组HR相近（1·99 vs 2·12），提示预后标志物而非疗效预测标志物，但摘要未明确讨论此区分。PD-L1仅安慰剂组显著可能与样本量差异（187 vs 400）有关，摘要未提及该组间效力差异。轨迹和event-aligned分析缺少具体效应量和P值，仅有方向性描述。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Severe COVID-19 is characterised by maladaptive host inflammation. In the SAVE-MORE trial (EudraCT no. 2020-005828-11; ClinicalTrials.gov NCT04680949), suPAR-guided anakinra treatment reduced mortality and progression to severe respiratory failure (SRF), but the underlying molecular mechanisms remain unclear. METHODS: We performed longitudinal proteomic profiling (Olink Inflammation panel, 67 proteins) in 587 SAVE-MORE participants (400 treated with anakinra and 187 with placebo), of whom 453 had samples at all three time points (baseline, Day 4, and Day 7). Analyses aimed to (i) identify baseline predictors of SRF, (ii) define inflammatory trajectories using mixed-effects models, and (iii) characterise proteomic changes at SRF onset. Cox models identified prognostic markers, validated in an independent anakinra-treated cohort from the SAVE trial (n = 153). FINDINGS: Multivariate Cox regression models adjusted for sex, age, BMI, and dexamethasone treatment showed that baseline IL-6 concentrations predicted SRF across both treatment arms (placebo HR = 1·99, CI: 1·31-3·02; anakinra HR = 2·12, CI: 1·56-2·87), while PD-L1 predicted SRF only in the placebo group (HR = 2·75, CI: 1·79-4·24). Anakinra allocation was associated with changes in inflammatory trajectories related to SRF progression. Patients developing SRF showed sustained activation marked by elevated concentrations of IL-6, MCP-1/3, EN-RAGE, and PD-L1, whereas SRF-free patients had higher levels of proteins linked to regulatory and adaptive immunity, including CD6, CD244, TRAIL, TNF-B, and FLT3L. Event-aligned analyses showed an acute inflammatory surge at SRF onset involving IL-6, CXCL5, OSM, and VEGFA, which was significantly attenuated by anakinra. Results were further confirmed in the SAVE cohort. INTERPRETATION: Progression to SRF was associated with an inflammatory amplification programme involving cytokine, chemokine, tissue-injury, and immune-checkpoint pathways. Anakinra allocation was associated with smaller changes in proteins associated with inflammatory amplification and acute inflammatory changes accompanying respiratory deterioration. These findings provide biological context for the clinical benefit observed in the SAVE-MORE trial. FUNDING: Hellenic Institute for the Study of Sepsis (sponsor) and Swedish Orphan Biovitrum (funder).

papers.study_type: 功能基因组学研究 · 肺-肿瘤配对组织扩展eQTL分析结合NSCLC术后生存/复发全基因组Cox回归GWAS
papers.title_zh: 种系变异对肺-肿瘤转录转换的贡献减弱，但鉴定出与NSCLC术后复发和生存相关的位点
papers.title_en: Germline variants affect lung-to-tumor transcription dynamics and NSCLC outcomes.
papers.authors: Mathieu S, Gaudreault N, Renaut S, Saavedra Armero V, Boudreau DK, Tremblay E, Li Z, Abolfathi H et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Institut universitaire de cardiologie et de pneumologie de Québec - Université Laval, Pavillon Marguerite-d'Youville, Y2…
papers.authors_conclusion: 肺到肿瘤的转录组转换的特征是种系变异贡献减弱；差异eQTL揭示了肺与肿瘤组织间基因表达的差异，提示候选癌症相关基因与通路，并确定了GWAS位点背后的靶基因
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未报告任何生存/复发GWAS位点的HR、效应值、CI或P值，也未提及独立验证队列，无法判断6p22.3-MBOAT1与16p13.3-RBFOX1的统计稳健性；标题强调'影响NSCLC结局'，但结果部分仅列出位点名称而无结局关联强度；'约低三倍'为唯一量化结果，且未给出肿瘤与肺组织eQTL的绝对数量；预后位点与复发位点的具体对应关系在摘要中未交代
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The influence of germline genetics on the molecular transition from lung to tumor and different transcriptional patterns of tumors remains underexplored. Additionally, little is known about the genetic contributions to lung cancer relapse and mortality following surgery. METHODS: The transcriptional transition from non-affected lung tissue to tumor was investigated using an extended eQTL approach. Associations between variants and expression differences in tumors relative to matched surrounding lung tissue were examined in 515 surgical cases of lung adenocarcinoma. We also used Cox regression in a genome-wide association study to identify variants associated with survival (n = 3472) and relapse (n = 3369) in patients with NSCLC. RESULTS: The number of significant eQTL was approximately threefold lower in tumor than in lung tissue. Variants that showed differential cis-regulatory control on expression between lung and tumor tissues were more frequently located in bivalent or distal regulatory elements. Those variants altered the transcription factor binding landscape and the expression of genes that are differentially expressed in tumors. Co-expression modules derived from WGCNA identified module-QTLs and putative regulatory signaling genes (CDK15, CD79B, CCDC80, and SCARA5) involved in immunity and mesenchymal cell fate. Differential eQTLs for three genes (NRG1, SECISBP2L, and JAML) colocalized with GWAS-nominated lung cancer risk loci. Prognostic lung cancer loci identified 6p22.3-MBOAT1 and 16p13.3-RBFOX1. CONCLUSIONS: The lung-to-tumor transcriptomic transition is characterized by an attenuated contribution of germline variants. Differential eQTLs inform differences in gene expression between lung and tumor tissues, implicate putative cancer-related genes and pathways, and identify target genes underlying GWAS loci.

papers.study_type: 单中心前后瞻性（ambispective）观察性比较队列 · 24周主要终点分析
papers.title_zh: 托珠单抗用于风湿病相关间质性肺病急性加重（AE-RD-ILD）的单中心前后瞻观察性队列：24周研究者定义复合临床应答率80.8% vs 13.9%，但为非随机设计且人群以抗合成酶综合征为主
papers.title_en: Tocilizumab for acute exacerbation of rheumatic disease-associated interstitial lung disease: a real-world comparative cohort study.
papers.authors: Xu W, Ma Y, Zhang D, Wu W, Sun S, Guo R, Chen Z, Fu Y et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Rheumatology, Renji Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine, Shanghai, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: 托珠单抗与AE-RD-ILD更高的短期客观复合临床应答及改善的呼吸和糖皮质激素节约结局相关；这些发现支持在选定患者中进一步评估IL-6受体阻断，但非随机设计与研究者自定义终点需谨慎解读；因队列主要由抗合成酶谱系疾病患者构成，发现主要适用于该表型，不应不加警惕地外推至RA-ILD、SSc-ILD或其他RD-ILD亚型。
papers.ai_note: 主要终点为研究者自定义、未经验证的客观复合临床应答，且固定时点（24周）二分类终点却报告HR，指标解释存疑；非随机设计下适应证混杂未充分排除（对照组7例后续改用托珠单抗提示治疗选择与疾病严重度/难治性相关），敏感性分析虽提及但摘要未给出具体混杂变量与残余偏倚评估；样本量小（26 vs 36），死亡/移植与新发AE等硬终点未达统计学差异，长期结局证据不足；感染安全性比较把握度低（p=0.272），不能据此认为安全性等同或更优；人群以抗合成酶谱系为主，外推性受限（作者已自述）。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Acute exacerbation of rheumatic disease-associated interstitial lung disease (AE-RD-ILD) is life-threatening and is commonly managed with high-dose corticosteroids; however, no standardised evidence-based regimen has been established, particularly regarding adjunctive immunosuppressive therapy. We evaluated the effectiveness and safety of tocilizumab, an interleukin-6 receptor inhibitor, in hospitalised patients with AE-RD-ILD. METHODS: In this single-centre ambispective observational cohort study conducted between January 2023 and December 2024, patients treated with tocilizumab (n=26) were compared with controls receiving corticosteroid-based conventional immunosuppression without tocilizumab (n=36). The primary outcome was investigator-defined objective composite clinical response (CR) at 24 weeks. Secondary outcomes included glucocorticoid exposure, oxygen discontinuation, radiological change, new acute exacerbation (AE) events, death or lung transplantation, and safety. RESULTS: The 24-week CR rate was higher with tocilizumab than in controls (80.8% [21/26] vs. 13.9% [5/36], p<0.001), with a risk ratio of 5.82 (95% CI 2.52-13.40) and an adjusted hazard ratio of 10.43 (95% CI 3.71-29.28); estimates were consistent in sensitivity analyses addressing competing risks, guarantee-time bias and additional confounders. Tocilizumab was associated with lower cumulative prednisone dose (3955 vs. 5005 mg, p=0.016), lower minimum maintenance dose (10.0 vs. 15.0 mg/day, p<0.001), more frequent oxygen discontinuation (76.9% vs. 30.6%, p<0.001), and greater CT-assessed reduction in ILD extent (20% vs. 15%, p=0.045). New AE events and death or lung transplantation were numerically less frequent but not statistically significant. At least one infection occurred in 23.1% of tocilizumab-treated patients and 38.9% of controls (p=0.272). During longer follow-up, seven controls subsequently switched to tocilizumab because of recurrent or progressive respiratory disease. CONCLUSIONS: Tocilizumab was associated with higher short-term objective composite clinical response and improved respiratory and glucocorticoid-sparing outcomes in AE-RD-ILD. These findings support further evaluation of interleukin-6 receptor blockade in selected patients, while the non-randomised design and investigator-defined endpoint require cautious interpretation. Because the cohort was predominantly composed of patients with anti-synthetase-spectrum disease, the findings primarily apply to this phenotype and should not be extrapolated to RA-ILD, SSc-ILD or other RD-ILD subtypes without caution.

papers.study_type: PDX模型转录组分型（NMF聚类+随机森林投影）的临床前研究
papers.category_label: 局晚期与晚期靶向/免疫
papers.title_zh: 对146个SCLC患者来源异种移植模型做NMF转录组分析，划分出8个生物学亚组并可投影至小鼠模型、细胞系及IMpower133患者数据
papers.title_en: Transcriptional analyses of patient derived xenograft models reveal distinct subsets of small cell lung cancer.
papers.authors: Fatherree JP, Hippe DS, Jenkins I, Hiatt JB, Wu F, Qian W, Chen X, Simpson KL et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Human Biology Division, Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center, Seattle, WA 98109, USA.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未给出与IMpower133患者应答相关联的任何效应量、CI或P值，仅称可将PDX亚组与特定模型和患者应答相联系，无法判断关联强度与统计学意义；随机森林分类器在外部数据上的投影未描述验证集/交叉验证与分类性能指标，存在过拟合与人群限定松动风险；全部证据为临床前模型推断，未验证其对患者治疗决策的影响。
papers.abstract_en: Small-cell lung cancer (SCLC) is a neuroendocrine carcinoma characterized by early metastasis, rapid emergence of therapy resistance, and dismal patient outcomes. SCLC subtypes have been proposed based on expression of lineage transcription factors ASCL1, NEUROD1, and POU2F3 and the level of inflammation. To further discern biologically distinct subsets, we apply non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) to gene expression data from 146 SCLC patient-derived xenograft (PDX) models. We identify three ASCL1-dominant and three NEUROD1-dominant subsets, an ASCL1/NEUROD1 co-active subset, and a REST-active low-neuroendocrine subset. These subsets differ in MYC family expression, transcription factor activation, antigen presentation transcriptional programs, and expression of cell surface molecules that represent therapeutic targets. Using a random forest classifier, we project these clusters onto 7 genetic mouse models of SCLC, human cell lines, and patient data from the IMpower133 clinical trial, allowing us to link PDX-derived subsets to specific murine and cellular models and to patient responses.

papers.study_type: 肺癌细胞系碱基编辑高通量突变筛选（体外/细胞内验证 + 结构分析）· 非临床研究
papers.category_label: 局晚期与晚期靶向/免疫
papers.title_zh: SHP2碱基编辑饱和突变筛选绘制肺癌细胞中对migoprotafib与TNO155耐药的突变图谱，并提示肿瘤中存在可能介导内在耐药的预存变异
papers.title_en: Base editor tiling of the PTPN11 gene identifies resistance variants to SHP2 inhibitors.
papers.authors: Ravichandran M, Dorighi KM, Martinez OE, Sodir NM, Zhu A, Passang T, Li Z, John C et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Translational Oncology, Genentech, Inc., South San Francisco, CA 94080, USA.
papers.authors_conclusion: Our study provides a comprehensive map of SHP2 mutations that reduce inhibitor sensitivity and identifies pre-existing variants that may confer intrinsic resistance to allosteric inhibitors in patients.
papers.ai_note: 全部证据为临床前筛选与生物信息学交叉比对，无任何患者疗效或耐药发生率数据；'may confer intrinsic resistance to patients' 属外推，信息不足。筛选富集突变与肿瘤突变的重叠为观察性关联，不能证明这些变异在患者中导致耐药；部分突变对TNO155比migoprotafib耐药升高为定性描述，摘要无定量数值。
papers.abstract_en: SHP2, a tyrosine phosphatase and key modulator of oncogenic signaling pathways, has emerged as a promising cancer target, but the impact of SHP2 mutations on therapy response remains unclear. Here we perform high-throughput mutagenic base editor screens in lung cancer cells to identify SHP2 mutations conferring resistance to migoprotafib and TNO155. Our screens identify numerous gain-of-function mutations associated with Noonan syndrome and various malignancies. Most resistance mutations overlap between inhibitors, although some exhibit elevated resistance to TNO155 compared to migoprotafib. Cross-referencing comprehensive genomic profiling data from predominantly advanced, SHP2 inhibitor-naive tumors reveals significant overlap between screen-enriched and tumor-associated mutations. We validate select mutations using in vitro and in cellulo assays and perform structural analyses to gain insights into the mechanisms driving resistance. Our study provides a comprehensive map of SHP2 mutations that reduce inhibitor sensitivity and identifies pre-existing variants that may confer intrinsic resistance to allosteric inhibitors in patients.

papers.study_type: 单中心前瞻性观察性诊断验证研究（含scan-rescan重复性评估）
papers.title_zh: 0.55T相位分辨功能肺MRI可量化通气与灌注缺损并区分肺病患者与对照，但缺金标准验证且重复性指标参差
papers.title_en: Phase-resolved Functional Lung MRI at 0.55 T for Evaluation of Ventilation and Perfusion in Pulmonary Disease.
papers.authors: Capaldi DPI, Baria D, Deo P, Lee YJ, Su P, Miao X, Grimm R, Voskrebenzev A et al.

papers.abstract_en: Purpose To evaluate ventilation and perfusion in control participants and individuals with lung disease using 0.55-T phase-resolved functional lung (PREFUL) MRI. Materials and Methods In this prospective study at a single academic institution, multisection free-breathing hydrogen 1 MRI was performed with a 0.55-T scanner with a balanced steady-state free precession sequence. PREFUL analysis was used to quantify the ventilation-defect-percentage (VDP), perfusion-defect-percentage (QDP), and ventilation-perfusion-mismatch (VQM) defects. Scan-rescan repeatability was assessed in 42 participants. Statistical analyses included nonparametric group comparisons and correlations with pulmonary function test (PFT) parameters. Results A total of 67 participants (mean age ± SD: 51 years ± 19; 32 female) were enrolled between November 2022 and March 2024, including 38 with different lung diseases, some with multiple underlying diagnoses (obstructive = 20, vascular = 9, fibrotic = 14, cancer = 34 and other = 23), and 29 control participants. Compared with control participants, individuals with lung disease had greater QDP (17% vs 11%; P = .02), VDP (30% vs 22%; P = .003), and VQM defects (7% vs 3%; P = .002). VDP and VQM defects were correlated with PFT measurements, including forced expiratory volume in 1 second (ρ = -0.59, P < .001; ρ = -0.50, P = .001), forced vital capacity (ρ = -0.53, P = .005; ρ = -0.49, P = .01), and diffusing capacity of the lung for carbon monoxide (ρ = -0.53, P = .02; ρ = -0.52, P = .02). Scan-rescan analysis revealed minimal bias (P = .06-0.3), coefficients of variation between 10.1% and 37.8%, and intraclass correlation coefficients of 0.64-0.90 for the three MRI metrics. Conclusion 0.55-T PREFUL MRI provides a reproducible, noninvasive method for quantifying ventilation and perfusion defects and effectively distinguishes individuals with lung disease from control participants. Keywords: MR-Functional Lung Imaging, Thorax, Lung Supplemental material is available for this article. © RSNA, 2026.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The aim of this study is to quantitatively describe the characteristics of disease progression and its influencing factors in the placebo group of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis clinical trials, and to provide evidence for the optimal design of clinical trials. METHODS: PubMed, Embase and Cochrane Library were searched for placebo-randomized controlled trials on IPF up to November 12, 2024. We conducted a time-course modeling analysis of the placebo group based on commonly reported evaluation indicators in clinical trials. Using the established model, we simulated the distribution of the placebo effect for each index under various conditions and applied this to provide a quantitative external control. RESULTS: A total of 32 studies were included. Common evaluation measures in clinical trials include all-cause mortality, forced vital capacity (FVC), 6-minute walk distance (6MWD) and Diffusing Capacity of the Lung for Carbon Monoxide (DLCO). Based on the final model, this study simulated typical effect sizes after different times of placebo intervention. Subgroup analysis showed that background treatment and gender also showed consistent trends in the effects on the above efficacy indicators. The potential utility of this model in drug effectiveness evaluation is demonstrated through a preliminary case study. CONCLUSIONS: This study established a disease progression model for the placebo group based on common evaluation indicators in IPF clinical trials. This model helps conserve valuable clinical resources for rare diseases and promotes the development of new drugs. STUDY REGISTRATION: The study strictly followed the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines (Supplementary Material) and was registered in the International Prospective Register of Systematic Reviews (PROSPERO) (registration ID: CRD42024557923).

papers.abstract_en: The ribosome, long considered an invariant actor of gene expression, recently emerged as a contributor to translational control through chemical modifications of ribosomal RNAs (rRNAs). These modifications are guided by small nucleolar RNAs (snoRNAs), which direct modifying enzymes to specific rRNA positions. Here, we report that lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) cells that are resistant to tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs) reshape both their translational program and rRNA 2'O-ribose methylation (2'Ome) profiles. EML4-ALK-positive LUAD cells that are resistant to crizotinib (ALK inhibitor) exhibit reduced global protein synthesis and a change in selective translation of mRNAs, encoding proteins previously linked to resistance. These cells show concomitant reduction in SNORD104 and 2'Ome at its associated 28S_Cm1327 position. Functional studies reveal that SNORD104 depletion abolishes 2'Ome at 28S_Cm1327 without affecting basal translation or cell viability, but enhances both under crizotinib exposure. Moreover, SNORD104 knockdown attenuates caspase activation and PARP cleavage during treatment, supporting reduced cell death. Altogether, our findings support a role for snoRNA-guided rRNA modification as a novel non-genomic mechanism in early adaptive responses to crizotinib therapy in LUAD.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Intensive smoking cessation interventions (I-SCIs) are among the most effective approaches to smoking cessation. Although socioeconomic inequalities in smoking are well-established, smoking cessation outcomes among detailed educational and employment subgroups receiving I-SCI remain poorly understood. Therefore, this study aimed to examine smoking cessation outcomes by educational attainment and employment status among participants receiving I-SCI. METHODS: This nationwide prospective cohort study was conducted in Denmark and included participants aged ≥18 years from the Danish STOPbase who received an I-SCI between January 2006 and June 2023. I-SCI comprised a structured behavioural and educational smoking cessation programme of ≥5-sessions, including pharmaceutical therapy. The primary outcome was continuous cessation from smoking at 6 months, self-reported by structured interviews. RESULTS: Among 101,549 participants, 34.1% achieved abstinence at 6-months. Cessation rates showed a clear educational gradient, ranging from 38.5% among participants with long-term education to 28.2% among those with no education or primary school education. After adjustment, participants with no education or primary school education were less likely to achieve smoking cessation (risk ratio (RR), 0.76 [95% confidence interval (CI): 0.70-0.83]). Employment status was also associated with smoking cessation outcomes, although the pattern was less consistent and did not show a clear socioeconomic gradient. CONCLUSION: Higher educational attainment was consistently associated with greater continuous smoking cessation success after I-SCI, whereas associations with employment status were more heterogeneous. Educational attainment showed a clearer socioeconomic gradient in cessation outcomes than employment status, although residual confounding factors and health-selection effects may have influenced the observed associations.

papers.abstract_en: Acute lung injury (ALI) is a severe inflammatory disorder with limited effective targeted therapies. Macrophage-associated ferroptotic stress contributes significantly to uncontrolled pulmonary inflammation, making it a promising therapeutic target for ALI treatment. Here, we report biomimetic macrophage membrane-coated hesperetin (HST)-magnesium (Mg2 +) nanoparticles (MM@HST-Mg NPs) that integrate inflammation-targeted delivery with ferroptosis modulation for the treatment of lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced ALI. The macrophage membrane coating enabled MM@HST-Mg NPs preferentially accumulate in inflamed lungs and be predominantly taken up by pulmonary macrophages. Compared with free HST or HST-Mg, MM@HST-Mg NPs exhibited superior therapeutic efficacy. They alleviated macrophage-associated ferroptotic stress by scavenging reactive oxygen species (ROS), reducing intracellular Fe2 + accumulation, suppressing lipid peroxidation, and activating the Nrf2/HO-1/GPX4 antioxidant pathway. Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) demonstrated that Mg2 + coordination enhanced the interaction between HST and Nrf2. Furthermore, Nrf2 knockdown and pharmacological inhibition confirmed that the anti-ferroptotic and macrophage-reprogramming effects of MM@HST-Mg NPs were largely dependent on Nrf2 signaling. These coordinated effects promoted macrophage polarization toward an anti-inflammatory phenotype, attenuated pulmonary inflammation, and effectively protected mice against LPS-induced ALI following early intervention. Overall, this study establishes a biomimetic macrophage-targeted nanoplatform for ferroptosis modulation and provides a rational strategy for developing immunoregulatory nanomedicines for acute inflammatory lung injury.

papers.title_en: Functional lung imaging in COPD: from disease characterisation to decision-making in bronchoscopic lung volume reduction.
papers.authors: Wu J, Zhang Y, Chen Y, Wang H, Huang H, Shi H, Dong Y, Bai C et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Respiratory and Critical Care Medicine, The First Affiliated Hospital of Naval Medical University, Shangha…
papers.authors_conclusion: In this review, we propose that the key clinical question is not how much lung is diseased, but which regions meaningfully contribute to overall function and which may be safely excluded. These regional insights are particularly relevant to lung volume reduction, where treatment effect depends on selecting targets with high mechanical burden and low gas exchange contribution. We review imaging-derived surrogates of regional aeration, ventilation, perfusion and gas transfer in COPD and synthesise them into an efficiency-based decision framework for bronchoscopic lung volume reduction, linking imaging findings with physiological interpretation and therapeutic decision-making.

papers.abstract_en: COPD is characterised by pronounced regional heterogeneity in structural damage and functional impairment, leading to substantial variability in symptoms and treatment response among patients with similar spirometric severity. Conventional pulmonary function tests rely on patient cooperation and provide global measures of airflow limitation, which incompletely capture regional abnormalities and may be difficult to perform or interpret in patients with advanced disease or limited ability to cooperate. Imaging-based assessment provides objective, effort-independent, spatially resolved evaluation that complements global pulmonary function tests. Quantitative imaging allows characterisation of emphysema distribution, small-airway dysfunction, air trapping, collateral ventilation, and regional perfusion, enabling identification of physiologically inefficient and potentially dispensable lung regions. In this review, we propose that the key clinical question is not how much lung is diseased, but which regions meaningfully contribute to overall function and which may be safely excluded. These regional insights are particularly relevant to lung volume reduction, where treatment effect depends on selecting targets with high mechanical burden and low gas exchange contribution. We review imaging-derived surrogates of regional aeration, ventilation, perfusion and gas transfer in COPD and synthesise them into an efficiency-based decision framework for bronchoscopic lung volume reduction, linking imaging findings with physiological interpretation and therapeutic decision-making.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) is an aggressive malignancy with dismal prognosis, primarily attributed to substantial tumor heterogeneity. Although the cytoskeleton is critically implicated in cancer progression, a comprehensive characterization of cytoskeleton-related prognostic genes in ESCC is still absent. METHODS: Bulk transcriptome data from public repositories were integrated with a single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) dataset for comprehensive analysis. Cytoskeleton-related candidate genes were screened by intersecting differentially expressed genes with a curated cytoskeleton-related gene (CRG) list, and expression findings were experimentally corroborated in clinical specimens via real-time quantitative PCR (RT-qPCR). Independent prognostic genes were subsequently determined through univariate and multivariate Cox regression analyses and incorporated into a risk model, which was subsequently evaluated in two external cohorts. Additional analyses covered functional enrichment, immune infiltration profiling, drug sensitivity estimation, mutational landscape characterization, and single-cell-level investigations of inferred metabolic pathway activity, intercellular communication, and differentiation trajectories. RESULTS: A total of 222 cytoskeleton-related candidate genes were identified. Among these, three genes -GABARAPL2, PDLIM2, and PPP2R2A - were established as independent prognostic factors and incorporated into a robust risk-scoring model. This model reliably partitioned patients into high- and low-risk groups with markedly divergent survival outcomes, and a similar association between the risk score and survival was observed in two external cohorts. The high-risk group exhibited distinct estimated immune infiltration, immune checkpoint expression, somatic mutation, and predicted drug sensitivity profiles. scRNA-seq analysis characterized the distribution of the prognostic genes across cell types and supported the selection of T cells for further exploratory analyses of metabolism, intercellular communication, and differentiation trajectories. CONCLUSION: This multi-omics integrative study identified and validated a CRG signature with potential prognostic value in ESCC and revealed its associations with immune microenvironment features and computationally predicted drug response patterns. These findings support the potential utility of the signature for risk stratification and provide testable hypotheses for further investigation of ESCC biology.

papers.abstract_en: Lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) demonstrates significant intra-tumor heterogeneity (ITH), which plays a critical role in disease progression and complicates therapeutic interventions. In the present study, we employed single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) to analyze cellular populations derived from stage I and stage III LUAD tumors, alongside matched adjacent normal tissues, with the objective of delineating malignant cell states and identifying tumor-propagating subpopulations. Unsupervised clustering analysis identified eight principal cell lineages, with epithelial cells predominating within tumor samples. Notably, advanced-stage tumors demonstrated a shift toward an immunosuppressive microenvironment, characterized by elevated T cell exhaustion and an increased presence of pro-angiogenic macrophages. Further stratification of malignant cells revealed eleven distinct subclusters, with stage III tumors enriched for invasive and immunosuppressive phenotypes. Pseudotime trajectory analysis identified evolutionary transitions from alveolar-like states toward squamous and stress-responsive lineages. Employing CytoTRACE to evaluate stemness independently of predefined markers, we identified subpopulations of cancer stem cells (sub-CSCs) predominantly in stage III tumors. These sub-CSCs exhibited heightened transcriptional heterogeneity and a core gene signature associated with cytoskeletal motility, immune regulation, metabolic reprogramming, and protein homeostasis. A four-gene panel derived from this signature demonstrated robust prognostic significance in independent LUAD cohorts. Collectively, these findings enhance the current understanding of stemness-driven tumor progression in LUAD and suggest potential therapeutic targets to address tumor heterogeneity.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Immune checkpoint inhibitors have become an important treatment for advanced lung cancer, but patient responses exhibit substantial interindividual variability. The tumor-associated microbiome is closely related to immunotherapy efficacy. METHODS: Tumor tissue samples from lung cancer patients receiving immunotherapy were analyzed using 16 S-5R rRNA sequencing (Cohort 1). Two core models were constructed: a deep learning-based bacterial diagnostic model (BDM) incorporating hidden layers and a Squeeze-and-Excitation block to predict immunotherapy response status, and a Cox proportional hazards (CoxPH) prognostic model to predict progression-free survival (PFS). Furthermore, four core bacterial species were selected using SHAP values, and a probe-based multiplex qPCR detection system (BDM-mqPCR) was developed (Cohort 2). RESULTS: The BDM achieved a sensitivity of 96.55% and 87.50%, specificity of 96.15% and 100.00%, and AUC of 0.989 and 1.000 in the training and validation set. The CoxPH model showed high concordance between predicted PFS curves and actual outcomes in both the training and validation sets, effectively distinguishing high-risk from low-risk patients, further providing the probability distribution of their PFS to help physicians decide whether to prepare subsequent treatment in advance or intensify monitoring. BDM-mqPCR constructed using the four SHAP-selected species achieved AUCs of 0.828 (training) and 0.869 (validation), which were lower than those of the BDM but significantly superior to Biomarker model, offering the advantages of rapidity, cost-effectiveness, and target specificity. CONCLUSION: BDM model and the CoxPH model achieved a complete assessment from whether a response occurs to how long the response lasts, providing a microbiome-driven precision tool for individualized decision-making in lung cancer immunotherapy.

papers.title_en: Statement from the International Society for Heart and Lung Transplantation (ISHLT) Consensus Conference on the Evolving Role of Nursing Professionals in Thoracic Transplantation.
papers.authors: Coleman B, Velleca A, Guzman AA, Benden C, Sumbi C, Kobashigawa J, Brown K, Campoli M et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Nursing Research and Quality, Department of Biomedical Sciences, and Smidt Heart Institute, Cedars-Sinai Medical Center,…
papers.authors_conclusion: These consensus statements provide an internationally informed blueprint for sustaining the thoracic transplant nursing workforce.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未报告会前调查的应答率、样本量、各国构成及各数据源的具体发现分布；结论为共识性建议，未提供任何患者或人力结局的验证数据（如离职率、配置比与结局关联），建议的效力层级与实施效果均未经评估；八主题中仅列出建议清单，未见证据分级或推荐强度标注。
papers.abstract_en: Thoracic transplantation has become increasingly complex, with new donor technologies, higher-acuity candidates and recipients resulting in expanding clinical demands and placing significant pressure on transplant coordinators (TCs) and Advanced Practice Registered Nurses (APRNs), including Advanced Nurse Practitioners (ANPs) in some international centers. The International Society for Heart and Lung Transplantation (ISHLT) convened its second Transplant Nursing Consensus Conference on April 26, 2025, in Boston, to address these pressures and develop actionable recommendations. A multi-method approach integrated 3 sources: a pre-conference international survey of transplant nursing professionals, 2 virtual international roundtables with nurses from 8 countries, and 4 facilitated in-person breakout sessions. Findings converged across sources, identifying incremental accumulation of duties without resource relief, administrative and after-hours burden, role ambiguity between TCs and APRNs, and absent career structures as dominant threats to workforce sustainability. International input revealed wide variation in roles, prescribing rights, and care models, while affirming shared priorities around retention, role clarity, work-life balance, and recognition. Seven overarching themes guided recommendations: staffing models and workload; work environment and retention; workforce roles and qualifications; professional development and impact measurement; clinical processes and protocols; technology and innovation; and patient education access. The panel endorsed acuity-driven staffing ratios, hybrid call structures with protected recovery, offloading non-clinical tasks to dedicated personnel, competency-based career ladders linked to certification and compensation, standardized nurse-led protocols with clear escalation, digital tools that reduce documentation duplication, and a universal modular patient education curriculum. These consensus statements provide an internationally informed blueprint for sustaining the thoracic transplant nursing workforce.

papers.study_type: 多季哨点监测（41,899份呼吸道样本，2021-2026）联合季节后血清活病毒中和试验的观察性研究
papers.title_zh: 跨5个季节RSV-A/B交替优势下婴幼儿亚组中和免疫由偏倚趋向平衡，且婴幼儿较低的中和活性与随后一季优势亚组相关
papers.title_en: Development of RSV subgroup neutralizing immunity across consecutive seasons with alternating RSV-A and RSV-B predominance.
papers.authors: Springer DN, Redlberger-Fritz M, Borsodi C, Aberle SW, Camp JV, Stiasny K, Aberle JH
papers.affiliation_highlight: Center for Virology, Medical University of Vienna, Vienna, Austria.
papers.authors_conclusion: Our findings indicate that neutralizing immunity develops from initially subgroup-biased responses after primary RSV infection toward balanced RSV-A/B neutralization with repeated exposure. Subgroup neutralizing activity in infants varied in the context of alternating RSV-A and RSV-B predominance across successive epidemic seasons. These findings provide new insights into age-dependent and seasonally varying patterns of RSV-A/B neutralizing immunity and subgroup circulation.
papers.ai_note: 摘要未报告任何统计学检验、效应量或置信区间，'lower neutralizing activity against the subgroup that predominated in the subsequent RSV epidemic'仅为方向性描述，且基于3/5个季节的生态学关联，无法确立因果或预测能力；血清学亚组（婴儿/儿童/成人）样本量、年龄分层与中和滴度具体数值均缺失，信息不足；'balanced/biased'缺乏定量阈值定义
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) circulates as two antigenically distinct subgroups, RSV-A and RSV-B, frequently alternating in seasonal predominance. Whether RSV subgroup predominance affects neutralizing immunity and how population immunity shapes subsequent subgroup dynamics, remains unclear. We analyzed multi-season RSV surveillance data and subgroup neutralizing antibody responses to characterize RSV-A/B neutralizing immunity across age groups and successive seasons. METHODS: We analyzed 41,899 respiratory samples collected through sentinel surveillance to characterize RSV-A and RSV-B circulation across five seasons (2021-2026). Subgroup neutralization was measured by live-virus neutralization assays in post-season serum samples from infants, children and adults. RESULTS: RSV-A and RSV-B alternated in seasonal predominance, with RSV-A predominating in 2021/22 and 2023/24, RSV-B in 2022/23 and 2025/26, with no clear predominance in 2024/25. In infants, the relative neutralizing activity against RSV-A and RSV-B differed across seasons, whereas adults maintained a balanced neutralizing activity against both subgroups. During the first three years of life, repeated exposure broadened antibody responses toward balanced subgroup neutralization. In the 2021/22, 2022/23, and 2024/25 seasons, lower neutralizing activity in infants was observed against the subgroup that predominated in the subsequent RSV epidemic. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings indicate that neutralizing immunity develops from initially subgroup-biased responses after primary RSV infection toward balanced RSV-A/B neutralization with repeated exposure. Subgroup neutralizing activity in infants varied in the context of alternating RSV-A and RSV-B predominance across successive epidemic seasons. These findings provide new insights into age-dependent and seasonally varying patterns of RSV-A/B neutralizing immunity and subgroup circulation.

papers.title_zh: 利福平暴露量升高与结核预防治疗的不良事件、停药及耐受性差相关，但无肝毒性关联且缺乏疗效终点
papers.title_en: Pharmacokinetic/Pharmacodynamic Analysis of Standard- and High-Dose Rifampicin to Predict Safety, Completion, and Tolerability of Tuberculosis Preventive Therapy in the 2R2 Randomized Controlled Trial.
papers.authors: Gafar F, Svensson EM, Yunivita V, Fregonese F, Fisher D, Fox GJ, Nguyen TA, Nguyen BH et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Respiratory Epidemiology and Clinical Research Unit, Centre for Outcomes Research and Evaluation, Research Institute of …
papers.authors_conclusion: 较高的利福平暴露与结核预防治疗中更差的安全性、完成率和耐受性相关。需要更大的疗效试验来确定实现足够暴露的 optimal 剂量，同时应研究治疗药物监测以避免过度暴露。
papers.ai_note: 该分析仅有安全性/完成度终点，无结核预防疗效终点，因此无法回答高剂量是否净获益，暴露-反应的临床意义需与疗效权衡后判断，作者也承认需更大疗效试验。暴露量由模型预测并经 1,000 次模拟插补而非全部实测，存在模型依赖性与测量误差风险。结论强调安全性恶化，但摘要同时报告肝毒性无显著关联，安全性结局内部不一致。剂量组间比较与连续暴露-反应混杂，个体药动学差异（如吸收、合并用药）可能同时影响暴露与不良事件，观察性暴露-反应关联不能直接推断降剂量或TDM的因果获益。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Rifampicin-based tuberculosis preventive therapy (TPT) may shorten treatment duration, but substantial interindividual pharmacokinetic variability may lead to different safety and tolerability profiles at the same dose. We performed pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic analyses of standard- and high-dose rifampicin to predict safety, completion, and tolerability. METHODS: We analyzed data from 1,368 adults and adolescents enrolled in the 2R2 trial comparing two months of rifampicin at 20 or 30 mg/kg/day with four months at 10 mg/kg/day. A population pharmacokinetic model developed from 440 participants was used to predict rifampicin exposure for all participants. Missing exposure metrics were imputed using 1,000 simulated datasets. Exposure-response relationships were evaluated using multivariable logistic regression models fitted within imputed datasets, with coefficients and standard errors pooled across imputations. RESULTS: A two-fold increase in total rifampicin exposure (AUC0-24) was associated with higher odds of protocol-defined adverse events (AEs) requiring permanent discontinuation (aOR 1.88, 95% CI 1.25-2.81), discontinuation unrelated to AEs (aOR 1.42, 95% CI 1.15-1.75), and tolerability symptoms potentially related to AEs without discontinuation (aOR 1.48, 95% CI 1.18-1.86); similar patterns were observed for peak concentration (Cmax). Higher AUC0-24 and Cmax were also associated with grade 1-2 and grade 3-4 AEs, rash/allergy/hypersensitivity, gastrointestinal intolerance, and early discontinuation, with no significant association for hepatotoxicity. Exposure-based models showed slightly better discriminatory performance than dose-based models in predicting safety. CONCLUSION: Higher rifampicin exposure was associated with worse safety, completion, and tolerability in TPT. Larger efficacy trials are needed to determine the optimal dose to achieve sufficient exposure, alongside investigation of therapeutic drug monitoring to avoid excessive exposure.

papers.study_type: 叙述性综述/框架展望文章 · 提出力学医学框架与转化路线图（无原始研究数据）
papers.title_zh: 肺移植长期结局受原发性移植物功能障碍与慢性移植物功能障碍限制，本文提出力学医学框架，将器官尺度力学、细胞力学转导与临床决策相连，并展望AI与数字孪生辅助的移植物风险评估（综述，无原始数据）
papers.title_en: Mechanomedicine for Lung Transplantation: From Multiscale Forces to AI-Assisted Translation.
papers.authors: Liu B, Feng J, Ren H, Wen T, Zhang G, Xu F
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, The First Affiliated Hospital of Xi'an Jiaotong University, Xi'an, P.
papers.authors_conclusion: We outline a translational roadmap for standardized mechanical biomarkers, interpretable AI and clinician-supervised digital-twin models.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：综述性框架文章，摘要未报告任何效应量、CI或终点数值，无法评估所述机械生物标志物/AI风险评估的实际效能；机械治疗策略按临床成熟度分层属作者自定框架，证据等级未在摘要中给出；AI与数字孪生部分为展望性主张，缺乏验证数据支撑。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term outcomes after lung transplantation remain limited by primary graft dysfunction and chronic lung allograft dysfunction, despite improvements in surgery, immunosuppression and infection control. Mechanical injury is a complementary contributor that remains insufficiently integrated into transplant care. The lung allograft must accommodate cyclic ventilation, reperfusion shear, thoracic constraints and matrix remodeling. These forces can disrupt the alveolar-capillary barrier, amplify inflammation and activate fibrotic programmes. Here we synthesize lung transplantation through a mechanomedicine framework that links organ-scale loading, cellular mechanotransduction and clinical decision-making. We discuss how computational models and artificial intelligence (AI) can integrate ex vivo lung perfusion waveforms, imaging-derived ventilation or strain patterns, and molecular injury markers to support graft-risk assessment. We then organize mechanotherapeutic strategies by clinical readiness, from protective ventilation, size matching and extracorporeal graft support to emerging interventions targeting mechanotransduction according to cell type and loading conditions. Finally, we outline a translational roadmap for standardized mechanical biomarkers, interpretable AI and clinician-supervised digital-twin models.

papers.study_type: 前临床体外与异种移植研究 · 多组学联合SPR/分子动力学机制验证
papers.category_label: 局晚期与晚期靶向/免疫
papers.title_zh: Acteoside在NSCLC细胞与异种移植模型中抑制增殖并上调E-cadherin、调控IL-17通路的前临床研究（同时提示其为代谢为咖啡酸的前药）
papers.title_en: Acteoside suppresses non-small cell lung cancer by upregulating E-cadherin and modulating IL-17/STAT3 signaling.
papers.authors: Wei JR, Wei TH, Song LG, Sun SL, Yin HS, Duan DD, Lu MY
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Biostatistics, School of Public Health, Nanjing Medical University, Nanjing, 210029, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: Acteoside是一种在前临床模型中抑制癌细胞增殖并诱导肿瘤消退的抗肿瘤药物，在所试剂量下无明显毒性；其机制为上调E-cadherin（CDH1）表达并以可测亲和力直接结合CDH1蛋白，同时调控IL-17信号通路；药代研究提示其口服后广泛代谢、代谢物咖啡酸全身暴露量更高，具有潜在前药特征；这些发现使其成为NSCLC中CDH1靶向治疗策略的有前景候选物，值得进一步研究
papers.ai_note: 信息不足/疑点：①全文仅有IC50一个明确数值，异种移植的抑瘤率、样本量、统计学与CI均未给出，'显著抑制''无毒性'无法核验；②研究自述acteoside为前药、活性代谢物咖啡酸暴露更高，却未区分母体与咖啡酸的贡献，'直接结合CDH1'的SPR亲和力数值（如KD）未报告，机制归因存疑；③IL-17通路抑制到CDH1上调的因果链主要依赖组学相关性与分子对接/MD模拟，敲低实验的具体结果数值缺失；④仅提及A549一种细胞系，未见对标准治疗药物的阳性对照比较，也无临床样本验证；⑤标题写IL-17/STAT3而正文结论仅提IL-17通路，表述不一致
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, hindered by drug resistance and metastasis. Epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) drives NSCLC progression and therapy resistance, but few effective EMT-targeting strategies exist. Acteoside, a phenylethanoid glycoside has shown promising antitumor activity, but its specific mechanisms in NSCLC remain unclear. METHODS: This study aimed to define the anti-NSCLC potency of acteoside, uncover its mechanism, and appraise its translational value. In vitro proliferation assays and distinct xenografts (monotherapy and Baihe Gujin Decoction) quantified efficacy. Integrative transcriptomics, proteomics, western blot, molecular dynamics, surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assay and knockdown experiment mapped the mode of action, while in vivo HPLC-MS/MS-based pharmacokinetic (PK) profiling gauged bioavailability. Functional validation supported that acteoside inhibited NSCLC cell migration in Transwell assays. RESULTS: Acteoside, identified as the key bioactive compound in Baihe Gujin Decoction, demonstrated potent anti-NSCLC efficacy both in vitro and in vivo. It inhibited A549 cell proliferation (IC50 = 3.79 µM), induced apoptosis and G0/G1 arrest, and significantly suppressed tumor growth in xenograft models without toxicity. Pharmacokinetic studies revealed acteoside acts as a prodrug, rapidly converting to caffeic acid. Multi-omics, IL-17 pathway perturbation assay and molecular analyses supported that acteoside upregulates E-cadherin (CDH1) via IL-17 pathway inhibition, with stable binding to the E-cadherin dimer interface validated by molecular dynamics, SPR, knockdown experiment and Western blot. Transwell assays functionally validated EMT modulation and migration inhibition. These findings provide evidence for acteoside as a novel small-molecule CDH1 modulator for NSCLC treatment. CONCLUSION: Acteoside is an antitumor agent that suppresses cancer cell proliferation and induces tumor regression in preclinical models, with no overt toxicity observed at the tested doses. Mechanistically, acteoside upregulates E-cadherin (CDH1) expression and directly binds to the CDH1 protein with measurable affinity, while also modulating the IL-17 signaling pathway. Pharmacokinetic studies indicate that acteoside undergoes extensive metabolism after oral administration, with its metabolite caffeic acid reaching higher systemic exposure, suggesting a potential prodrug characteristic. These findings position acteoside as a promising candidate for CDH1-targeted therapeutic strategies in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), warranting further investigation.

papers.study_type: 单中心横断面观察性研究·多变量（DAG混杂选择）与性别分层关联分析
papers.title_zh: OSA评估患者中自我报告性欲下降患病率44.7%，其独立关联因素为抑郁症状与社会心理因素而非OSA客观严重程度
papers.title_en: Self-reported decreased libido in patients evaluated for obstructive sleep apnea (OSA): Association with depressive symptoms rather than OSA severity.
papers.authors: Dramé M, Coffi M, Zabulon A, Awanou B, Andreu M, Inamo J, Duféal M, Parsemain A et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Clinical Research and Innovation, Centre Hospitalier Universitaire de Martinique, Fort-de-France, France.
papers.authors_conclusion: 自我报告性欲下降在因疑似OSA就诊的患者中很常见。性欲下降似乎与抑郁症状及社会心理因素的关联较与客观呼吸疾病严重程度的关联更一致。这些发现凸显了在OSA评估患者的常规呼吸科诊疗路径中整合心理与生活质量评估的重要性。
papers.ai_note: 摘要未给出任何效应量（OR/RR）、95%CI或P值，仅用'borderline'描述中重度OSA的关联，无法判断关联强度与统计精度，信息不足。横断面设计不能推断因果，作者'appears to be more consistently associated'的表述隐含比较性推断，但两组关联均无量化指标支撑。主要结局为二分法自报性欲下降，测量粗糙且未报告信效度。样本量188例却构建了含多协变量的扩展模型、性别分层及交互检验，效能可能不足；交互检验不显著，却仍按分层结果给出男女不同主导因素的结论。单中心、64.4%为女性，代表性有限。
papers.abstract_en: BackgroundSexual health complaints are frequently reported by patients evaluated for obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) but remain under-recognized in respiratory care settings. The relative contributions of respiratory disease severity, daytime symptoms, and psychological factors to decreased libido in this population remain poorly understood.ObjectivesThe aim of the study was to determine the prevalence of self-reported decreased libido in patients evaluated for suspected or confirmed OSA and to identify factors independently associated with this complaint.DesignMonocentric cross-sectional observational study performed in patients referred for suspected or confirmed obstructive sleep apnea from 1 July 2024 to 30 June 2025.MethodsSelf-reported decreased libido was assessed using a dichotomous patient-reported measure. Demographic characteristics, body mass index, comorbidities, OSA severity indices, daytime sleepiness, fatigue, and depressive symptoms were collected using standardized clinical assessments and questionnaires. Multivariable logistic regression models were performed to identify factors independently associated with decreased libido, including models based on directed acyclic graph (DAG) confounder selection, extended models including symptoms, sex-stratified analyses, and formal testing of sex-by-depression interaction.ResultsAmong 188 included patients (mean age 55.3 ± 15.9 years; 64.4% women), self-reported decreased libido was reported by 44.7%. In multivariable analyses based on DAG-selected confounders, increasing age was independently associated with decreased libido, while moderate-to-severe OSA showed only a borderline association. In the extended model including daytime symptoms and depressive symptoms, higher depressive symptom scores remained independently associated with decreased libido, whereas indices of OSA severity, daytime sleepiness, and fatigue were not associated. Sex-stratified analyses showed that depressive symptoms and relationship status were associated with decreased libido among women, whereas age was the main determinant among men. Formal testing of the interaction between sex and depressive symptoms was not statistically significant.ConclusionsSelf-reported decreased libido is common among patients evaluated for suspected OSA. Decreased libido appears to be more consistently associated with depressive symptoms and psychosocial factors than with objective respiratory disease severity. These findings highlight the importance of integrating psychological and quality-of-life assessment into routine respiratory care pathways for patients evaluated for OSA.

papers.title_zh: NSCLC中NK细胞CD226过表达抑制IL-22产生并阻断IL-22RA1-pSTAT3-CD155免疫逃逸环路（临床前机制研究）
papers.title_en: CD226 overexpression restrains NK92-associated IL-22 and limits an IL-22RA1-pSTAT3-CD155 circuit in the NSCLC tumor microenvironment.
papers.authors: Hui Z, Guo Z, Peng Y, Zeng Y, Hou Y, Wang Y, Ma M, Zhao F et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: The College of Life Sciences, Northwest University, Xi'an, Shaanxi, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: CD226 overexpression restrains NK-cell-derived IL-22 and interrupts an IL-22RA1-pSTAT3-CD155 immune-evasive circuit in NSCLC. This work supports combinatorial NK-cell engineering and IL-22-targeted immunotherapeutic strategies.
papers.ai_note: 全篇为体外/公共数据层面的机制研究，摘要未报告任何效应量、CI或P值，'correlating with clinical survival outcomes'无具体统计学数值，信息不足；未见体内肿瘤生长或生存验证，由细胞实验直接外推至'NK细胞工程化与IL-22靶向治疗策略'属结论跨越；公共数据集相关性分析不能支持因果推断，因果性依赖体外增益/失功能实验；数值未经四元组核验
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME) drives tumor immune escape in non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Tumor-expressed CD155 down-regulates NK-cell CD226; however, whether reduced NK-cell CD226 reciprocally modulates tumor-cell CD155 and the underlying regulatory mechanism remain unclear. METHODS: Public transcriptome datasets GSE32863 and TCGA-LUAD were analyzed. CD226-overexpressing NK92 cells and primary NK cells from CD226-knockout mice were applied in co‑culture systems with NSCLC/LLC tumor cells. Gain-and loss-of-function assays using recombinant IL-22, IL-22 neutralizing antibody and STAT3 siRNA were performed, combined with flow cytometry, RT-qPCR, western blot, ELISA and functional cytotoxicity, proliferation and invasion assays. RESULTS: LUAD tumor tissues exhibited decreased CD226 but elevated PVR (CD155) and IL-22RA1 expression, correlating with clinical survival outcomes. CD226 overexpression restrained NK-cell-derived IL-22 transcription and secretion. NK-cell-produced IL-22 triggered tumor-cell CD155 upregulation via IL-22RA1-pSTAT3 signaling. CD226-high NK cells displayed stronger anti‑tumor cytotoxicity, while exogenous IL-22 impaired NK-mediated tumor killing. Murine CD226-deficient primary NK cells reproduced this regulatory circuit. CONCLUSION: CD226 overexpression restrains NK-cell-derived IL-22 and interrupts an IL-22RA1-pSTAT3-CD155 immune-evasive circuit in NSCLC. This work supports combinatorial NK-cell engineering and IL-22-targeted immunotherapeutic strategies.

papers.study_type: 研究类型待评定（启发式模式）
papers.title_zh: Association between sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors and the risk of chronic lower respiratory disease in type 2 diabetes mellitus: findings from two target trial emulations.
papers.title_en: Association between sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors and the risk of chronic lower respiratory disease in type 2 diabetes mellitus: findings from two target trial emulations.
papers.authors: Li Y, Lv Y, Dai Y, Zeng H, Du F, Wu L, Li P, Song Y et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Epidemiology and Biostatistics, School of Public Health, Key Laboratory of Epidemiology of Major Diseases,…
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Research on the association between sodium‑glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT-2i) and chronic lower respiratory diseases (CLRDs) in patients with type 2 diabetes (T2DM) remains limited. This study aimed to investigate this association and examine the potential modifying effects such as age, sex, and diabetes severity. METHODS: Using the Shenzhen Public Health Data Platform, we conducted two independent target trial emulations with a new‑user active comparator design, comparing SGLT‑2i with glucagon‑like peptide‑1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RA) and dipeptidyl peptidase‑4 inhibitors (DPP‑4i), respectively. The primary outcome was incident CLRD; secondary outcomes included five subtypes-bronchitis, bronchiectasis, asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, and emphysema. Overlap-weighted Cox models estimated hazard ratios (HRs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs). RESULTS: During a median follow-up of 1.76 years, 349 (7.95%) and 397 (9.04%) new CLRD cases occurred in SGLT-2i and GLP-1RA users, respectively. Compared with GLP-1RA, SGLT-2i use was associated with a lower CLRD incidence (HR 0.87, 95% CI 0.79-0.96), primarily driven by reduced risk of bronchitis (HR: 0.89; 95% CI: 0.79-1.00) and asthma (HR: 0.77; 95% CI: 0.58-1.01); no significant associations were found for other subtypes. Compared with DPP-4i, SGLT-2i use showed a trend toward lower CLRD risk (HR: 0.95; 95% CI: 0.91-0.99), with significant reductions for bronchitis (HR: 0.95; 95% CI: 0.91-1.00), bronchiectasis (HR: 0.86; 95% CI: 0.75-1.00), and asthma (HR: 0.87; 95% CI: 0.77-0.98). Subgroup analyses indicated significant interactions for bronchiectasis by sex (P interaction = 0.001). CONCLUSION: Compared with GLP-1 RA, SGLT-2i were associated with a significantly lower risk of CLRDs, driven predominantly by bronchitis; versus DPP-4i, the risk reduction was primarily observed for bronchitis, bronchiectasis, and asthma. The protective association between SGLT-2i use and bronchiectasis was more pronounced in females than in males relative to DPP-4i.

papers.title_en: Effect of compound kushen injection on immune function in patients with lung cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Xiong Y, Cai Y, Wang L, He C, Sun L, Sun S, Yan Q, Wang X et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Tumor, Chongqing Hospital of the First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou University of Chinese Medicine, (C…
papers.authors_conclusion: Current evidence indicates that CKI combined with conventional treatment provides multiple clinical benefits for lung cancer patients. However, the limited available evidence may compromise the reliability of our conclusions. Rigorously designed multicenter double-blind randomized controlled trials with staged analyses and long-term follow-up are needed to validate these findings. All findings should be interpreted as exploratory.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要宣称CD3+、CD4+、CD4+/CD8+、NK细胞、CD8+、ORR、DCR、CEA、KPS、1年OS及不良反应均显著改善，但未给出任何效应量、95%CI或P值，无法判断获益幅度与统计学/临床意义。检索截止日期写为25 March 2026，与注册号CRD420261384207同为未来时点，时间信息自相矛盾，需核实。以免疫指标等替代终点为核心，OS仅报告1年单点且无HR/CI；纳入研究多为中文小型RCT，盲法与分配隐藏未描述，存在高偏倚风险与发表偏倚可能。作者结论亦自认证据有限、结果应作探索性解读。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Lung cancer remains a major global public health burden, characterized by high morbidity and mortality. The tumor immune microenvironment of lung cancer displays complex and dynamically changing immune landscapes, where diverse cell types collectively construct an immunosuppressive tumor ecosystem. Accordingly, boosting host immune function represents a promising therapeutic strategy to improve clinical outcomes and alleviate treatment-related adverse reactions in patients with lung cancer. OBJECTIVE: To systematically analyze the effects, efficacy, and safety of Compound Kushen Injection (CKI) combined with conventional treatment on improving immune function in lung cancer patients, providing evidence-based medical evidence for clinical practice. METHODS: A systematic search was conducted in major Chinese and English databases from their inception to 25 March 2026. Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) evaluating the impact of CKI on immune function in lung cancer patients were included. Quality assessment and data extraction were performed, and statistical analyses were conducted using Review Manager 5.4 and Stata 18.0 software. RESULTS: A total of 3846 patients from 39 RCTs were included (1971 in the experimental group and 1875 in the control group). Compared with conventional treatment alone, CKI combined with conventional treatment significantly enhanced immune function, as evidenced by increased levels of CD3+, CD4+, CD4+/CD8+ ratio, and natural killer (NK) cells, and decreased levels of CD8+ cells. Additionally, this combination improved the objective response rate (ORR) and disease control rate (DCR), reduced carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) levels, improved Karnofsky Performance Status (KPS) scores, prolonged 1-year overall survival, and effectively reduced treatment-related adverse reactions such as gastrointestinal reactions, myelosuppression, hepatorenal toxicity, and fatigue. CONCLUSION: Current evidence indicates that CKI combined with conventional treatment provides multiple clinical benefits for lung cancer patients. However, the limited available evidence may compromise the reliability of our conclusions. Rigorously designed multicenter double-blind randomized controlled trials with staged analyses and long-term follow-up are needed to validate these findings. All findings should be interpreted as exploratory. SYSTEMATIC REVIEW REGISTRATION: https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261384207, identifier CRD420261384207.

papers.authors: Cohen H, Levy Y, Gur D, Jaoui HD, Vitner EB, Lazar S, Bar-On L, Aftalion M et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Genetics, Israel Institute for Biological Research, Ness-Ziona, 76100, Israel.
papers.authors_conclusion: 通过迈向世界卫生组织目标产品概况优先强调的单次剂量生物防御基准，该膜锚定构建体成为一个有前景的快速反应鼠疫疫苗转化候选；本研究证明将既有的抗原栓系策略扩展到细菌靶点可能是产生强效免疫以克服复杂细菌感染的高度有效途径。
papers.ai_note: 主要比较组（分泌型native、hFc偶联）的保护率未在摘要中量化，87.5%（7/8）无CI/P与统计学比较，样本仅8只；随机化、盲法、攻毒剂量与对照设置信息不足；'进展至WHO单次剂量基准'为外推表述，信息不足。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The success of mRNA-lipid nanoparticle (LNP) platforms has prompted significant interest in their application against bacterial pathogens. However, adapting these platforms requires optimising host-expressed antigen structure to ensure robust immunogenicity. While membrane anchoring enhances the efficacy of viral mRNA vaccines, its application in bacterial mRNA platforms remains largely unexplored. Plague, caused by the Gram-negative bacterium Yersinia pestis, has been one of the most devastating diseases throughout human history. Despite extensive studies, there are no licenced vaccines available. METHODS: We developed a bivalent mRNA-LNP vaccine against Y. pestis, utilising the major antigens F1 and LcrV (5 μg of each mRNA). We evaluated glycosylphosphatidylinositol (GPI)-anchored and transmembrane (TM) variants alongside secreted native and hFc-conjugated formats to assess immunological profiles and determine protective efficacy in a murine model of pneumonic plague. FINDINGS: Membrane-tethering of F1 and LcrV antigens improved overall immunogenicity. Whereas secreted native and hFc-conjugated variants elicited predominantly cell-mediated and serological immune responses, respectively, the membrane-anchored bivalent mRNA vaccine generated a robust, protective immune response. This dual humoural and cellular immunity facilitated robust (87.5%, 7/8 mice) protection following a single-dose vaccination. INTERPRETATION: By progressing towards the single-dose biodefense benchmark prioritised by the World Health Organisation Target Product Profile, this membrane-anchored construct emerges as a promising translational candidate for a rapid-response plague vaccine. Ultimately, this study demonstrates that extending established antigen-tethering strategies to bacterial targets may be a highly effective approach for generating the potent immunity required to overcome complex bacterial infections. FUNDING: This research was supported by the Israeli Science Foundation (grants 2012/20, 842/25), the Lewis Trust and the Shmunis Family Trust.

papers.title_en: Spatially autocorrelated and clustered associations between short-term exposure to PM2.5 and daily reported confirmed COVID-19 cases across the contiguous United States, 2020-2022.
papers.authors: Li S, Tao C, Wang W, Chen J, Wang J, Luo C, Qian J, Wang N et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Epidemiology and Biostatistics, West China School of Public Health and West China Fourth Hospital, Sichuan…

papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未说明是否调整温度、湿度、人口流动、封锁与检测政策等COVID-19病例数的关键混杂因素；结局为每日报告确诊病例，受检测能力与报告政策影响，未见敏感性分析。聚类2的RR高达1.1770而聚类3几乎为零（1.0005, 95%CI跨1），提示残余混杂或地区报告差异的可能。摘要称考虑空间自相关与聚类“有效改善了meta回归拟合”，但未给出改善的具体比较指标。归因病例数依赖WHO 5 μg/m3反事实阈值的设定，阈值选择的敏感性未报告。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) is a highly transmissible respiratory infection that has caused a global pandemic. Evidence for the effect of short-term PM2.5 exposure on COVID-19 incidence varied across regions, and few studies have used advanced spatial analysis methods to examine spatial autocorrelation or clustering in these associations to improve estimation accuracy and identify highly susceptible geographic regions. METHODS: In this study, we used a novel three-stage strategy, including generalized additive model (GAM) and the newly developed estimation-error-based scan statistic (EESS) and multivariate conditional meta-autoregression (MCMAR), to fill the gap across the contiguous United States. RESULTS: We found there was significant spatial heterogeneity ( I 2 = 67.416 % , P < 0.001 ), autocorrelation ( ρ = 0.972 , P < 0.001 ), and clustering (four clusters were discovered, P ≤ 0.011 ) in the associations between short-term exposure to PM2.5 and daily reported confirmed COVID-19 cases. Considering the spatial autocorrelation and the spatial clustering effectively improved the fitting results of meta-regression. The pooled relative risk (RR) and 95% confidence intervals (95% CI) for per 10 μg/m3 increase in PM2.5 were 1.0341 and (1.0308, 1.0375). The RRs (95% CIs) for per 10 μg/m3 increase in PM2.5 were 1.0107 (1.0074, 1.0140), 1.1770 (1.1551, 1.1992), 1.0005 (0.9984, 1.0026), 1.0719 (1.0566, 1.0875), and 1.1032 (1.0798, 1.1270) in baseline and clusters 1-4, respectively. By 30 June 2022, a total of 1,761,726 (95% CI: 1,583,970-1,916,779; accounting for 2.06%, 95% CI: 1.85-2.24%) COVID-19 cases were found to be related to elevated PM2.5 exposure relative to the WHO annual mean PM2.5 guideline threshold of 5 μg/m3 across the contiguous United States. The eastern region and central region exhibited greater RR, greater attributable risk percentage, and more attributable cases than the western coastal region. CONCLUSION: There was significant spatial heterogeneity, autocorrelation, and clustering in the associations between short-term exposure to PM2.5 and daily reported confirmed COVID-19 cases across the contiguous United States.

papers.study_type: 系统综述与Meta分析（4项RCT，1055例）
papers.title_zh: 雾化干扰素β1a（SNG001）治疗COVID-19的RCT荟萃分析：住院风险降低但死亡与未康复率无显著差异
papers.title_en: Nebulized interferon-β1a (SNG001) in COVID-19 patients: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
papers.authors: Qin J, Wang G, Han D
papers.affiliation_highlight: Radioimmunoassay Center, Shaanxi Provincial People's Hospital, Xi'an, Shaanxi, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: 雾化SNG001安全且与COVID-19相关住院减少相关。SNG001对门诊COVID-19患者显示出潜在获益，但需要更大规模临床试验进一步验证，特别是在已接种疫苗和既往感染人群中。
papers.ai_note: 住院终点仅纳入2/4项RCT数据（样本子集），CI极宽（0.03-0.88），且为摘要中唯一显著的疗效终点；全因死亡与第28天未康复均未达统计学显著，结论仍强调'安全'与'潜在获益'存在选择性强调。住院与严重不良事件两个阳性终点并存的模式需注意发表偏倚可能。COVID-19治疗背景已变化（疫苗普及），外推性受限。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to determine the efficacy of nebulised interferon-β1a (SNG001) in patients with Coronavirus disease-2019 (COVID-19). METHODS: A systematic search was conducted across PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, and clinicaltrials.gov, without language restrictions. Studies were searched up to November 2025. Randomised controlled trials (RCTs) on treatment of COVID-19 with SNG001, compared with placebo or standard of care, were reviewed. Data were analysed using the RevMan Version 5.1 (The Cochrane Collaboration). Pooled risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated for dichotomous outcomes. RESULTS: Four RCTs (enrolling 1055 participants) met the inclusion criteria. The proportion of patients with hospitalisations (data extracted from two RCTs) (RR 0.16, 95% CI 0.03 to 0.88), and serious adverse events (RR 0.65, 95% CI 0.47 to 0.90) were significantly fewer in SNG001 groups. There was no statistically significant difference in all-cause mortality (RR 0.72, 95% CI 0.37 to 1.39), patients non-recovery at day 28 (RR 0.87, 95% CI 0.65 to 1.17), and adverse event (RR 0.97, 95% CI 0.90 to 1.04) between the two groups. CONCLUSIONS: Nebulised SNG001 was safe and associated with a reduction in COVID-19-related hospital admission. SNG001 shows a potential benefit for outpatients with COVID-19, but it requires larger clinical trials for future validations, particularly in vaccinated and previously infected populations.

papers.authors: Yasui H, Inui N, Inoue Y, Hozumi H, Suzuki Y, Karayama M, Furuhashi K, Enomoto N et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Second Division, Department of Internal Medicine, Hamamatsu University School of Medicine, Hamamatsu, Japan.
papers.authors_conclusion: 阿那瑞林治疗与iPPFE患者恶病质相关症状、体重、身体成分、营养生物标志物、呼吸相关生活质量的改善以及GH/IGF-1轴的药效学作用相关。鉴于可能存在失访/脱落偏倚，这些探索性结果需谨慎解读，并在随机对照试验中加以证实。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足之处：①单臂、开放标签、无安慰剂对照，症状评分与生活质量均为患者报告终点，无法区分药物效应与安慰剂效应、自然病程及伴随营养支持的影响；②样本极小（疗效分析仅15例），脱落3例，作者自述存在attrition偏倚，主要终点p=0.028接近阈值且95%CI下限0.5接近无效线；③中位数由26升至36（差10分）与Hodges-Lehmann估计值5.0不一致，两者口径差异摘要未说明；④体重与瘦体重升高可能被全身水肿这一治疗相关不良事件混淆（体液潴留可同时抬高体重与体成分数值），摘要未说明是否校正；⑤多个探索性终点（呼吸困难、QOL、握力、GH/IGF-1）仅定性描述'升高/下降'而无任何数值或统计量，存在选择性呈现的可能。
papers.abstract_en: BackgroundIdiopathic pleuroparenchymal fibroelastosis (iPPFE) is a rare, progressive interstitial lung disease with a poor prognosis and no established pharmacological treatment. Cachexia and cachexia-related symptoms are common in patients with iPPFE and are associated with functional decline and poor outcomes.ObjectivesTo evaluate the efficacy and safety of anamorelin, an oral ghrelin receptor agonist, in patients with iPPFE.DesignProspective interventional study.MethodsIn this single-arm pilot study, patients with iPPFE received oral anamorelin hydrochloride (100 mg once daily) for 8 weeks. The primary endpoint was the change in anorexia- and cachexia-related symptoms assessed using the Anorexia/Cachexia Subscale of the Functional Assessment of Anorexia/Cachexia Therapy (FAACT-A/CS). Exploratory endpoints included changes in body weight, lean body mass, nutritional biomarkers, dyspnoea severity, respiratory-related quality of life (QOL), and handgrip strength. Safety was assessed through clinical and laboratory evaluations.ResultsNineteen patients were enrolled; 18 received at least one dose of anamorelin, and 15 were included in the efficacy analyses. The median FAACT-A/CS score increased from 26 to 36, with a Hodges-Lehmann estimate of 5.0 (95% confidence interval, 0.5-9.5) (p = 0.028). Body weight, lean body mass, prealbumin, and transferrin levels increased from baseline. Circulating growth hormone (GH) and insulin-like growth factor-1 (IGF-1) levels also increased. Dyspnoea severity decreased, respiratory-related QOL scores increased, and handgrip strength increased. No treatment-related serious adverse events occurred; however, two participants discontinued treatment because of treatment-related adverse events (hepatic enzyme elevation and generalised oedema).ConclusionTreatment with anamorelin was associated with improvements in cachexia-related symptoms, body weight, body composition, nutritional biomarkers, respiratory-related QOL, and pharmacodynamic effects on the GH/IGF-1 axis in patients with iPPFE. Given the potential attrition bias, these exploratory findings warrant cautious interpretation and confirmation in randomised controlled trials.
