PFT and flow-volume curves are valuable for monitoring airway obstruction. In particular, expiratory plateauing on the flow-volume curve may indicate moderate central airway obstruction even when chest CT findings remain unchanged.
papers.ai_note: 单例个案报告，无对照、无可推广的量化数据；'中度中心气道梗阻'为定性描述，摘要未给出FEF25-75、FEV1/FVC等具体数值或梗阻程度的客观分级；从'疑似炎症致狭窄'到'考虑手术包括激光治疗'的决策链条信息不足，未报告最终是否手术及结局；CT'无显著变化'与气道梗阻并存的机制为推测（慢性炎症），缺乏组织学或支气管镜证据支持；数值未经四元组核验
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Upper respiratory tract disease and intratracheal tumors commonly cause central airway obstruction patterns on the flow-volume curves obtained during pulmonary function testing. We herein describe a rare case in which a central airway obstruction pattern was attributed to slowly progressive tracheal lumen narrowing caused by chronic inflammation in the surrounding area rather than enlargement of the tracheal diverticulum. In our patient, the flow-volume curve demonstrated an expiratory plateau pattern consistent with moderate central airway obstruction, despite no remarkable changes on chest computed tomography (CT). CASE PRESENTATION: A 73-year-old woman diagnosed with a tracheal diverticulum was followed as an outpatient. Although her subjective symptoms did not worsen, her flow-volume curves obtained during pulmonary function testing indicated central airway obstruction. Annual chest CT showed no significant changes; however, tracheal narrowing due to inflammation around the tracheal diverticulum was suspected. Therefore, surgical treatment, including laser therapy, was considered. CONCLUSION: We report a rare case of a tracheal diverticulum diagnosed >10 years previously that exhibited a central airway obstruction patterns on the flow-volume curves obtained during pulmonary function testing. Pulmonary function testing and flow-volume curves are valuable for monitoring airway obstruction. In particular, expiratory plateauing on the flow-volume curve may indicate moderate central airway obstruction even when chest CT findings remain unchanged.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Pathologic response (PR) after neoadjuvant therapy is an established surrogate endpoint in lung cancer clinical trials. Although IASLC recommendations standardizing PR assessment in primary tumors are widely adopted, guidance for evaluating treatment response in regional lymph nodes (LNs) has been lacking. The IASLC has developed multidisciplinary consensus recommendations for LN assessment in resected lung cancer specimens following neoadjuvant therapy. METHODS: A core group of IASLC pathologists drafted statements addressing key aspects of gross and microscopic LN evaluation. These were refined through a two-round Delphi process involving 48 international experts in thoracic oncology, surgery, radiology, and pathology. Consensus was predefined as ≥85% agreement. Experts reviewed, commented upon, and voted on 13 final recommendations. RESULTS: All 13 recommendations reached consensus (86-100%). Key statements include: defining pathologic complete response (pCR) as the absence of residual viable tumor (RVT) in both lung and LNs; introducing MPR(N+) for cases with ≤10% RVT at the primary site but residual nodal disease; requiring estimation of RVT, stroma, and necrosis across LN stations; accepting unweighted ("eyeball") microscopic assessment; encouraging reporting of metastasis size; and advising complete LN submission with selective use of deeper levels and/or immunohistochemistry. The recommendations further clarify interpretation of direct tumor extension into LN, interpretation of psammoma bodies or acellular mucin, and interactions with ypTNM staging principles. CONCLUSION: These IASLC multidisciplinary recommendations provide the first standardized framework for assessing treatment response in LNs after neoadjuvant therapy in lung cancer and are intended to improve diagnostic reproducibility, support trial harmonization, and to outline research opportunities.

papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is starting to transform pathology by enhancing diagnostic accuracy, prognostication, and therapeutic prediction through advanced computational analysis of histopathological images. This review explores key AI methodologies and their applications in lung cancer diagnostics. Supervised learning dominates current clinical AI tools, relying on annotated whole-slide images (WSIs) for tasks like tumor subtyping, quantitation of tissue-based parameters, prediction of driver alterations (e.g. EGFR and KRAS mutations, ALK rearrangement), and assessment of tumor microenvironment (TME) features. Meanwhile, weakly supervised and self-supervised learning (SSL) methods, such as multiple instance learning (MIL) and contrastive learning, reduce dependency on labor-intensive annotations and uncover novel prognostic morphologic patterns. AI demonstrates strong performance in predicting therapeutic responses, including immune checkpoint inhibitor efficacy and pathologic response to neoadjuvant therapy, while emerging techniques like spatial transcriptomics and multiplex immunofluorescence further leverage AI to decode complex spatial biology and generate novel biomarkers. Despite much progress, major challenges persist in validation, reliability, interpretability, regulatory approval, ethics and data privacy standards, cost and reimbursement, equity, and integration into clinical workflows. Adoption requires scalable digital pathology infrastructure, interdisciplinary collaboration, and suitable reimbursement frameworks. Regulatory efforts aim to address ethical and safety concerns, but global harmonization remains incomplete. We also consider the professional consequences of adoption, including cognitive deskilling, workforce displacement, and the conditions under which pathologist oversight remains meaningful rather than nominal, and argue that liability should follow the reality of control. As AI evolves, particularly with foundation models and large language models (LLMs), thoracic pathology stands to benefit from substantially extended diagnostic and predictive capabilities, pending resolution of implementation barriers.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Thymic epithelial tumors (TETs) are rare malignancies. Since they occur infrequently, most physicians encounter only a small number of patients, resulting in limited experience with their diagnosis and management and a scarcity of large-scale studies. Nevertheless, TNM staging was developed for all TETs in 2017, and guidelines for diagnosis and management of these tumors, largely based on expert opinion, are available. OBJECTIVE: To better understand the utilization of the TNM staging system by providers, and their awareness and knowledge of current recommendations for the diagnosis and management of patients with TET. METHOD: A global survey of medical oncologists, pathologists, radiation oncologists, radiologists, and thoracic surgeons was conducted. RESULTS: Based on 398 contributors, we found many areas of agreement among physicians but also areas of controversy. For instance, the acceptance of TNM staging was over 90%, but some providers still solely used the Masaoka-Koga staging system. Other agreements and controversies were identified and reported in this paper. To our knowledge, this is the largest international multidisciplinary survey on diagnosis and management of TET. CONCLUSIONS: Our results confirmed that continuous education about the latest literature and available recommendations, guidelines, and TNM staging is important, and ongoing, ideally multi-institutional, global research is imperative, with the goal of developing a standardized, evidence-based approach to the diagnosis and management of patients with TETs.

papers.abstract_en: Accurate and minimally invasive percutaneous biopsy is critical for early lung cancer diagnosis, yet conventional manual procedures suffer from repeated radiation exposure, high reliance on doctor expertise, and risk of tissue injury. This study presents a 5 degree-of-freedom robotic system combined with an intelligent shared control framework guided by expert skills learning. Expert skills were modeled using a variational autoencoder-hidden Markov model to segment latent procedural phases, and dynamic motion primitives reconstructed representative expert trajectories. These learned skills were integrated into a phase-adaptive shared controller, enabling online modulation of impedance and trajectory parameters. Both phantom and in vivo porcine experiments validated the system's feasibility, safety, and accuracy, with animal experiment studies confirming minimal tissue trauma and stable physiological responses. Compared with manual, leader-follower, and admittance control methods, the intelligent shared control substantially reduced force fluctuations and trajectory deviations.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Nutritional risk is prevalent among patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), yet remains underrecognized in routine clinical practice and administrative datasets, with significant implications for clinical outcomes and hospital reimbursement. This study aims to evaluate the extent of malnutrition underdocumentation, its association with postoperative outcomes, and its implications within a Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG)-based reimbursement system. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective, single-center cohort study including 197 patients undergoing curative-intent surgery for NSCLC between 2015 and 2024. Nutritional status was assessed using body mass index (BMI), Nutritional Risk Screening 2002 (NRS​), and the Graz Malnutrition Screening (GMS) tool. Discrepancies between clinically assessed nutritional risk and administrative coding of malnutrition were analyzed. Multivariable regression models were used to evaluate associations with postoperative complications and length of stay (LOS). Reimbursement was analyzed using generalized linear models with gamma distribution with log-link, and marginal effects were calculated to estimate absolute differences. RESULTS: The proportion of patients identified at nutritional risk varied substantially by assessment method: 28.4% by BMI, 33% by NRS ≥ 3, and 65% by GMS ≥ 3, where as only 11.7% of patients had malnutrition documented in administrative data. GMS-defined risk of malnutrition was independently associated with increased postoperative complications (odds ratio [OR] = 2.45, p = 0.003) and prolonged LOS (rate ratio [RR] 1.31, p < 0.001). In contrast, administratively coded malnutrition was not associated with these outcomes. Although nutritional risk was associated with higher reimbursement (+€2,210), coding itself was not an independent predictor after adjustment. Tumor stage and surgical complexity remained the primary drivers of reimbursement. CONCLUSION: Nutritional risk in patients undergoing surgery for NSCLC is substantially underdocumented in routine hospital data, limiting its utility for clinical risk stratification and reimbursement accuracy. Nutritional risk was associated with higher reimbursement in the initial model but that this was attenuated and no longer significant after adjustment for CMI and PCCL. This indicates that the economic effect of nutritional status is mediated through DRG-related measures of clinical complexity, and the finding should be interpreted with caution. Systematic nutritional screening and standardized documentation represent feasible, high-impact interventions to improve outcome prediction, resource allocation, and transparency in DRG-based reimbursement systems. Integration of nutritional assessment into perioperative workflows should be prioritized as part of quality improvement strategies in thoracic oncology care. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.

We distinguish systemic efficacy in populations that include brain metastases from demonstrated intracranial activity and propose a CNS-specific evidence hierarchy. papers.abstract_en: Brain metastases are a defining biological feature of small-cell lung cancer (SCLC) and a persistent blind spot in therapeutic development. Chemo-immunotherapy has improved survival in extensive-stage SCLC, and durvalumab consolidation has changed care for limited-stage disease, but these advances do not establish intracranial efficacy. Patients with active or symptomatic brain metastases remain under-represented in pivotal trials; brain imaging is inconsistent; and prophylactic cranial irradiation, previous radiotherapy and corticosteroid exposure confound interpretation. Emerging DLL3-directed T-cell engagers and B7-H3-directed antibody-drug conjugates have nevertheless generated prospective intracranial activity signals. This narrative review integrates CNS assessment, radiotherapy and prevention, systemic treatment, treatment sequencing, leptomeningeal disease and the biological and methodological questions that determine clinical interpretation. Radiotherapy selection requires lesion size and volume, neurological status, prior treatment and reliable MRI surveillance; emerging systemic activity does not establish that local therapy or prophylactic cranial irradiation can routinely be omitted. We distinguish systemic efficacy in populations that include brain metastases from demonstrated intracranial activity and propose a CNS-specific evidence hierarchy. Future trials should mandate brain MRI, separate treated-stable from untreated-asymptomatic disease, use RANO-BM-compatible endpoints, report corticosteroid and radiotherapy exposure, and incorporate paired plasma and cerebrospinal-fluid analyses.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: COPD is associated with high disease burden and is a leading cause of death. In July 2024, Germany introduced regulation allowing low-dose CT for early lung cancer detection in smokers. This cost-utility and cost-effectiveness model compares hypothetical lung cancer screening with embedded COPD screening (LC+COPD screening) with lung cancer screening alone (LC-screening). METHODS: A dynamic Markov model from the perspective of the statutory health insurance was developed including individuals aged 50-75 years meeting current German lung cancer screening criteria. The base-case assumed a smoking cessation success rate of 12% among individuals with newly detected COPD compared to 7.5% among individuals with known and undetected COPD. The model used a 40-year time horizon with 3-month cycles. Outcomes include costs, quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) and life years gained (LYG). Deterministic and probabilistic sensitivity analyses were conducted. RESULTS: Under base-case assumptions, the ICER was €59,868 per QALY gained and €32,175 per LYG. Assuming an increased smoking cessation success rate of 15% among individuals with newly detected COPD, ICERs were €35,349 per QALY gained and €17,967 per LYG. Univariate sensitivity analyses showed the greatest impact from discount rates and smoking cessation success. Probabilistic sensitivity analyses with 10,000 draws each yielded mean ICERs of €59,038 per QALY gained and €31,821 per LYG. DISCUSSION: Our model provides a first indication of the cost-effectiveness of LC+COPD-screening. The findings are limited by, among other things, lack of knowledge about the utilization of services for undiagnosed COPD and assumptions about the utilization and success of smoking cessation measures.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Metabolic dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (MASLD) represents the predominant cause of chronic liver disease worldwide and shares with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) common pathobiological pathways; however, its burden in COPD is insufficiently characterized. The study aimed to estimate the prevalence of MASLD in COPD patients, the association between MASLD and COPD severity and to develop a predictive score of MASLD risk. METHODS: Cross-sectional monocenter study. Adults ≥60 years old with COPD and without a history of viral or autoimmune hepatitis, liver cirrhosis, high daily alcohol consumption and active malignancy were included. Participants underwent spirometry, 6-minute walking test and liver ultrasound; laboratory parameters were also collected. MASLD was diagnosed according to the EASL-EASD-EASO guidelines and the respiratory symptoms, exacerbations and lung function were compared between participants with and without MASLD. Logistic regression was used to develop a predictive model, with a bootstrapped validation. RESULTS: 116 patients were enrolled. Patients with MASLD were 54.3% and were more comorbid, with a higher prevalence of cardiometabolic diseases, more symptomatic (mean CAT 16vs13, P-value:0.03), and with a worse BODE index (3vs2, P-value:0.04). The ROC-AUC of the "BMI, Airflow obstruction, Sex, Lung exacerbation and Dyspnea- M-A-S-L-D -" predictive score was 0.81. A cut-off ≥2 showed a diagnostic sensitivity and specificity for MASLD of 92% and 36%, respectively. CONCLUSION: MASLD is highly prevalent in COPD, and it is associated with more severe COPD. "M-A-S-L-D" predictive score is easy-to-use and may help to stratify the risk of MASLD.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Pulmonary tuberculosis (PTB) remains a major global infectious disease, and short-video platforms are increasingly used for health information seeking. However, the quality, reliability, disease-specific accuracy, and safety of PTB-related videos on major Chinese platforms have not been well characterized. METHODS: A cross-sectional analysis was conducted on PTB-related videos retrieved from Douyin and Bilibili on January 5, 2026. The first 150 videos from each platform were screened using the Chinese keyword "" (pulmonary tuberculosis). Video characteristics, uploader types, content categories, presentation formats, and engagement metrics were extracted. General quality and reliability were assessed using the Global Quality Score (GQS) and modified DISCERN (mDISCERN), respectively. TB-specific accuracy and potentially harmful information were evaluated using a study-specific Accuracy Score on a 0-3 scale and a Safety Risk Checklist. Nonparametric tests, Spearman correlation analysis, and multivariable linear regression were applied. RESULTS: A total of 263 videos were included. Overall, video quality was moderate (median GQS: 3.0), reliability was limited (median mDISCERN: 2.0), and disease-specific accuracy was moderate (median Accuracy Score: 2.0 on a 0-3 scale). No overtly misleading or potentially harmful claims were identified according to the predefined Safety Risk Checklist. Treatment-related content was the most common topic. In univariate comparisons, Bilibili videos were significantly longer and had higher GQS, mDISCERN, and Accuracy Score values, whereas Douyin videos showed higher engagement. However, after adjustment for platform, video duration, uploader type, total engagement, and video age, platform was not independently associated with GQS, mDISCERN, or Accuracy Score. Longer video duration and being uploaded by specialists were independently associated with higher quality-related scores, whereas total engagement and video age were not independent predictors. CONCLUSIONS: PTB-related short videos on Douyin and Bilibili provided moderate-quality information overall, but reliability and disease-specific completeness remained limited. Video duration and specialist uploader identity, rather than platform or engagement metrics, were the main factors independently associated with higher video quality, reliability, and TB-specific accuracy. These findings suggest that popularity should not be used as a surrogate for credible medical information and highlight the need for more evidence-based, guideline-concordant PTB communication on short-video platforms.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is characterized by persistent airway inflammation, yet clinically useful biomarkers and mechanistically validated therapeutic targets remain limited. Here, we aimed to identify and functionally validate smoke-responsive regulators of airway epithelial inflammation in COPD and establish an interpretable prediction framework by integrating population-based clinical data, multi-omics analyses, genetic causal inference, and experimental validation. METHODS: Complementary clinical and molecular investigations used separate populations. Interpretable machine-learning models classified recorded COPD status in CHARLS, with validation across survey waves. Independent lung transcriptomic analyses integrated differential expression, co-expression networks, 113 machine-learning configurations, and single-cell profiling. Two-sample Mendelian randomization examined genetically predicted IER3 expression in relation to FEV1/FVC. Functional effects of IER3 were evaluated through AAV-mediated silencing in cigarette-smoke-exposed mice and siRNA knockdown in cigarette-smoke-extract-stimulated bronchial epithelial cells. Drug screening and molecular simulations prioritized candidate compounds for further investigation. RESULTS: The support vector machine achieved the best predictive performance for COPD risk (test AUC = 0.821; temporal validation AUC = 0.829). Multi-omics analyses consistently identified IER3 as a central COPD-associated gene within an inflammation-enriched transcriptional network. A six-gene diagnostic signature demonstrated robust external performance (AUC = 0.882 and 0.836), with IER3 and ATF3 emerging as the most reproducible biomarkers across independent cohorts. Single-cell analysis localized IER3 predominantly to airway epithelial cells and macrophages and revealed enhanced epithelial-macrophage communication in COPD. Mendelian randomization supported a causal association between genetically predicted IER3 expression and impaired lung function (IVW β = -0.042, P < 0.001). Experimental studies further demonstrated that cigarette smoke induced epithelial IER3 expression, whereas IER3 silencing suppressed pro-inflammatory cytokine production, reduced inflammatory-cell recruitment, alleviated lung injury, and partially restored pulmonary function. Drug-repurposing analysis nominated IMD-0354 as a potential candidate modulator of the IER3-associated inflammatory axis. CONCLUSIONS: We developed an interpretable machine-learning framework for COPD risk prediction and identified IER3 as a candidate mediator of airway epithelial inflammation. Integrated evidence supports its involvement in smoke-induced inflammatory amplification and potential contribution to impaired lung function, highlighting IER3 as a potential therapeutic target warranting further mechanistic and clinical validation.

papers.ai_note: 纯基础机制研究，无患者样本量、无统计量（CI/P）或效应值报告，信息不足；'elevated pSCD levels correlating with ESCC metastasis'来自公共临床磷蛋白质组数据集但未给出相关系数或P值；未见体内转移模型或干预抑制pSCD的验证描述，转化与靶向价值尚待证实；缺乏临床队列独立验证与分期/预后多因素校正信息。
papers.abstract_en: Phosphorylation dysregulation is a marker of cancer serving as a key mechanism for tumor malignant progression. However, the mechanism by which the phosphorylation of metabolic enzymes drives metastasis in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) remains unclear. Here, we identify phosphorylation of stearoyl-CoA desaturase (SCD) at serine 198 (pSCD) as a key driver of metastasis in ESCC. Analysis of clinical phosphoproteomic datasets revealed elevated pSCD levels correlating with ESCC metastasis. Functional assays demonstrated that pSCD promotes ESCC metastasis independently of SCD's desaturase activity. pSCD translocates into the nucleus, where it directly binds to the scaffold protein MTA2 within the NuRD complex, suppressing deacetylase activity and reprogramming transcription toward pro-metastatic programs. Integrative ATAC-seq and RNA-seq analyses identified increased accessibility and expression of metastasis-related genes, including MET, KDR, PGF, FGF5, FGF18, and IGF1R. Mechanistically, p110α mediates the phosphorylation of SCD S198, enhancing KPNA2-dependent nuclear import by exposing the nuclear localization signal of SCD through conformational changes. Collectively, these findings reveal a previously unrecognized PI3K-pSCD-MTA2/NuRD signaling axis that links the phosphorylation of metabolic enzymes to chromatin remodeling and transcriptional activation, thereby driving ESCC metastasis.

papers.ai_note: 1) 样本量小(n=180)、事件数61例，多变量模型的事件/变量比可能不足，存在过拟合风险；2) 仅内部bootstrap验证，无外部验证，AUC=0.854可能偏乐观；3) 回顾性设计，部分变量（如延迟就医、入院前过度氧疗）的测量存在回忆偏倚和记录不完整风险；4) 摘要未报告模型的校准截距/斜率、Hosmer-Lemeshow检验P值或DCA的具体阈值概率范围；5) 摘要称'非严重程度变量'但急性心衰/容量超负荷本身即为严重程度相关表现，变量分类口径存在模糊之处；6) 未说明NIV失败的操作性定义（插管时间窗、失败标准）。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Noninvasive ventilation (NIV) is widely used in acute exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (AECOPD), but failure remains common and is associated with poor outcomes. Most existing models rely on severity indicators, limiting early risk identification. OBJECTIVES: To develop and internally validate an early prediction model for NIV failure using non-severity-based clinical variables. METHODS: A retrospective cohort of 180 hospitalized AECOPD patients receiving NIV was analyzed. Candidate predictors included medical history, routine laboratory parameters, and chest radiography findings. Least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression was used for variable selection, followed by multivariable logistic regression. Model performance was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves, calibration analysis with 1000-bootstrap resampling, and decision curve analysis (DCA). RESULTS: NIV failure occurred in 61 patients (33.9%). Independent risk factors included smoking pack-years, mucus plugging/excessive sputum production, acute heart failure/volume overload, pre-admission excessive oxygen therapy, and delayed medical consultation, while serum albumin was protective. The LASSO risk model showed good discrimination (AUC = 0.854) and calibration. Risk stratification demonstrated a clear gradient in NIV failure rates across low-, medium-, and high-risk groups (8.3%, 25.0%, and 68.3%, respectively). CONCLUSION: A clinically accessible model based on non-severity variables can effectively predict NIV failure and may support early risk stratification and targeted management.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Sarcoidosis is a multisystem granulomatous disease with a variable clinical course. In real-world practice, treatment initiation, tapering strategies, and duration are heterogeneous, and data on the relationship between treatment exposure and comorbidity burden remain limited. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective monocentric observational study including adults with sarcoidosis followed at a tertiary referral centre from January 2010 to November 2025. Demographic, clinical, radiological, therapeutic, and comorbidity data were extracted from a prospectively maintained database. Associations between treatment variables and documented hypertension and bone mineral density (BMD) impairment were evaluated using univariable and multivariable logistic regression. RESULTS: A total of 835 patients were included. At baseline, 81.8% received pharmacological treatment, most commonly corticosteroids alone. Extrapulmonary involvement was present in 45.4% and was associated with treatment initiation and escalation to immunosuppressive therapy. During follow-up, 664 patients received systemic corticosteroids for a mean treatment duration of 38.4 ± 64.3 months, and 25.9% received immunosuppressive agents, predominantly methotrexate. After multivariable adjustment, longer corticosteroid treatment duration was associated with documented hypertension (OR 1.008 per month, 95% CI 1.0002-1.016; p=0.045) and BMD impairment (OR 1.009 per month, 95% CI 1.0002-1.018; p=0.046), whereas initial corticosteroid dose was not significantly associated with either outcome. CONCLUSION: Longer corticosteroid treatment duration was associated with documented hypertension and BMD impairment. However, unavailable comorbidity onset dates, cumulative corticosteroid dose data, and potential confounding by indication preclude causal interpretation. Prospective studies are needed to clarify treatment-related risks.

papers.abstract_en: RATIONALE: Osteoporosis and fragility fractures are recognised comorbidities in chronic airway diseases such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and asthma, but their burden in bronchiectasis beyond cystic fibrosis (CF) remains poorly defined and is not addressed in current guidelines. OBJECTIVE: To quantify the risk of osteoporosis and fragility fractures in adults with bronchiectasis using large, multicentre electronic health record datasets. METHODS: We performed a retrospective cohort study using de-identified data from TriNetX and Epic Cosmos (2015–2024). Adults with bronchiectasis were identified using International Classification of Diseases, 10th Revision, Clinical Modification code J47, excluding CF codes. In TriNetX, 1:1 propensity score matching balanced demographics and key osteoporosis risk factors between bronchiectasis and non-bronchiectasis cohorts. Absolute risks, risk differences and risk ratios (RRs) were estimated for osteoporosis and fragility fractures. Epic Cosmos was used to assess yearly prevalence and incidence trends. RESULTS: After matching, 364 924 patients were retained per cohort. Osteoporosis occurred in 8.41% of bronchiectasis patients versus 6.69% of controls (RR 1.26, 95% CI 1.24 to 1.28; p<0.001). Fragility fractures occurred in 2.80% vs 2.50% (RR 1.12, 95% CI 1.09 to 1.15; p<0.001). Associations were stronger in a CT-restricted cohort (osteoporosis RR 1.45; fragility fracture RR 1.40; both p<0.001). Recorded prevalence of both outcomes was higher in 2024 than in 2015 in both datasets, while annual estimates fluctuated. CONCLUSIONS: A diagnosis of bronchiectasis was associated with a higher recorded burden of osteoporosis and fracture-related diagnoses than in matched controls. These findings support greater attention to bone health and prospective evaluation of risk stratification, screening strategies and targeted interventions in this population.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Targeted next-generation sequencing (tNGS) is increasingly used for pathogen detection in lower respiratory tract infections. However, real-world data on bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF)-dominant tNGS findings in respiratory and critical care settings remain limited. METHODS: This single-center retrospective real-world study included 580 tNGS records from the respiratory and critical care department between November 2024 and April 2026. Reported pathogens and resistance- or virulence-related genetic signals were extracted and standardized. Detection frequencies, pathogen-category distributions, mixed-pathogen detection patterns, co-detection pairs, age-stratified differences, and monthly variation were analyzed. RESULTS: Among 580 records, BALF accounted for 551 specimens (95.0%). At least one pathogen or related signal was detected in 543 records (93.6%). Among pathogen-positive records, 125 (23.0%) showed single-pathogen detection, whereas 418 (77.0%) showed detection of two or more pathogens. The most frequently detected pathogens were Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) (38.1%), Haemophilus influenzae (20.2%), Candida albicans (18.4%), Klebsiella pneumoniae (15.3%), and Pseudomonas aeruginosa (15.2%). Bacteria were detected in 388 records (66.9%), viruses in 366 (63.1%), fungi in 186 (32.1%), and resistance- or virulence-related genetic signals in 117 (20.2%). Common co-detection pairs included EBV with C. albicans, EBV with H. influenzae, and C. albicans with K. pneumoniae. Frequently observed pairs were not always significantly associated after FDR correction, indicating that absolute pair frequency and chance-adjusted association provide different report-level information. Significant age-stratified differences after false discovery rate correction were observed across multiple pathogen categories and individual pathogens, including bacteria, viruses, fungi, atypical or special bacteria, EBV, C. albicans, K. pneumoniae, CMV, A. baumannii, E. coli, and HSV-1 (all adjusted P < 0.05). Monthly variation was significant for overall detection, mixed-pathogen detection, bacteria, viruses, fungi, EBV, H. influenzae, and C. albicans (all adjusted P < 0.05). CONCLUSIONS: BALF-dominant tNGS records showed a complex and frequently mixed pathogen detection profile. However, incomplete patient-level clinical data and the absence of paired conventional microbiology limited differentiation between infection, colonization, and incidental detection and restricted the generalizability of these findings. Co-detection should therefore be interpreted together with clinical and microbiological evidence.

papers.title_en: Dysregulated ASH1L-MUC1-CD133 axis promotes lung metastasis and reprograms the metastatic niche in SPOP-deficient prostate cancer.
papers.authors: Meng C, Gu Q, Wang Y, Li H, Shi W, Liang X, DeBruine A, Leo J et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Experimental Radiation Oncology, The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center, Houston, TX, USA.
papers.authors_conclusion: These findings uncover a previously unrecognized SPOP-ASH1L-MUC1-CD133 regulatory axis linking genetic alterations to metastatic niche remodeling and reveal actionable vulnerabilities in metastatic PCa. It uncovers novel post-translational regulation of pro-metastatic epigenetic factor ASH1L and informs biomarker-guided MUC1-targeted therapy for metastatic PCa.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要通篇无任何定量数值、样本量、统计学检验或CI/P，'significantly suppressed lung metastasis'无数据支撑，无法评估效应量与稳健性；'informs biomarker-guided MUC1-targeted therapy'等转化表述超出临床前移植瘤模型证据；MUC1药理抑制剂种类、TAM浸润与干性表型的量化方法均未说明；结论中'actionable vulnerabilities'与'biomarker-guided'属前瞻性外推，尚无人体验证。
papers.abstract_en: Metastasis remains the leading cause of mortality in prostate cancer (PCa). Loss-of-function mutations in SPOP, commonly observed in metastatic PCa, have undefined roles in the metastatic niche. Histone methyltransferase ASH1L plays a crucial role in leukemogenesis and is overexpressed in various solid tumors. However, its post-translational regulation and protein homeostasis in cancer remain poorly understood. Here, we report that SPOP mutations promote PCa lung metastasis and induce infiltration of tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) in graft models. We identified that the CUL3-SPOP E3 ubiquitin ligase complex is a key regulator of ASH1L protein, mediating its polyubiquitination and proteasomal degradation. PCa-associated SPOP mutations cause aberrant stabilization of ASH1L, thereby epigenetically activating the oncogenic glycoprotein MUC1. Dysregulation of the ASH1L-MUC1 axis augmented CD133-associated cancer stemness and TAM recruitment in the metastatic niche. In preclinical models, genetic knockdown of ASH1L or pharmacological inhibition of MUC1 significantly suppressed lung metastasis driven by SPOP mutations. These findings uncover a previously unrecognized SPOP-ASH1L-MUC1-CD133 regulatory axis linking genetic alterations to metastatic niche remodeling and reveal actionable vulnerabilities in metastatic PCa. It uncovers novel post-translational regulation of pro-metastatic epigenetic factor ASH1L and informs biomarker-guided MUC1-targeted therapy for metastatic PCa.

papers.title_zh: 单细胞分析鉴定香烟烟雾暴露下中性粒细胞-巨噬细胞互作网络及HIF-1α/NET通路在COPD中的作用（机制性研究，未做通路干预验证）
papers.title_en: Single-cell analysis reveals smoke-induced neutrophil-macrophage crosstalk as a targetable mechanism in COPD pathogenesis.
papers.authors: Jiang S, Yang X, Li Y, Fei Y, Zhao C, Zou J, Zhu Y, Li W et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Nanxiang Branch of Ruijin Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine, Shanghai, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: CS exposure drives chronic pulmonary inflammation through a self-amplifying neutrophil-macrophage circuit mediated by HIF-1α-induced NET formation and dysregulated ANXA1-FPR2 signaling. This study establishes intercellular crosstalk networks as central mechanisms linking environmental tobacco exposure to COPD pathogenesis. Single-cell profiling stratified by environmental exposure may inform early biomarker development and guide pathway-specific interventions for smoke-related lung diseases.
papers.ai_note: 标题与结论称'可靶向机制(targetable)'，但全文未实施任何ANXA1-FPR2或HIF-1α/NET通路的阻断或干预实验，'targetable'仅为推断，信息不足以支撑可成药性主张；小鼠验证的均为CS暴露相关性指标（细胞因子、MPO、蛋白表达），未验证'自我放大环路'的因果性，存在把相关性表述为驱动机制的滑移；体外推断的配受体对为ANXA1-FPR1/FPR2，而体内验证仅检测FPR2，FPR1未报告，推断与验证对象不完全一致；scRNA-seq仅9例且未说明吸烟分层各组样本量与临床特征匹配，存在人群混杂风险；样本水平仅NK细胞比例达FDR显著，巨噬细胞仅'趋势'，却作为主要结论反复强调，属选择性强调；'信息不足'：未报告效应量、细胞比例具体数值及小鼠样本量
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is projected to become the third leading cause of death globally by 2030, with cigarette smoke (CS) exposure accounting for 80-90% of cases. This study aimed to elucidate the intercellular communication networks amplified by CS exposure and identify targetable pathways driving smoking-related COPD pathogenesis. METHODS: We performed single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) analysis of lung tissues from nine COPD patients stratified by smoking status (GSE173896), integrating ligand-receptor interaction inference (CellChat), pseudo-temporal trajectory analysis (Monocle), phenotype-cell linkage (Scissor), and weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) with bulk RNA-seq data (GSE57148). Smoking-associated immune cell subpopulations were identified, and pathogenic gene modules were prioritized through functional enrichment analysis. Key computational predictions were validated in C57BL/6 mice exposed to cigarette smoke for 90 days, with assessment of pulmonary function, histopathology, serum cytokines (ELISA), immunofluorescence, Western blot, and lung myeloperoxidase (MPO) activity. RESULTS: After quality control, 40,500 cells were analyzed (28,630 from COPD and 11,870 from never-smoker control tissues). At the sample level, COPD tissues showed a lower proportion of NK cells than controls (FDR = 0.011) and a trend toward more macrophages. Intercellular communication analysis revealed neutrophils and macrophages as dominant signaling hubs, and ANXA1-FPR1/FPR2 was among the most prominent neutrophil-to-macrophage ligand-receptor pairs. Trajectory analysis followed by sub-clustering and Scissor analysis prioritized macrophage and neutrophil subpopulations associated with the COPD phenotype in bulk lung tissue. Enrichment analysis of these modules pointed to neutrophil extracellular trap (NET) formation and HIF-1 signaling. In vivo validation confirmed CS-induced pulmonary dysfunction, elevated serum cytokines (IL-1β, TNF-α, IL-6; all p < 0.05), increased macrophage infiltration with FPR2 upregulation (p < 0.01), neutrophil accumulation (p < 0.01) and NET formation, increased lung MPO activity (p < 0.001), and HIF-1α protein induction (p < 0.001). CONCLUSION: CS exposure drives chronic pulmonary inflammation through a self-amplifying neutrophil-macrophage circuit mediated by HIF-1α-induced NET formation and dysregulated ANXA1-FPR2 signaling. This study establishes intercellular crosstalk networks as central mechanisms linking environmental tobacco exposure to COPD pathogenesis. Single-cell profiling stratified by environmental exposure may inform early biomarker development and guide pathway-specific interventions for smoke-related lung diseases.

papers.study_type: 高通量化合物筛选联合全基因组CRISPR/Cas9筛选的临床前机制研究（体外细胞实验+NSCLC小鼠模型）

papers.title_zh: 高通量筛选发现桑黄素经AGTR2/caspase-3/GSDME通路诱导NSCLC细胞焦亡的临床前机制研究（仅细胞与小鼠模型验证）
papers.title_en: Morusin induces GSDME-dependent pyroptosis in non-small cell lung cancer via the angiotensin II receptor type 2.
papers.authors: Cui X, Zhang Q, Hu J, Li X, Shu C, Xi Y, Zheng S, Ma S et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pathogenic Biology and Immunology, School of Basic Medical Sciences, Chongqing Medical University, Chongqi…
papers.authors_conclusion: Our study reveals a novel mechanism underlying the antitumor effect of morusin, establishes AGTR2 as a potential therapeutic target, and provides a rationale for pyroptosis-based therapy for NSCLC.
papers.ai_note: 纯临床前研究，无患者数据，对临床决策无直接影响；摘要全文无任何定量结果（无抑制率、CI、P值、样本量），抑瘤与AGTR2依赖性仅以定性措辞（potentially/substantially diminished）表述，效果量信息不足；AGTR2被确立为靶点仅基于CRISPR筛选与敲除小鼠模型，缺乏独立队列与人体验证；桑黄素的药代/生物利用度及焦亡选择性（是否伤及正常细胞）未涉及。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Lung cancer remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, its 5-year survival rate continues to be unsatisfactory. Current therapies are often limited by resistance, toxicity, or poor efficacy, highlighting the urgent need for novel strategies. METHOD: We performed a high-throughput compound screen for inducing cell death in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) cells. Combined with lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) release assays, cell death morphology observation, and propidium iodide (PI) staining, we confirmed the cell death mode as pyroptosis. Then, we conducted a genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 screen to identify the critical regulator of compound-induced pyroptosis. RESULTS: The screening results showed that morusin is a trigger of gasdermin E (GSDME)-mediated pyroptosis in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) cells. Importantly, morusin suppresses tumor growth in vivo. Through a genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 screen, we further demonstrated that angiotensin II receptor type 2 (AGTR2) as a critical regulator of morusin-induced pyroptosis, acting via activation of the caspase-3-GSDME signaling cascade. Notably, morusin also upregulated AGTR2 expression in NSCLC cells. In an NSCLC mouse model, morusin treatment potently suppressed wild-type tumor growth, whereas its antitumor efficacy was substantially diminished in AGTR2-knockout tumors. CONCLUSION: Our study reveals a novel mechanism underlying the antitumor effect of morusin, establishes AGTR2 as a potential therapeutic target, and provides a rationale for pyroptosis-based therapy for NSCLC.

papers.study_type: 多中心前瞻性观察性研究 · 血液标志物预测价值分析
papers.title_zh: 吡非尼酮治疗IPF患者基线及6个月血液标志物（CCL18/KL-6/CA-125）对FVC恶化与疾病进展的预测价值：加用标志物后AUC由0.769升至0.824但未达显著
papers.title_en: Baseline and longitudinal changes in blood biomarkers for predicting clinical outcomes in pirfenidone-treated idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis: a prospective observational study.
papers.authors: Kang J, Lee KH, Lee JH, Jeong YY, Choi SM, Kim HC, Park JH, Lee HK et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Division of Pulmonary and Critical Care Medicine, Department of Internal Medicine, Seoul National University Bundang Hos…
papers.authors_conclusion: These findings suggest that several blood biomarkers, particularly CCL18, KL-6, and CA-125, may provide additional prognostic information for IPF patients receiving pirfenidone and warrant further investigation.
papers.ai_note: 核心增量价值未达显著：AUC由0.769升至0.824为非显著改善，但结论仍表述为『可提供额外预后信息』，属对阴性/边缘结果的乐观化表述；摘要未报告任何HR、OR、95%CI或P值，各标志物关联的效应量与显著性水平信息不足；仅118例单队列、无外部验证，事件数未报告，过拟合风险无法评估；次要/替代终点（12个月FVC恶化、复合疾病进展）替代了更长期硬终点。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: This study investigated blood biomarkers for predicting lung function decline or disease progression in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) receiving pirfenidone. METHODS: Data from a multicenter prospective observational study in South Korea were analyzed. Patients with available blood samples at baseline and 6 months were followed up for 12 months. We assessed the predictive value of baseline levels and 6-month changes in nine biomarkers for forced vital capacity (FVC) deterioration and disease progression. FVC deterioration was defined as an absolute decline of ≥ 10% points in FVC % predicted at 12 months, while disease progression included FVC deterioration, hospitalization, or death. RESULTS: A total of 118 patients were included, with a mean age of 68.9 years and 82.2% being men. Median follow-up and treatment duration were 350 days. Greater FVC decline was observed in patients with higher baseline biomarker levels. Elevated baseline CCL18 predicted FVC deterioration in unadjusted analysis, and higher baseline CCL18 and KL-6 were independently associated with disease progression after adjusting for age, sex, and baseline FVC. Baseline CA-125 was associated with FVC deterioration after adjustment, and its relative changes over 6 months were associated with FVC deterioration and showed a trend toward disease progression. When comparing predictive models, individual biomarkers showed discriminative performance comparable to clinical variables, and their addition to clinical variables resulted in a slight, non-significant improvement in performance (area under the curve for FVC deterioration increasing from 0.769 to 0.824). CONCLUSIONS: These findings suggest that several blood biomarkers, particularly CCL18, KL-6, and CA-125, may provide additional prognostic information for IPF patients receiving pirfenidone and warrant further investigation.

papers.study_type: 多组学整合+计算模拟+体外实验验证的临床前机制研究（无体内动物模型验证）
papers.category_label: 局晚期与晚期靶向/免疫
papers.title_zh: 基于单细胞组学与网络药理学筛选Galangin和Kaempferol作为AhR拮抗剂逆转SCLC中TAM免疫抑制极化的临床前研究
papers.title_en: Aryl hydrocarbon receptor-dependent regulation of polarization in tumor-associated macrophages by galangin and kaempferol in small-cell lung cancer.
papers.authors: Meng L, Mai H, Ze H, Hu X, Chen J, Li K, Zhang Z, Hu W et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, The First Affiliated Hospital of Ningbo University, Ningbo 315010, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: This work elucidates at single-cell resolution the distinct immunosuppressive role of AhR+ TAMs in SCLC and validates galangin and kaempferol as candidate modulators of TAM polarization. Our findings provide an exploratory, hypothesis-generating mechanistic basis for AhR-targeted immunomodulatory strategies aimed at mitigating immunosuppression in SCLC.
papers.ai_note: 纯临床前研究，无体内动物模型验证，无临床样本验证；摘要未报告任何具体效应量、P值或置信区间，仅定性描述'逆转M2极化'和'AhR依赖性'，信息不足无法评估效应强度。'AhR依赖性'的实验验证方法（如siRNA/CRISPR敲低）未在摘要中说明。药物源自中药网络药理学筛选（137个化合物/20味中药），临床转化路径不明确。作者已自行标注为'hypothesis-generating'，但摘要选择性强调阳性预测结果而未提及潜在局限。
papers.abstract_en: The poor prognosis of small cell lung cancer (SCLC) is closely linked to immunosuppressive M2-polarized tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs). While the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) promotes immunosuppressive myeloid differentiation, its single-cell mechanisms and targeted therapeutics in SCLC remain undefined. Integrating single-cell transcriptomics, network pharmacology, and cell communication analysis, we constructed a comprehensive SCLC atlas identifying AhR as a central immunosuppressive hub. Uniquely, AhR+ TAMs displayed a mixed inflammatory-regulatory phenotype rather than a classic M2 signature, acting as pivotal modulators of TME signaling. Screening 137 bioactive compounds from 20 traditional Chinese medicines identified galangin and kaempferol as potential AhR antagonists. Docking and MD simulations predicted compatible occupancy of the AhR ligand-binding domain, which was supported experimentally by SPR binding and by blockade of FICZ- or SCLC-conditioned medium-induced nuclear translocation and transcriptional activity. Consequently, they reversed M2 polarization by downregulating M2 markers and cytokines in an AhR-dependent manner. This work elucidates at single-cell resolution the distinct immunosuppressive role of AhR+ TAMs in SCLC and validates galangin and kaempferol as candidate modulators of TAM polarization. Our findings provide an exploratory, hypothesis-generating mechanistic basis for AhR-targeted immunomodulatory strategies aimed at mitigating immunosuppression in SCLC.

papers.study_type: 叙述性综述（半结构化文献检索，PubMed/Embase/CINAHL，2007年1月–2026年5月）
papers.title_zh: 肺移植患者用药依从性干预的叙述性综述：依从性改善但无任何干预证实临床结局获益
papers.title_en: Addressing medication adherence in lung transplantation patients: a narrative review on interventions.
papers.authors: Schelders MA, Laios LC, Smit C, Gan CT, van Boven JFM
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Clinical Pharmacy & Pharmacology, University Medical Center Groningen, University of Groningen, Groningen,…
papers.authors_conclusion: 应将用药依从性常规评估纳入肺移植患者的标准临床实践，并系统纳入队列研究；依从性干预应采用多因素方法，证据表明数字、行为和治疗相关干预均可有效改善依从性；鉴于患者群体的异质性，一刀切方法不太可能最优，干预应根据个体特征、需求和情况量身定制以最大化有效性。
papers.ai_note: 摘要声称所有领域均显示依从性显著改善，但未给出任何具体数值、效应量或统计学指标，无法核实；作为叙述性综述无预设方案与偏倚风险评估，可能存在选择性纳入阳性研究的偏倚；摘要同时承认依从性改善未转化为任何临床结局获益，但expert opinion部分未充分讨论这一核心矛盾，存在对依从性终点的乐观强调倾向。
papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Lung transplant patients need lifelong immunosuppressive medication, but adherence is often challenging due to complex treatment regimens and occurrence of side effects. Since nonadherence is strongly associated with poor graft and patient survival, effective adherence-enhancing interventions are needed. However, specific evidence regarding lung transplant patients remains limited, making it unclear which interventions are most effective for this high-risk population. AREAS COVERED: This narrative review examined interventions aimed at improving medication adherence after lung transplantation (LTx) through a semi-structured literature search in PubMed, Embase, and CINAHL. Included studies described interventions that comprised digital interventions, behavioral and therapy-related interventions and were published between January 2007 and May 2026. In all areas, significant improvement of medication adherence was shown, although efficacy on clinical outcomes was not shown for any intervention. EXPERT OPINION: Routine assessment of medication adherence should be incorporated into standard clinical practice for patients with LTx and systematically included in cohort studies. Adherence-enhancing interventions should adopt a multifactorial approach, as evidence suggests that digital, behavioral, and therapy-related interventions can be effective in improving adherence. Given the heterogeneity of patient populations, a one-size-fits-all approach is unlikely to be optimal. Instead, interventions should be tailored to individual patient characteristics, needs, and circumstances to maximize their effectiveness.

papers.study_type: 多组学整合生物信息学研究，辅以计算毒理学、机器学习优先级筛选与探索性实验验证
papers.title_zh: 多组学整合与机器学习优先级排序识别PFAS与COPD交界面的免疫炎症候选分子节点（HMOX1、JUNB、CXCL12、PTGS2）
papers.title_en: Integrative multi-omics, machine learning, computational toxicology, and experimental validation reveal PFAS-associated immune-inflammatory signatures in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
papers.authors: Hu Z, Yang Y, Yu J, Nian M, Cui J, Ran P, Cao X, Xin H et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Ningxia Key Laboratory of Clinical and Pathogenic Microorganisms, Institute of Medical Science, General Hospital of Ning…
papers.authors_conclusion: This integrative systems-immunology framework delineates immune-inflammatory signatures at the PFAS-COPD interface and identifies HMOX1, JUNB, CXCL12, and PTGS2 as convergent molecular nodes. The findings do not establish exposure causality but provide a multi-scale basis for future epidemiological and mechanistic studies of how persistent environmental pollutants may contribute to COPD-associated immune and inflammatory alterations.
papers.ai_note: 标题使用'reveal'（揭示）一词带有较强断言色彩，但作者结论明确承认'未建立暴露因果关系'，标题与结论之间存在张力；血浆ELISA仅称为'exploratory'（探索性）且摘要未提供样本量、效应量、CI或P值；核心结果全部为关联性分析与计算预测（分子对接仅为结构假说），无前瞻性设计支持因果推断；113种机器学习模型组合的比较可能存在多重比较后选择性报告最优模型的风险；信息不足以评估样本量与统计效力
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) are persistent environmental contaminants increasingly implicated in respiratory disorders. However, the systems-level connections among PFAS-associated molecular perturbations, immune dysregulation, and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) remain poorly understood. This study aimed to prioritize candidate links between PFAS-associated target information and COPD-related transcriptional and inflammatory signatures. METHODS: PFAS-associated target information was integrated with bulk transcriptomic differential expression and weighted gene co-expression network analysis to identify overlapping candidate genes. Protein-protein interaction analysis and 113 machine-learning model combinations were used for candidate prioritization and cross-cohort classification evaluation. CIBERSORT and xCell provided computational immune-cell signatures, with Benjamini-Hochberg correction applied to group comparisons and gene-signature correlations; single-cell transcriptomics provided cell-type expression context. Candidate expression was examined in cigarette-smoke-extract-treated cells, clinical samples, and public human and murine datasets. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations explored candidate PFAS-protein interactions. RESULTS: HMOX1, JUNB, CXCL12, and PTGS2 were prioritized as candidate genes overlapping PFAS-associated target information and COPD-related expression patterns. Enrichment and immune-deconvolution analyses suggested associations with inflammatory and immune-related signatures, while single-cell analysis described their distribution across annotated cell types. Exploratory plasma ELISA measurements supported higher levels of the four candidate proteins in participants with COPD, with additional expression support varying by gene and experimental model. Docking and molecular dynamics generated structural hypotheses for PFOA/PFOS-protein interactions, including HMOX1. CONCLUSIONS: This integrative systems-immunology framework delineates immune-inflammatory signatures at the PFAS-COPD interface and identifies HMOX1, JUNB, CXCL12, and PTGS2 as convergent molecular nodes. The findings do not establish exposure causality but provide a multi-scale basis for future epidemiological and mechanistic studies of how persistent environmental pollutants may contribute to COPD-associated immune and inflammatory alterations.

papers.study_type: 网络药理学/非靶向代谢组学预测靶点 + 体内外（小鼠ALI模型）实验验证的临床前机制研究
papers.title_zh: 香薷二氯甲烷提取物通过调控CCR1与FLT1通路减轻小鼠急性肺损伤炎症并重塑肠道菌群
papers.title_en: Elsholtzia Bodinieri vaniot dichloromethane extract exerts anti-inflammatory effects in acute lung injury mice by regulating the CCR1 and FLT1.
papers.authors: Li Y, Sun R, Feng Y, Li Z, Duan L, Cao Y, Xiang B, Li Y et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Faculty of Food Science and Engineering, Kunming University of Science and Technology, Kunming, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: EBED对ALI具有 potent 的抗炎活性，该效应通过调控关键靶基因CCR1和FLT1介导；此外EBED对ALI小鼠肠道菌群具有有利的重塑作用；这些发现使EBED有望成为有前景的功能性食品成分及ALI预防与治疗的潜在治疗候选物
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：靶点CCR1/FLT1来自生物信息学/网络药理学预测，验证仅依赖Western blot通路蛋白与炎症介质检测，未见基因敲除、拮抗剂或回补实验以确证因果；全篇无剂量、样本量、统计学数值、CI/P及阳性对照药数据，『显著』表述无法核验；肠道菌群变化为相关性证据，未做菌群移植或去定植验证；主要终点（肺损伤/炎症硬指标）与效应量未量化，结论中『功能性食品成分与治疗候选物』超出动物实验与机制预测的证据强度
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Acute lung injury (ALI) is a disease characterized by diffuse dysfunction leading to systemic inflammation, increased vascular permeability and loss of alveolar epithelial cell function. Elsholtzia bodinieri Vaniot is a traditional folk medicinal and edible plant endowed with heat-clearing(Qingre) and detoxifying efficacies. METHODS: The dichloromethane fraction of E. bodinieri Vaniot extract (EBED) was isolated and evaluated for anti-inflammatory activity. Chemical profiling of EBED was performed using untargeted metabolomics. Putative target genes of EBED were predicted through bioinformatics analysis, and the anti-inflammatory effects of EBED were assessed both in vitro and in vivo using a model of acute lung injury (ALI). Mechanistic validation focused on CC chemokine receptor 1 (CCR1)- and Fms-like tyrosine kinase 1 (FLT1)-mediated downstream signaling pathways by Western blot and inflammatory mediator detection. In addition, the impact of EBED on gut microbiota composition was evaluated in ALI mice via fecal microbiome analysis, with particular attention to changes in the relative abundances of specific bacterial genera. RESULTS: EBED exerted markedly superior anti-inflammatory activity compared with other fractions. A total of 1775 chemical metabolites were identified in EBED. Bioinformatics analysis predicted that CCR1 and FLT1 serve as potential target genes for EBED to exert anti-inflammatory activity against ALI, which was subsequently validated in inflammatory pathways. In vitro and in vivo experiments collectively demonstrated that EBED mitigates inflammatory responses via modulating CCR1 and FLT1, as well as their downstream signaling cascades including CCR1/Ca2+, FLT1/PRKCA and FLT1/PRKD2, thereby regulating the expression of inflammatory mediators. Furthermore, EBED remodeled the gut microbiota structure in ALI mice. Specifically, the abundances of beneficial bacteria including Akkermansia, Lactobacillus, Ruminococcus and Coriobacteriaceae_UCG-002 were markedly elevated, while those of harmful bacteria such as Rikenellaceae, Tyzzerella and Paraprevotella were distinctly decreased. CONCLUSION: In summary, the EBED demonstrates potent anti-inflammatory activity against ALI. This effect is mediated through the modulation of key target genes CCR1 and FLT1. Additionally, EBED exerts a favorable remodelling effect on the gut microbiota of ALI mice. These findings position EBED as a promising functional food ingredient and a potential therapeutic candidate for the prevention and treatment of ALI.

papers.study_type: 工程原型可行性研究 · 台架测试 + 4头健康猪概念验证（无对照）
papers.title_zh: 基于汽车与五金零件的简易呼吸机原型：台架与4头猪概念验证显示可覆盖多数通气范围
papers.title_en: Simple and easy to build mechanical ventilator for pandemic health crises in resource-limited areas.
papers.authors: Farré R, Salama R, Rodríguez-Lázaro MA, Kiarostami K, Fernández-Barat L, Oliveira VC, Torres A, Farré N et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Unitat de Biofisica i Bioenginyeria, Facultat de Medicina i Ciències de la Salut, Universitat de Barcelona, Barcelona, S…
papers.authors_conclusion: 尽管存在局限，该低成本呼吸机作为原型显示出充分性能；虽不能替代商用重症监护呼吸机，但其简便性、自主性与对脆弱供应链的低依赖，为资源受限应急场景提供了挽救生命的可选途径
papers.ai_note: 无对照组、样本量仅4头且为健康猪（非急性肺损伤模型），无呼吸力学、血流动力学或气道/肺损伤组织学终点；体内仅以'血气维持在目标范围'表述，未给具体数值、目标范围定义与逐例数据，无法评估；台架'覆盖多数通气范围'为参数上限而非实际通气效果，且PEEP上限10 cmH₂O、未报告压力支持/同步触发/报警等关键安全性能；作者自陈'局限'但摘要未列出具体局限内容；开源视频教程替代完整技术验证资料。信息不足
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The COVID-19 pandemic exposed critical shortages of mechanical ventilators, particularly in low-resource settings. Disruptions in global supply chains and dependence on specialized components highlighted the need for scalable, locally manufacturing alternatives for emergency respiratory support. AIM: To describe and evaluate a simplified mechanical ventilator with minimal supply-chain dependence, assembled from widely available automotive and simple hardware components, and intended as a last-resort solution. METHODS: The ventilator is based on a reciprocating air pump driven by an automotive windshield wiper motor coupled to parallel shaft bellows and readily assembled passive membrane valves, only requiring materials available from standard hardware retailers, minimal tools, and basic manual skills. Ventilator performance was assessed through bench testing using a patient model simulating severe lung disease in an adult (R = 20 cmH₂O·s/L, C = 15 mL/cmH₂O) and pediatric (R = 50 cmH₂O·s/L, C = 10 mL/cmH₂O) patients. Realistic proof of concept was performed in four mechanically ventilated 50-kg healthy pigs. RESULTS: According to the bench test, the device delivered tidal volumes up to 600 mL and respiratory rates up to 45 breaths/min with PEEP up to 10 cmH₂O, covering most pediatric and adult ventilation ranges. The in vivo proof-of-concept showed that the ventilator maintained arterial blood gases within the targeted range. Technical details for ventilator construction are provided in an open-source video tutorial. DISCUSSION: Notwithstanding its limitations, this low-cost ventilator demonstrated adequate performance as a prototype. Although not a substitute for commercial intensive care ventilators, its simplicity, autonomy, and low dependence from fragile supply chains provides an approach towards life-saving options in resource-constrained emergency scenarios.

papers.title_en: Clinical Interpretation of Variants in CHIP-Associated Genes Detected Using Tumor-Only Comprehensive Genomic Profiling in NSCLC.
papers.authors: Inoue Y, Karayama M, Yasui H, Suzuki Y, Hozumi H, Furuhashi K, Enomoto N, Inui N et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Second Division, Department of Internal Medicine, Hamamatsu University School of Medicine, Hamamatsu, Japan.
papers.authors_conclusion: Although NCF-based classification stratified the prognosis of TP53-mutated NSCLC, this separation largely reflected TP53 VAF distribution rather than biologically distinct subgroups.
papers.ai_note: NCF阈值1为探索性设定且未外部验证；NCF与VAF共线性极强（ρ=0.91），二者同时纳入多变量模型的独立效应存疑。区分度极低（C-index 0.54/0.53）却仍被用于预后分层表述，属弱判别力下的分层宣称。SETD2为突变亚组内探索性分析，且NCF在其阴性——与TP53阳性结论方向不一致。摘要未报告TP53/SETD2的HR与95%CI，效应量信息不足。NCF框架在单变量中反而不显著、仅多变量/亚组中出现分层，提示模型依赖性。
papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: The interpretation of variants in genes associated with clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP) detected by tumor-only comprehensive genomic profiling (CGP) remains challenging. We investigated the prognostic significance of variants in CHIP-associated genes and evaluated whether the normal cell fraction (NCF) framework could be extrapolated to tumor-only CGP to provide clinically meaningful stratification in NSCLC. METHODS: We analyzed 3294 patients with NSCLC who underwent tumor-only CGP using FoundationOne CDx and were registered in the Center for Cancer Genomics and Advanced Therapeutics. Forty-six CHIP-associated genes were evaluated. Associations between mutations and post-CGP overall survival (OS) were assessed using the Cox proportional hazards model. The NCF-based classification used CHIP mutation-type criteria and an exploratory NCF threshold of 1. The associations of NCF and variant allele frequency (VAF) with OS were evaluated. RESULTS: TP53 and SETD2 mutations remained significantly associated with OS after multivariable adjustment, with TP53 associated with shorter OS and SETD2 associated with longer OS. In TP53-mutated cases, NCF-based classification stratified survival outcomes; nevertheless, NCF was strongly correlated with VAF (Spearman's ρ = 0.91; p < 0.0001). Restricted cubic spline analyses found no clear VAF threshold, with no significant association after multivariable adjustment (p = 0.24). In univariable continuous-variable analyses, VAF, but not NCF, was associated with OS, although both showed. limited prognostic discrimination (C-indices, 0.54 and 0.53, respectively). Within SETD2-mutated cases, NCF-based classification did not provide meaningful prognostic stratification. CONCLUSIONS: Although NCF-based classification stratified the prognosis of TP53-mutated NSCLC, this separation largely reflected TP53 VAF distribution rather than biologically distinct subgroups.

papers.authors: Landry SA, Joosten SA, Collet J, Preston T, Thomson LDJ, Beatty CJ, Emperado T, Mann D et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: School of Psychological Sciences and Turner Institute for Brain and Mental Health, Monash University, Melbourne, Victori…

papers.ai_note: 选择性强调：结论与标题突出联合用药'显著改善OSA严重度'，但摘要显示联合对fAHI并不优于乙酰唑胺单药（-3.4/h，95%CI -8.5~1.6；-14.6%，95%CI -31.1~5.8），联合优效仅见于替代/机制终点loop gain。fAHI采用不含去饱和与觉醒判定的流速事件标准，非标准AHI，跨研究可比性受限。方法学局限：样本量小（22例）、单盲、仅7天用药、无CPAP等标准治疗对照、无长期依从性/不良反应与硬终点。信息不足：摘要未交代主要终点与检验层级的预设、退出与安全性数据；-23.3/hr与其CI [-26.6, -13.1] 不对称，原始分布未说明。
papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Ventilatory control instability (elevated 'loop gain') is a key pathophysiological determinant of obstructive sleep apnea (OSA), but available interventions have modest potency. RESEARCH QUESTION: Since acetazolamide (ACZ) and supplemental oxygen (O2) independently lower loop gain via different mechanisms, can combination ACZO2 strongly reduce loop gain and therefore OSA severity? STUDY DESIGN AND METHOD: In a randomized, single-blind, crossover trial, 22 participants with moderate-severe OSA (15 M, 7 F), received ACZ (500 mg daily) or placebo for 7 days. On the final nights of each period, participants underwent two nights of polysomnography with O2 (3 L/min) or sham. Loop gain (LG1) and flow-based apnea-hypopnea-index (fAHI, events scored without desaturation/arousal criteria) were assessed from polysomnography at each visit. RESULTS: Compared with placebo+sham both ACZ and O2 monotherapies produced significant reduction in both LG1 and AHI. Combination ACZO2 markedly reduced LG1 by -0.26 [CI95%: -0.32, -0.20], and further significantly reduced LG1 compared to both ACZ (-0.07 [-0.13, -0.01]) and O2 alone -0.08 [-0.14, -0.02]. ACZO2 strongly reduced fAHI by -23.3/hr [-26.6, -13.1] (-55.2% [-63.9, -44.4]), however was not superior to ACZ alone (-3.4/h [-8.5, 1.6], -14.6% [-31.1, 5.8]). INTERPRETATION: In patients with OSA, combining acetazolamide and supplemental oxygen provides a potent reduction in loop gain and roughly halves the AHI. This combination intervention holds promise for individuals whose OSA is meaningfully driven by elevated ventilatory control. CLINICAL TRIAL REGISTRATION: ACTRN12616001297415.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Small cell carcinoma (SCC) is an aggressive malignancy that commonly arises in the lung and can develop in extrapulmonary organs. Although organ-specific genomic studies have been reported, the clinicogenomic landscape of SCC across primary sites remains poorly characterized. We conducted a nationwide Japanese clinicogenomic analysis to characterize recurrent and organ-specific molecular features and assess their potential therapeutic actionability in SCC. PATIENTS AND METHODS: We obtained clinicogenomic data from the Center for Cancer Genomics and Advanced Therapeutics (C-CAT) database, and included patients with SCC who underwent comprehensive genomic profiling (CGP) between June 2019 and February 2025. Genomic alterations were annotated using OncoKB therapeutic evidence levels, and each patient was assigned to the highest level identified. RESULTS: Among 95,234 patients who underwent CGP, 615 (0.65%) had SCC, including 320 with small cell lung cancer (SCLC) and 295 with extrapulmonary SCC (EPSCC). TP53 (73.0%) and RB1 (49.9%) alterations were the most frequent events. Organ-specific genomic features included frequent TERT alterations in bladder SCC, PTEN alterations in prostate SCC, and SMARCA4 alterations in ovarian SCC. Furthermore, EGFR alterations were significantly associated with never-smoking status in SCLC after multiple-testing correction and adjustment for age and sex. CGP identified potentially actionable alterations corresponding to OncoKB Levels 1, 2, 3A, or 3B in 12.2% of patients, including ERBB2 amplification in 3.7%. CONCLUSIONS: SCC demonstrates recurrent genomic alterations and substantial organ-specific molecular heterogeneity across primary sites. CGP identified potentially actionable genomic alterations in a subset of patients, while the clinical relevance of these findings requires further evaluation.

papers.authors: Baccelli A, Rinaldo RF, Davies RJ, Gin-Sing W, Vigo B, Lo Giudice F, Haji G, Howard LS et al.

papers.ai_note: 共病定义为≥3项危险因素（肥胖、高血压、糖尿病、冠心病、吸烟史、TLCO<45%预计值）的组合，属研究者自定阈值且未见外部验证，存在表型定义的灵活性；主要关注的运动能力终点仅报告'相似改善'而无具体数值、CI或等效/非劣效界值，'无差异'不等于已证实等效；气体交换（A-a梯度）差异虽p=0.003，但属相对次要的探索性终点，且其临床意义阈值未说明；信息不足：摘要未给出各运动终点的具体校正值与置信区间、未说明是否校正基线值及多因素模型细节、未报告共病组人数较少对检验效能的影响。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Current ESC/ERS guidelines suggest that initial monotherapy should be considered for pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) with cardiopulmonary comorbidities. However, data on the cardiopulmonary physiological responses to treatment in this subset of patients remain limited. Our aim was to evaluate the cardiopulmonary exercise and gas exchange response to treatment in patients with PAH and cardiopulmonary comorbidities. RESEARCH QUESTION: Do patients with PAH and a cardiopulmonary phenotype display a worse exercise capacity and gas exchange response to treatment? STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: Incident treatment-naïve patients with idiopathic, heritable, drug/toxins-induced, HIV, and connective tissue disease-associated PAH were analysed at first follow-up. Comorbid patients were defined based on the presence of ≥3 risk factors among obesity (body mass index ≥30 Kg/m2), systemic arterial hypertension, diabetes mellitus, coronary artery disease, smoking history and transfer factor of the lung for carbon monoxide (TLCO) <45% predicted. RESULTS: A total of 178 patients were included: 52 with comorbidities and 126 without. Comorbid patients were older, predominantly male, and had a lower baseline exercise capacity, despite comparable hemodynamics. There were no differences in therapy, with approximately one third of patients receiving combination therapy in both groups at the time of reassessment. At follow-up, both groups demonstrated similar adjusted improvements from baseline in peak oxygen uptake, oxygen pulse, ventilatory efficiency and 6-minute walk distance, all known prognostic markers in PAH. However, comorbid patients exhibited a significantly worse gas exchange response to treatment, with an adjusted widening of the peak A-a gradient of +1.23 kPa compared with -0.35 kPa in patients without comorbidities (p=0.003). INTERPRETATION: PAH patients with and without cardiopulmonary comorbidities achieve similar improvements in exercise capacity after treatment. However, the worse gas exchange response to exercise among comorbid patients warrants caution, careful monitoring and further research to confirm this finding.

papers.ai_note: ① '一线疗效显著更优（HR=2.70, P=.001）'方向表述含混：HR=2.70更可能对应后线vs一线，摘要未标注参照组，方向不可确证；② 一线vs后线、一线vs常规方案均为非随机分组，存在适应证与线数选择偏倚（后线患者本身经多线治疗、疾病更难治），不能解读为线序治疗的因果效应；③ 未报告任何95%CI，仅给P值，估计精度无法评估；④ '更好的安全性、更少3级及以上AE'无任何具体发生率数值；⑤ PIK3CA为探索性生物标志物，未提及多重比较校正，且样本中PIK3CA突变例数（由18.8%推算约16例）较少，ORR与PFS估计不稳定；⑥ 机制部分（p-AKT/p-mTOR升高）为相关性观察，'通路过度激活'的提示缺乏功能实验验证
papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: Real-world evidence regarding RET-tyrosine kinase inhibitors (RET-TKIs) efficacy and predictive biomarkers in Chinese RET fusion-positive non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients remains insufficient. This study aimed to evaluate the real-world efficacy and safety of RET-TKIs and identify potential predictive biomarkers for treatment response and resistance. METHODS: This retrospective study included 132 advanced RET fusion-positive NSCLC patients. We analyzed efficacy, safety, and prognostic factors. Co-mutation profiles were identified by NGS, and mechanisms explored via Western blot and multiplex immunohistochemistry (mIHC). Cox regression screened independent predictors for outcomes. RESULTS: The overall median progression-free survival (mPFS) of RET-TKI treatment was 16.0 months, with first-line (1L) RET-TKI yielding superior efficacy over conventional regimens. About 1L RET-TKI treatment yielded significantly superior efficacy (HR = 2.70, P = .001) and a better safety profile with fewer grade ≥ 3 adverse events compared with RET-TKI administration in third-line (3L) and later settings. Patients with PIK3CA mutations exhibited significantly lower objective response rate (18.8%) and shorter mPFS (10.6 months, P = .033). PIK3CA co-mutation (HR = 3.06, P = .005), along with brain metastasis and increased prior treatment lines, were confirmed as independent adverse prognostic factors. Meanwhile, increased p-AKT and p-mTOR expression was observed in PIK3CA co-mutated samples, hinting at PI3K-AKT-mTOR pathway hyperactivation. CONCLUSION: RET-TKIs exhibit favorable real-world efficacy and safety in Chinese RET fusion-positive NSCLC patients, with better survival outcomes achieved with 1L versus later-line RET-TKI therapy. Although PIK3CA co-mutation is often associated with inferior treatment responses, these findings remain exploratory and await further confirmation in prospective studies.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Dyspnea is unexplained in 15% of patients. Insomnia has been associated with respiratory diseases, but its relationship with dyspnea in general population remains uncertain. RESEARCH QUESTION: Is there an association between dyspnea and insomnia, defined according to different criteria, using data from a population-based cohort? STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: Participants underwent complete respiratory, psychiatric and sleep assessments. Dyspnea (dependent variable) was defined as modified Medical Research Council (mMRC) ≥ 1. Insomnia (independent variable) was defined with Insomnia Severity Index (ISI) cut-offs ≥8 or ≥15, and with ISI categories as subthreshold (ISI 8 to 14) or clinical (ISI≥15) insomnia. Logistic regressions were performed adjusted for age, sex, BMI, smoking, FEV1, AHI, psychiatric disorders and self-reported cardiac and respiratory disorders. We defined unexplained dyspnea with mMRC≥1 for participants of a healthy group (normal spirometry, normal Nt-proBNP, no anemia, no respiratory or cardiac disorders and normal electrocardiogram). RESULTS: We included 1'221 participants (mean age 62.2 years; female 52%) of whom 42% reported dyspnea and 18% reported insomnia (ISI≥8). The prevalence of dyspnea increased among ISI categories. After adjustment, higher odds of dyspnea were significantly associated with ISI cut-offs ≥ 8 (OR 1.87, CI95 1.31-2.67) and ≥ 15 (OR 1.96, CI95 1.09-3.64), as well as subthreshold insomnia (OR 1.76, CI95 1.17-2.64) and clinical insomnia (OR 2.17, CI95 1.16-4.05), all FDR p-value<0.05. Unexplained dyspnea was also associated with ISI≥8.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Diffuse pleural mesothelioma (DPM) is an aggressive, most commonly asbestos-related malignancy with limited therapeutic options. HER2-directed antibody-drug conjugates active against HER2-low tumors have renewed interest in HER2 assessment across malignancies, yet no DPM-specific HER2 scoring system exists and the impact of applying tumor-specific guidelines to DPM is unknown. PATIENTS AND METHODS: We evaluated HER2 expression by immunohistochemistry, with FISH confirmation, in 53 consecutive DPM patients, and compared classification when the breast, gastric, and colorectal scoring guidelines were applied in parallel to the same cases. RESULTS: HER2 membrane staining was detected in 9 cases (17.0%), consistently faint-barely perceptible, incomplete, and segmental (median 5% of neoplastic cells), with no overexpression or amplification. The identical staining pattern yielded markedly discordant scores: most cases were classified as "0″ under breast criteria but as "1+" under gastric and colorectal criteria. HER2 expression was confined to epithelioid components. CONCLUSIONS: These findings show that, in the absence of a validated DPM-specific scoring system, HER2 guidelines are not interchangeable, a methodological caveat with direct implications for biomarker comparability and for interpreting "HER2-low" status in the era of next-generation antibody - drug conjugates.

papers.ai_note: 结论段突出PFS阳性而淡化OS主要生存终点未达显著（HR 0.84, P=0.222），存在以PFS替代OS作为卖点的倾向；OS随访截止2026年4月信息不足（数据收集窗口末端患者随访时间可能不足）。仅23%患者接受免疫检查点抑制剂，研究无法回答该标志物的免疫治疗预测价值，作者亦承认预测价值未确立。回顾性、免疫细胞可评估为入组条件、≥10%组仅28例，分层样本量小且未见多重比较校正，P趋势与HR检验的等价性假设信息不足。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The prognostic relevance of programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression on tumor-infiltrating immune cells remains uncertain in metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) without PD-L1 expression on tumor cells. OBJECTIVE: We evaluated PD-L1 expression on tumor-infiltrating immune cells and its association with treatment outcomes. PATIENTS AND METHODS: This retrospective real-world cohort included 174 patients with stage IV NSCLC without a documented targetable driver alteration on routine molecular testing, a PD-L1 tumor proportion score below 1%, and evaluable immune-cell expression who received first-line systemic therapy between January 2018 and April 2026. Patients were classified by immune-cell score as below 1%, 1-9%, or at least 10%. Outcomes were assessed using trend tests, Kaplan-Meier analyses, and multivariable Cox regression. RESULTS: First-line treatment was chemotherapy alone in 134 patients (77.0%) and included an immune checkpoint inhibitor in 40 patients (23.0%). Immune-cell scores were below 1% in 100 patients, 1-9% in 46 patients, and at least 10% in 28 patients. Objective response rates rose across categories (32.0%, 39.1%, 60.7%; P for trend = 0.009), as did progression-free survival (P for trend = 0.004). After adjustment, each one-category increase was independently associated with a 23% lower hazard of progression or death (hazard ratio 0.77, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.61-0.97; P = 0.025), with similar estimates across first-line regimens (interaction P = 0.82). Overall survival was numerically longer with higher immune-cell expression, but the adjusted association was not statistically significant (hazard ratio 0.84, 95% CI 0.64-1.11; P = 0.222). CONCLUSIONS: Higher immune-cell PD-L1 expression was independently associated with longer progression-free survival in tumor proportion score (TPS)-negative metastatic NSCLC without documented targetable driver alterations. Its potential prognostic role and unestablished predictive value for immunotherapy warrant prospective validation.

papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is a common sleep-related breathing disorder that increases the risk of cardiovascular diseases. While continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) remains the first-line therapy for OSA, adherence continues to be a major challenge. Recently, mandibular advancement devices (MADs) have emerged as a safe and effective alternative. This systematic review and meta-analysis aim to compare MAD and CPAP across several health outcomes. METHODS: Following PRISMA guidelines, six databases were searched, and the protocol was preregistered on PROSPERO (CRD420251081182). Primary outcomes included apnea-hypopnea index (AHI), minimum peripheral capillary oxygen saturation (SpO2), oxygen desaturation index (ODI), and several blood pressure (BP) parameters. Secondary outcomes included adherence, BMI, among others. A meta-analysis was performed using R version 4.6.0 and heterogeneity was assessed using I2 statistics. RESULTS: A total of 18 studies were included with 1244 participants. The CPAP group showed improvement in SpO2 (MD = -4.54, 95% CI: -5.50 to -3.59; p < 0.01; I2 = 50.2%), ODI (MD = 6.54, 95% CI: 3.70 to 9.38; p < 0.01; I2 = 85.4%), and arousal index (MD = 4.40, 95% CI: 1.22 to 7.58; p = <0.01; I2 = 77.5%). The MAD group showed significantly greater adherence (MD = 1.43, 95% CI: 1.10 to 1.77; p < 0.01; I2 = 55.6%) and modest significant reduction in several BP parameters. Meta-regression identified baseline AHI as a significant moderator of treatment effect (β = 0.82, 95% CI: 0.30 to 1.35; p < 0.01). CONCLUSION: This review suggests that treatment selection between CPAP and MAD may be informed by OSA severity and expected adherence. CPAP remains superior in improving polysomnographic parameters. Further long-term trials incorporating objectively monitored adherence and hard cardiovascular outcomes are needed to guide individualized treatment selection in OSA.
